attributes.description: the source system operation number (Vorgangs-Nr.) identifying the specific manufacturing step being performed on this WIP item. Aligns with the production order routing sequence.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Routing Operations; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: operation_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the manufacturing operation on this WIP item was started by the operator or automated system. Represents the principal business event time for this WIP transaction.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Shop Floor Execution; SAP S/4HANA PP – Confirmation

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain technology type of the vehicle being assembled: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), EV (Electric Vehicle), or FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Drives assembly process routing and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Emissions Standards; CARB ZEV Mandate; SAE J1711

attributes.name: priority_code
attributes.description: Production priority assigned to this WIP item. 'EXPEDITE' indicates a rush order requiring immediate processing to meet customer or dealer commitment. Used by shop floor supervisors to manage queue sequencing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Order Priority; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of units represented by this WIP inventory record. Typically 1 for discrete vehicle assemblies; may be greater than 1 for batch sub-assembly components (e.g., fasteners, brackets).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Stock Quantity; IATF 16949

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this WIP inventory record was first created in the source MES system. Audit trail field for data lineage and IATF 16949 traceability compliance.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this WIP inventory record was last modified in the source MES system. Used for change detection and incremental Silver Layer ingestion.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: sap_order_number
attributes.description: the source system order number (Auftragsnummer) from the source system corresponds to the production_order_id. Retained as a business-visible identifier for cross-system reconciliation between MES and ERP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Order; IATF 16949

attributes.name: scheduled_completion_date
attributes.description: Planned date by which this WIP item is expected to complete the current operation or exit the current stage, as defined in the production order schedule. Used for OTD (On-Time Delivery) tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Order Scheduling; OTD KPI

attributes.name: scrap_reason_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the reason a WIP item was scrapped (e.g., dimensional non-conformance, weld failure, paint defect, crash damage). Populated only when wip_status = 'scrapped'. Feeds PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: dimensional_nonconformance|weld_failure|paint_defect|crash_damage|material_defect|process_error — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; SAP S/4HANA QM – Scrap; PPM Reporting

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Just-in-Sequence (JIS) position number assigned to this WIP item within the production line sequence. Critical for sequenced delivery of components (e.g., seats, instrument panels) and for maintaining build order integrity.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – JIS Sequencing; SAE J4000 – JIS Principles

attributes.name: snapshot_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this WIP inventory snapshot record was captured. Supports point-in-time WIP visibility and Silver Layer delta processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – WIP Snapshot; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: standard_cycle_time_sec
attributes.description: Planned standard cycle time in seconds for the current operation on this WIP item, as defined in the the source system Used to calculate actual vs. standard cycle time variance and identify takt time deviations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Routing Standard Values; SAE J4000 – Lean Manufacturing

attributes.name: sub_assembly_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for a sub-assembly unit (e.g., powertrain module, instrument panel, axle assembly) when the WIP item is not yet associated with a full VIN. Assigned by the MES during component-level traceability.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Component Traceability; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: supplier_deviation_number
attributes.description: Reference number for an approved supplier deviation or concession allowing a non-standard component to be used in this WIP item. Issued via PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) deviation process.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7.1 – Supplier Deviation; PPAP Requirements

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the WIP quantity (e.g., EA = each for discrete assemblies, KG for weight-based materials). Aligns with the source system of measure (Basismengeneinheit). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|L|M|M2|M3|PC|SET — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Unit of Measure; ISO 80000

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Internal code identifying the vehicle model or nameplate being assembled (e.g., F-150, Silverado, Model 3 equivalent). Supports model-mix analysis and JIS sequencing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Material Master; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number assigned to the vehicle body or chassis associated with this WIP item. Populated once the VIN is stamped during body shop operations; null for sub-assembly WIP prior to VIN assignment.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 – VIN Requirements; ISO 3779

attributes.name: wip_record_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally visible business identifier for this WIP inventory record, generated by the MES (Manufacturing Execution System). Used on shop floor traveler documents and in MES dashboards.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Shop Floor Traceability; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2

attributes.name: wip_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the WIP item on the shop floor. 'in_process' = actively being worked on; 'on_hold' = paused pending resolution; 'awaiting_inspection' = queued for quality gate; 'scrapped' = condemned and removed from flow; 'completed' = operation finished; 'rework' = returned for corrective operations.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – WIP Status; IATF 16949 Clause 8.7 – Nonconforming Outputs

attributes.name: wip_valuation_amount
attributes.description: Standard cost valuation of this WIP item in the plant currency, calculated based on the accumulated material and activity costs up to the current production stage. Used for WIP inventory valuation in the source system and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO – WIP Valuation; IAS 2 – Inventories; GAAP

products.name: production_schedule
products.description: Master production schedule (MPS) record defining planned vehicle production volumes by plant, production line, model, MY (Model Year), and time period (daily, weekly, monthly). Captures scheduled quantity, confirmed quantity, schedule version, freeze horizon, schedule status, and MRP run reference. Integrates with the source system and supports capacity planning and supplier call-off generation.

attributes.name: production_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the master production schedule (MPS) record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: mrp_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the the source system Requirements Planning) run that generated or last updated this production schedule. Enables traceability of schedule origin and supports re-planning analysis.

attributes.name: nameplate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aftersales.aftersales_nameplate. Business justification: REQUIRED: Production schedules are often filtered by nameplate; nameplate‑level planning dashboards need this FK.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where the scheduled production will occur. Corresponds to the the source system unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Org Structure; IATF 16949

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production line (e.g., final assembly, body shop, paint shop, stamping) within the plant where the scheduled build will take place.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Center; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: vehicle_model_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle model (e.g., sedan, SUV, truck, EV) being scheduled for production. Links to the vehicle master product record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: vehicle_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.vehicle_program. Business justification: Production schedules are generated per vehicle program; schedule analytics filter by vehicle_program_id.

attributes.name: actual_quantity
attributes.description: Actual number of vehicles produced and confirmed as good units by the MES (Manufacturing Execution System) during the schedule period. Populated upon schedule completion from Apriso/Dassault MES.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; SAP S/4HANA PP Goods Receipt; IATF 16949 Clause 9.1

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the production planning manager who formally approved this schedule version for release to the shop floor. Required for IATF 16949 document control and audit trail.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5; SAP S/4HANA PP Workflow

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the production schedule was formally approved for release. Marks the transition from 'draft' to 'released' status and triggers supplier call-off generation.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5; SAP S/4HANA PP Workflow

attributes.name: assembly_process_stage
attributes.description: Manufacturing process stage covered by this schedule record. Reflects the major shop areas in automotive assembly: stamping (metal forming), body shop (welding/joining), paint (surface treatment), final assembly (powertrain/trim installation), or trim-chassis-final (TCF integrated line).
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; SAP S/4HANA PP Routing; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: available_capacity_hours
attributes.description: Total available production capacity in hours for this schedule period on the assigned production line, accounting for planned downtime, maintenance windows, and shift patterns.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Capacity Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: body_style
attributes.description: Body style classification of the vehicles scheduled for production. Used for production line configuration, tooling setup, and capacity planning by body type.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Classification; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: build_sequence_end
attributes.description: Ending sequence number for the JIS (Just-in-Sequence) build order within this schedule period. Together with build_sequence_start defines the range of vehicle sequence numbers assigned to this schedule.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; JIS Standard; SAP S/4HANA PP Sequencing

attributes.name: build_sequence_start
attributes.description: Starting sequence number for the JIS (Just-in-Sequence) build order within this schedule period. Used by MES and AGV systems to sequence vehicle bodies through the production line in the correct order.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; JIS Standard; SAP S/4HANA PP Sequencing

attributes.name: build_type
attributes.description: Classification of the production build type. 'standard' = full series production; 'ckd' = Completely Knocked Down (CKD) kit assembly; 'skd' = Semi Knocked Down (SKD) assembly; 'pilot' = pre-production pilot build; 'pre_series' = pre-series validation build.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; APQP Phase 4-5; IATF 16949

attributes.name: calloff_transmission_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when supplier delivery call-offs were transmitted to the supply base for this production schedule. Used for OTD (On-Time Delivery) tracking and supplier performance measurement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Scheduling Agreement; IATF 16949 Clause 8.4; JIT Standard

attributes.name: capacity_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Planned capacity utilization percentage for this schedule period, calculated as (confirmed_quantity × takt_time) / available_capacity_hours × 100. Stored as a planning input from the source system leveling, not a derived KPI.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Capacity Leveling; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: confirmed_quantity
attributes.description: Number of vehicles confirmed for production after capacity leveling, constraint resolution, and production planning approval. May differ from planned_quantity due to capacity constraints or material availability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Capacity Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this production schedule record was first created in the system, either by an MRP run or manual entry. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: Official End of Production (EOP) date for the vehicle model/model year. Schedules beyond this date are invalid. Used for phase-out planning, last-time-buy procurement, and regulatory deregistration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; NHTSA Homologation

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month number 1-12 or 1-16 for special periods) within the fiscal year. Enables alignment of production volumes with financial reporting periods for management accounting and EBITDA analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Fiscal Period; GAAP/IFRS

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year (FY) to which this production schedule belongs. Used for financial planning, CapEx allocation, and EBITDA reporting alignment between production volumes and financial periods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-CO Fiscal Year; GAAP/IFRS Financial Reporting

attributes.name: freeze_horizon_date
attributes.description: Date up to which the production schedule is frozen and cannot be changed without formal change control. Protects supplier call-offs and JIT/JIS delivery commitments within the frozen window.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Planning Time Fence; IATF 16949 Clause 8.4; JIT/JIS Standard

attributes.name: is_frozen
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this schedule record is currently within the freeze horizon and locked against changes. True = frozen (no modifications allowed without change control); False = open for revision.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Planning Time Fence; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this production schedule record. Updated on every revision, status change, or quantity adjustment. Essential for incremental data loading in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The automotive model year (MY) designation for the vehicles being scheduled. Used for regulatory compliance (CAFE, EPA), BOM versioning, and sales planning. Typically one year ahead of the calendar year for SOP planning.
attributes.references: NHTSA FMVSS; EPA CAFE Standards; SAE International MY Definition

attributes.name: planned_quantity
attributes.description: Total number of vehicles planned for production in this schedule period as determined by the MRP run. Represents the gross requirement before capacity and constraint adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP-MRP Planned Order Quantity; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain technology classification for the vehicles in this schedule. ICE = Internal Combustion Engine; HEV = Hybrid Electric Vehicle; PHEV = Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle; EV = Battery Electric Vehicle; FCEV = Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle. Drives regulatory reporting (CAFE, EPA, CARB) and BOM variant selection.
attributes.references: EPA CAFE Standards; CARB ZEV Mandate; NHTSA FMVSS; SAE J1711

attributes.name: regulatory_market
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the primary regulatory market for which these vehicles are being produced. Determines applicable homologation standards (NHTSA/FMVSS for USA, UNECE for Europe, etc.), emissions certification (EPA, CARB, Euro 6), and CAFE compliance tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: USA|CAN|MEX|DEU|GBR|CHN|JPN|KOR|AUS|BRA — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NHTSA FMVSS; EPA Emissions Standards; UNECE Vehicle Regulations; CARB; ISO 3166-1

attributes.name: schedule_change_reason
attributes.description: Business reason code or description for the most recent schedule revision. Examples: material shortage, capacity constraint, demand change, quality hold, tooling failure, model mix adjustment. Required for change control audit trail per IATF 16949.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 (Document Control); SAP S/4HANA PP Change Management

attributes.name: schedule_date
attributes.description: The principal planned production date (or start date of the weekly/monthly bucket) for this schedule record. Represents the real-world business event date when production is planned to occur.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Planned Order; IATF 16949

attributes.name: schedule_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the production schedule period. For daily schedules this equals schedule_date; for weekly/monthly buckets this marks the last day of the planning period.

attributes.name: schedule_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for production planners to record contextual notes, exceptions, or special instructions associated with this schedule record. Examples: tooling changeover notes, quality hold references, special customer order constraints.

attributes.name: schedule_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the production schedule record, sourced from the source system Planning). Used for cross-system reference and communication with supply chain and manufacturing teams.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the production schedule record. 'draft' = initial planning; 'released' = approved for execution; 'frozen' = within freeze horizon, no changes allowed; 'in_execution' = active shop floor production; 'completed' = all planned units built; 'cancelled' = schedule voided.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Time granularity of the production schedule record. 'daily' = day-level MPS; 'weekly' = weekly bucket plan; 'monthly' = monthly capacity plan. Determines the planning horizon and supplier call-off frequency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP-MRP Planning Horizon; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: schedule_version
attributes.description: Incremental version number of the production schedule. Each MRP (Material Requirements Planning) run or manual revision increments this counter, enabling version comparison and rollback analysis.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when production is scheduled to complete for this schedule record. Used for shift planning, takt time validation, and downstream logistics coordination.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Order Scheduling; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: scheduled_start_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when production is scheduled to begin on the line for this schedule record. Used for JIS (Just-in-Sequence) sequencing, AGV routing, and supplier call-off timing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Work Order Scheduling; Apriso/Dassault MES; JIS Standard

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: Shift configuration planned for this production schedule period. Determines available production hours and workforce requirements. Single = 1 shift/day; Double = 2 shifts/day; Triple = 3 shifts/day; Weekend = weekend-only production.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Capacity Planning; SuccessFactors Workforce Planning

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: Official Start of Production (SOP) date for the vehicle model/model year being scheduled. Marks the formal launch of series production. Used to validate that schedule dates fall within the active production window.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Siemens Teamcenter PLM Program Management; APQP Phase 5

attributes.name: supplier_calloff_generated
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether supplier delivery call-offs (JIT/JIS delivery schedules) have been generated and transmitted to suppliers based on this production schedule. True = call-offs sent; False = pending call-off generation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Scheduling Agreement; JIT/JIS Standard; IATF 16949 Clause 8.4

attributes.name: takt_time_seconds
attributes.description: Planned takt time in seconds per vehicle unit for this production schedule. Takt time = available production time divided by customer demand rate. Drives line balancing, AGV pacing, and JIS sequencing intervals.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Rate Routing; Apriso/Dassault MES; SAE Manufacturing Standards

products.name: shift
products.description: Reference master for production shift definitions at each plant and production line. Captures shift code, shift name (Day, Afternoon, Night, Weekend), planned start and end times, break schedule, planned production hours, and applicable plant and line assignments. Used for production order scheduling, OEE calculation, and workforce planning integration.
products.reference: SAP PP Shift Definition / Apriso MES Shift Master

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each shift definition record in the manufacturing plant reference master.

attributes.name: factory_calendar_id
attributes.description: the source system identifier governing public holidays and non-working days applicable to this shift definition (e.g., US01, DE01). Ensures production scheduling excludes statutory holidays.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Factory Calendar; ISO 8601 – Date and Time Standards

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant at which this shift definition applies. Used to scope shift schedules to specific production facilities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Work Center / Plant Assignment

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production line (e.g., stamping, body shop, paint, final assembly) to which this shift definition is assigned. Enables line-level OEE and scheduling.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Shop Floor Line Configuration; SAP S/4HANA PP – Work Center

attributes.name: agv_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) operations are active during this shift. Used for shop floor automation scheduling and safety protocol management in MES and SCADA integrations.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – AGV Integration; SAE International – Automated Manufacturing Safety

attributes.name: break_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total scheduled break time in minutes for the shift (e.g., 30 minutes for a single meal break, 50 minutes for two breaks). Used to reconcile gross shift hours against planned production hours.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Break Schedule; DOT – Hours of Service Regulations

attributes.name: break_schedule
attributes.description: Textual description of the break schedule for the shift, including break times and durations (e.g., '10:00–10:15 AM rest break; 12:30–13:00 PM meal break'). Supports workforce planning and ergonomic compliance documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Break Schedule; DOT – Occupational Health and Safety

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the shift definition within the plant (e.g., DAY1, AFT2, NGT3, WKD1). Used as the business key in the source system MES integrations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Shift Definition; Apriso/Dassault MES – Shift Master

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shift definition record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and IATF 16949 document control compliance.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 – Document Control; ISO 9001 – Quality Records

attributes.name: day_of_week_mask
attributes.description: Seven-character binary string (Mon–Sun) indicating which days of the week this shift runs (e.g., '1111100' = Monday to Friday, '0000011' = Saturday and Sunday). Used by MES and the source system automated shift calendar generation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Factory Calendar; Apriso/Dassault MES – Shift Calendar

attributes.name: shift_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context about the shift definition, including special operating conditions, seasonal variations, or programme-specific notes (e.g., 'Reduced capacity shift during model year changeover').
attributes.references: IATF 16949 – Document Control; SAP S/4HANA PP – Shift Master

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date from which this shift definition becomes valid and available for production scheduling. Supports versioned shift master management and seasonal schedule changes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Shift Validity Period; IATF 16949 – Document Control

attributes.name: energy_consumption_target_kwh
attributes.description: Planned energy consumption target in kilowatt-hours for the shift. Used for energy efficiency monitoring, ISO 14001 environmental reporting, and CAFE/EPA compliance cost tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 – Environmental Management; EPA – Energy Efficiency Standards; CARB

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: End of Production (EOP) date associated with this shift definition, indicating when the shift schedule is retired for a vehicle programme. Null if no planned end. Used for production wind-down planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – EOP Planning; Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Programme Milestones

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date after which this shift definition is no longer valid for production scheduling. Null indicates an open-ended shift definition with no planned end. Supports model year changeovers and SOP/EOP transitions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Shift Validity Period; IATF 16949 – Document Control

attributes.name: gross_shift_hours
attributes.description: Total clock hours from shift start to shift end including all breaks and non-production time (e.g., 8.0 hours). Used to distinguish gross capacity from net available production time.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Shift Duration; ISO 9001 – Production Capacity Records

attributes.name: handover_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Planned duration in minutes allocated for shift handover activities between outgoing and incoming crews (e.g., 15 minutes). Included in shift scheduling to ensure continuity of production and quality checks.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Shift Handover; IATF 16949 – Production Continuity

attributes.name: is_template
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift record is a reusable template definition (True) rather than a plant/line-specific instantiation (False). Templates are used to standardise shift configurations across multiple plants and lines.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Shift Template; Apriso/Dassault MES – Shift Master

attributes.name: mes_shift_code
attributes.description: Native shift identifier in the Apriso/Dassault MES system used for shop floor execution and traceability. Enables cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the MES source of record.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Shift Master; IATF 16949 – Traceability Requirements

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Automotive model year (MY) for which this shift definition is applicable (e.g., 2025). Aligns shift scheduling with SOP (Start of Production) and EOP (End of Production) milestones for specific vehicle programmes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Model Year Planning; NHTSA – Vehicle Model Year Definitions

attributes.name: shift_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the shift (e.g., Day Shift, Afternoon Shift, Night Shift, Weekend Shift). Used in production scheduling dashboards, workforce planning reports, and OEE calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Shift Definition; SuccessFactors – Workforce Planning

attributes.name: number_of_breaks
attributes.description: Count of distinct scheduled break periods within the shift (e.g., 2 for a morning rest break and a meal break). Used in ergonomic compliance reporting and workforce scheduling.
attributes.references: DOT – Occupational Health and Safety; IATF 16949 – Workforce Management

attributes.name: oee_target_percent
attributes.description: Target OEE percentage for this shift, representing the combined availability, performance, and quality targets (e.g., 85.00%). Used as the benchmark for shift-level OEE reporting and continuous improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 – OEE Measurement; SAE International – Manufacturing Efficiency Standards

attributes.name: overtime_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift definition is classified as an overtime shift, triggering premium pay calculations and overtime reporting in the source system SuccessFactors payroll.
attributes.references: SuccessFactors – Time and Attendance; SAP S/4HANA HCM – Payroll

attributes.name: pattern_code
attributes.description: Code referencing the rotating shift pattern or schedule template to which this shift belongs (e.g., 3SHIFT_ROTATING, 2SHIFT_FIXED, CONTINENTAL). Used for workforce rostering and long-term capacity planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Shift Pattern; SuccessFactors – Work Schedule

attributes.name: planned_end_time
attributes.description: Planned clock time at which the shift ends production activities. Combined with planned_start_time to derive gross shift duration for capacity and OEE calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Shift Time Profile; Apriso/Dassault MES – Shift Schedule

attributes.name: planned_production_hours
attributes.description: Net planned production hours for the shift after deducting all scheduled breaks and non-production time (e.g., 7.5 hours for an 8-hour shift with 30-minute break). Core input for OEE denominator and capacity planning in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Available Capacity; IATF 16949 – OEE Measurement

attributes.name: planned_start_time
attributes.description: Planned clock time at which the shift begins production activities (e.g., 2024-01-15T06:00:00.000+00:00). Used for production order scheduling, JIS sequencing, and workforce rostering.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Shift Time Profile; Apriso/Dassault MES – Shift Schedule

attributes.name: premium_pay_rate
attributes.description: Pay rate multiplier applied to base wages for this shift (e.g., 1.5000 for time-and-a-half overtime, 1.2500 for night shift differential). Used in payroll cost calculations and labour cost reporting. Classified confidential as it contains compensation data.
attributes.references: SuccessFactors – Payroll; SAP S/4HANA HCM – Wage Types; DOT – Fair Labour Standards

attributes.name: production_model
attributes.description: Shift operating model classification indicating the overall production schedule structure at the plant (e.g., single_shift, two_shift, three_shift, four_shift_continental). Drives capacity planning and workforce rostering strategy.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Capacity Planning; SAE International – Manufacturing Operations

attributes.name: quality_inspection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a mandatory quality inspection (e.g., PDI, SPC check, FMEA-driven inspection point) is required at the start or end of this shift. Drives the source system lot creation and MES quality gate activation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM – Inspection Planning; IATF 16949 – Quality Management; APQP

attributes.name: sap_shift_code
attributes.description: Shift identifier as defined in the source system module (Schicht). Used for production order scheduling, capacity planning, and cross-system reconciliation with the ERP source of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Shift Definition (Schicht); IATF 16949 – Production Planning

attributes.name: scada_zone_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Zone Code
attributes.description: Code identifying the SCADA monitoring zone associated with this shift definition. Used to correlate shift-level production data with real-time SCADA telemetry for process control and quality monitoring.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – SCADA Integration; IATF 16949 – Process Monitoring

tag_set.value: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Zone Code

attributes.name: sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of the shift within a 24-hour production cycle at the plant/line (e.g., 1 = first shift, 2 = second shift, 3 = third shift). Used for JIS sequencing and handover management.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Shift Sequencing; SAP S/4HANA PP – Shift Order

attributes.name: shift_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the shift definition. Active shifts are available for production order scheduling; inactive or suspended shifts are excluded from planning runs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Shift Validity; IATF 16949 – Production Planning Records

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift by its operational period. Drives workforce planning, premium pay calculations, and production capacity modelling. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: day|afternoon|night|weekend|overtime|shutdown — promote to reference product if additional types are required]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Shift Category; SuccessFactors – Time Management

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: Start of Production (SOP) date associated with this shift definition, indicating when the shift schedule becomes operational for a new vehicle programme or model year. Used for production ramp-up planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – SOP Planning; Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Programme Milestones

attributes.name: supervisor_role_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the required supervisor role classification for this shift (e.g., PROD_SUPV, AREA_LEAD). Used for workforce planning and shift handover accountability. References the HR role catalogue in SuccessFactors.
attributes.references: SuccessFactors – Job Role Catalogue; SAP S/4HANA HCM – Organisational Management

attributes.name: target_takt_time_seconds
attributes.description: Planned takt time in seconds per unit for this shift, calculated as net available production time divided by customer demand rate. Fundamental metric for line balancing and JIS sequencing in automotive assembly.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Takt Time; SAE International – Production Rate Standards

attributes.name: target_units_per_shift
attributes.description: Planned number of vehicle units (or assemblies) to be produced during this shift. Used as the production target for OEE performance ratio calculation and daily production reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Order Quantity; IATF 16949 – OEE Measurement

attributes.name: timezone_code
attributes.description: IANA timezone identifier for the plant location where this shift operates (e.g., America/Detroit, Europe/Berlin). Ensures accurate timestamp interpretation for global multi-plant production scheduling and reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 – Date and Time Standards; IANA Timezone Database

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this shift definition record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data lineage, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 – Document Control; ISO 9001 – Quality Records

attributes.name: workforce_headcount_target
attributes.description: Planned number of direct production workers required for this shift. Used for workforce planning, labour cost budgeting, and integration with SuccessFactors workforce scheduling.
attributes.references: SuccessFactors – Workforce Planning; SAP S/4HANA CO – Labour Cost Planning

products.name: downtime_event
products.description: Transactional record capturing unplanned and planned production downtime events at the work center or line level. Tracks downtime start and end timestamps, duration (minutes), downtime category (mechanical failure, tooling change, material shortage, quality hold, scheduled maintenance, changeover), affected work center, production order impact, and responsible team. Critical for OEE analysis and SCADA-integrated downtime reporting.

attributes.name: downtime_event_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each downtime event record in the manufacturing execution system. Primary key for the downtime_event data product.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 9.1 – Monitoring, Measurement, Analysis and Evaluation

attributes.name: downtime_equipment_equipment_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific machine, robot, AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle), or equipment asset that experienced the downtime. Maps to the source system master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Equipment Master; ISO 14224 – Equipment Taxonomy

attributes.name: downtime_equipment_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific machine, robot, AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle), or equipment asset that experienced the downtime. Maps to the source system master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Equipment Master; ISO 14224 – Equipment Taxonomy

attributes.name: oee_daily_snapshot_id
attributes.description: Links this event to the pre-aggregated daily OEE snapshot for OEE analytics.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance, production, or quality team responsible for resolving the downtime event. Used for accountability tracking and response time analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Work Center (Maintenance); IATF 16949 Section 7.1.2

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where the downtime event occurred. Corresponds to the the source system organizational unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Plant (Werk); IATF 16949 Section 4.3

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production line (e.g., stamping line, body shop line, paint line, final assembly line) affected by the downtime event. Enables line-level OEE and throughput impact analysis.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Production Line; SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Line

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the the source system Order (Fertigungsauftrag) that was active or impacted at the time of the downtime event. Used to quantify production order impact and schedule deviation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Order; IATF 16949 Section 8.5

attributes.name: reported_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee (operator, technician, or supervisor) who initially reported or logged the downtime event in the MES or the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Notification Reported By; SuccessFactors – Employee Master

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific work center or production cell where the downtime event was recorded. Maps to the source system Center (Arbeitsplatz) or MES work station definition. Critical for OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) analysis at the work center level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Work Center; Apriso MES – Work Center; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

attributes.name: affected_process_area
attributes.description: The manufacturing process area impacted by the downtime event. Reflects the major shop segments in automotive assembly: stamping (press shop), body shop (BIW - Body in White), paint shop, final assembly, powertrain assembly, chassis, trim, or general assembly. Used for plant-level downtime distribution analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stamping|body_shop|paint|final_assembly|powertrain|chassis|trim|general_assembly — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Process Area; IATF 16949 Section 8.5; SAP PP – Production Process

attributes.name: corrective_action_code
attributes.description: Standardized code from the the source system type catalog describing the corrective action taken to resolve the downtime event (e.g., part replacement, lubrication, calibration, software reset, tooling adjustment). Supports FMEA corrective action tracking and spare parts consumption analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Activity Type Code; IATF 16949 Section 10.2; AIAG 8D

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the downtime event record was first created in the source system (MES, the source system SCADA). Represents the audit creation time, distinct from start_timestamp which is the actual business event time. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 7.5 – Documented Information; SAP S/4HANA – Record Creation Timestamp

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the maintenance_cost_local field (e.g., USD, EUR, MXN, CNY). Required for multi-plant, multi-currency cost consolidation in global automotive manufacturing operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 – Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI – Currency Configuration

attributes.name: downtime_category
attributes.description: Primary classification of the downtime event type. 'mechanical_failure' covers equipment breakdowns; 'tooling_change' covers die/tool swap activities; 'material_shortage' covers JIT/JIS supply disruptions; 'quality_hold' covers production stops due to quality issues; 'scheduled_maintenance' covers planned PM activities; 'changeover' covers model or variant changeover activities. Drives OEE availability loss categorization.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 9.1 – OEE; SAP PM – Notification Type; ISO 22400-2 – KPI for Manufacturing

attributes.name: downtime_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the downtime event was planned (scheduled maintenance, changeover, tooling change per production schedule) or unplanned (unexpected breakdown, quality hold, material shortage). Critical for separating planned vs. unplanned OEE availability losses.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2 – Planned vs. Unplanned Downtime; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed duration of the downtime event in minutes, calculated as the difference between end_timestamp and start_timestamp. Stored as a business field for direct use in OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) availability calculations and SCADA-integrated downtime reporting. Null if the event has not yet ended.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2 – Downtime Duration; IATF 16949 Section 9.1; SAP PM – Breakdown Duration

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the downtime event ended and production resumed, as recorded by the MES or SCADA system. Null if the event is still active. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Downtime End; SCADA Event Log; ISO 22400-2

attributes.name: escalation_level
attributes.description: Indicates the management escalation level reached during the downtime event based on duration thresholds or safety/quality triggers. 'none' = resolved at operator level; 'supervisor' = shift supervisor notified; 'manager' = production manager engaged; 'plant_director' = plant director escalation triggered. Supports escalation SLA compliance reporting.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 5.3 – Organizational Roles; SAP PM – Notification Priority; Internal Escalation Matrix

attributes.name: event_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the downtime event started. Derived from start_timestamp for day-level partitioning, reporting, and trend analysis. Stored as a separate DATE field to support efficient date-range queries and daily OEE dashboard aggregations. Format: yyyy-MM-dd.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2 – Downtime Reporting; SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Date

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the downtime event as entered by the operator, technician, or supervisor in the MES or the source system Captures contextual details not covered by structured codes, such as observed symptoms, environmental conditions, or operator observations at the time of failure.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Notification Long Text; Apriso MES – Event Notes; IATF 16949 Section 10.2

attributes.name: event_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the downtime event, typically generated by the MES (Manufacturing Execution System) or the source system Maintenance) module. Format: DT-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}. Used for cross-system referencing and shop floor communication.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Downtime Event Reference; SAP PM Notification Number

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the downtime event record. 'open' indicates the event is active and unresolved; 'in_progress' indicates a repair or corrective action is underway; 'resolved' indicates the root cause has been addressed; 'closed' indicates the event is fully documented and closed; 'cancelled' indicates the event was logged in error.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Notification Status; Apriso MES – Downtime Status; IATF 16949 Section 10.2

attributes.name: failure_mode_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the specific failure mode that caused the downtime event, aligned with the FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) failure mode library. Examples: electrical fault, hydraulic leak, sensor failure, conveyor jam. Enables FMEA-driven root cause trending and PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) corrective action tracking.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 10.2 – FMEA; SAP PM – Damage Code; AIAG FMEA Reference Manual

attributes.name: fault_location_code
attributes.description: the source system part / location code identifying the specific component or sub-assembly on the equipment where the fault occurred (e.g., spindle, conveyor belt, welding gun tip, paint nozzle). Enables component-level failure frequency analysis and spare parts demand forecasting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Object Part Code; ISO 14224 – Equipment Taxonomy; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

attributes.name: is_quality_hold_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the downtime event triggered a quality hold on WIP (Work in Progress) or finished vehicle inventory. True = quality hold was activated; False = no quality hold. Links to the source system notification and SPC (Statistical Process Control) out-of-control action plans.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM – Quality Notification; IATF 16949 Section 8.6; SPC AIAG Reference Manual

attributes.name: is_repeat_failure
attributes.description: Indicates whether this downtime event is a recurrence of a previously recorded failure on the same equipment or work center within a defined lookback period (typically 30 days). True = repeat failure; False = first occurrence. Used to identify chronic equipment issues requiring escalated corrective action under IATF 16949 Section 10.2.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 10.2 – Nonconformity and Corrective Action; SAP PM – Recurring Breakdown

attributes.name: is_safety_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether the downtime event involved a safety incident, near-miss, or safety-critical equipment failure (e.g., AGV collision, robot safety stop, lockout/tagout activation). True = safety-related; False = non-safety. Triggers mandatory safety reporting and OSHA/DOT compliance escalation workflows.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910 – Machine Safety; DOT FMVSS; IATF 16949 Section 8.4.2

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the downtime event record was most recently modified in the source system, such as when resolution notes were added, status was updated, or cost data was posted. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail in the Silver layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 7.5 – Documented Information; Databricks Lakehouse – Delta Lake Change Data Capture

attributes.name: maintenance_cost_local
attributes.description: Total direct maintenance cost incurred to resolve the downtime event, including labor, spare parts, and external service costs, expressed in the plant's local currency. Sourced from the source system cost settlement. Used for cost-of-downtime analysis and CapEx vs. OpEx maintenance budget reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Actual Cost; SAP CO – Cost Center Accounting; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The vehicle model year (MY) of the production program running on the affected line at the time of the downtime event. Used to correlate downtime patterns with specific model year launches, SOP (Start of Production) ramp-up periods, and EOP (End of Production) transitions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Program; NHTSA MY Definition; Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Model Year

attributes.name: notification_number
attributes.description: The the source system (PM) notification number (Meldungsnummer) created in the source system formally record the maintenance request or breakdown notification associated with this downtime event. Enables traceability between the MES downtime record and the the source system order lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – PM Notification (IW21/IW22); IATF 16949 Section 7.1.3

attributes.name: oee_availability_loss_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of scheduled production time lost due to this downtime event, calculated as (duration_minutes / scheduled_production_time_minutes) × 100. Represents the availability loss component of the OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) metric for the affected work center during the event period. Stored as a business field for direct use in OEE dashboards.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2 – OEE Availability; IATF 16949 Section 9.1; SEMI E10 Standard

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: The powertrain type of the vehicle being produced at the time of the downtime event. ICE = Internal Combustion Engine, HEV = Hybrid Electric Vehicle, PHEV = Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle, EV = Electric Vehicle, FCEV = Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle. Used to analyze downtime patterns by powertrain technology, particularly relevant for EV/PHEV line ramp-up monitoring.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Material Classification; CAFE/EPA Powertrain Classification; UNECE Regulation

attributes.name: production_loss_units
attributes.description: Number of vehicle units or production units lost due to the downtime event, based on the planned production rate for the affected work center. Used to quantify the production order impact and schedule recovery requirements.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2 – Production Loss; SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Order Confirmation; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing the maintenance technician's description of the actions taken to resolve the downtime event and restore production. Complements corrective_action_code with detailed narrative. Stored in the Silver layer for use in AI/ML-based predictive maintenance model training.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Work Order Completion Text; IATF 16949 Section 10.2; AIAG 8D Step 5

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the confirmed root cause of the downtime event after investigation, aligned with the the source system code catalog. Distinct from failure_mode_code which captures the symptom; root_cause_code captures the underlying reason (e.g., inadequate lubrication, worn tooling, incorrect setup, supplier part defect).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Cause Code; IATF 16949 Section 10.2; AIAG 8D Problem Solving

attributes.name: scada_alarm_code
attributes.description: The alarm or fault code generated by the SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) or PLC (Programmable Logic Controller) system at the time the downtime event was triggered. Provides the raw machine-level signal that initiated the downtime record. Used for SCADA-integrated downtime reporting and automated event correlation.
attributes.references: IEC 62682 – Management of Alarm Systems; SCADA/PLC Event Log; Apriso MES – Machine Signal Integration

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: The production shift during which the downtime event occurred (e.g., shift_1 = day shift, shift_2 = afternoon shift, shift_3 = night shift, weekend = weekend shift). Used for shift-level OEE analysis and workforce accountability reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Shift Planning; Apriso MES – Shift Definition; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

attributes.name: spare_parts_consumed
attributes.description: Indicates whether spare parts or materials were consumed from inventory to resolve the downtime event. True = spare parts were issued via the source system issue; False = no parts consumed (e.g., adjustment or reset only). Drives spare parts demand planning and MRP (Material Requirements Planning) replenishment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Goods Issue; SAP PM – Material Consumption; MRP APICS Standard

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the downtime event began, as recorded by the MES or SCADA system. This is the principal real-world event time used for duration calculation and shift-level reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Downtime Start; SCADA Event Log; ISO 22400-2

attributes.name: time_to_repair_minutes
attributes.description: Elapsed time in minutes from when the maintenance team began active repair work to when the equipment was restored to operational status. Distinct from duration_minutes (total downtime) and time_to_respond_minutes (response lag). Core component of MTTR (Mean Time to Repair) KPI calculation.
attributes.references: ISO 22400-2 – MTTR; SAP PM – Repair Duration; IATF 16949 Section 9.1

attributes.name: time_to_respond_minutes
attributes.description: Elapsed time in minutes between the downtime event start_timestamp and the time the responsible maintenance or production team acknowledged and began responding to the event. Key metric for maintenance response SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance and MTTR (Mean Time to Repair) component analysis.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 9.1; SAP PM – Response Time; ISO 22400-2 – MTTR

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: The internal vehicle model or platform code (e.g., F-150, Silverado, Model 3 equivalent) being produced on the affected line at the time of the downtime event. Enables model-specific downtime analysis and supports PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) integration.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Vehicle Program Code; SAP S/4HANA PP – Material Master

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: The the source system work order number (Auftragsnummer) issued to address the downtime event. Distinct from the production order; this is the corrective or preventive maintenance order raised by the maintenance team in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM – Maintenance Order (IW31/IW32); IATF 16949 Section 8.5

products.name: production_bom
products.description: Manufacturing Bill of Materials (BOM) record representing the production-level BOM used on the shop floor for a specific vehicle configuration and model year. Distinct from the engineering BOM (eBOM) in the engineering domain — this is the manufacturing BOM (mBOM) as released to production. Captures BOM header (vehicle model, MY, plant, effectivity dates), BOM status, and reference to the engineering change order that authorized it. Managed via the source system Teamcenter PLM BOM transfer.
products.reference: SAP PP Manufacturing BOM (mBOM) / Teamcenter BOM Transfer

attributes.name: production_bom_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the manufacturing Bill of Materials (mBOM) record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP PP BOM Header (CS01/CS02); IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: component_bom_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Engineering Bill of Materials (eBOM) Reference ID
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this manufacturing BOM (mBOM) to the originating engineering BOM (eBOM) in Siemens Teamcenter PLM or PTC Windchill. Enables traceability from shop floor execution back to the engineering design intent. The eBOM-to-mBOM transformation is managed via the PLM-the source system
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – BOM Management; PTC Windchill EDM; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3

tag_set.value: Engineering Bill of Materials (eBOM) Reference ID

attributes.name: model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.model. Business justification: BOM Management Report requires each BOM to be tied to a vehicle model to ensure correct component list per model.

attributes.name: production_ebom_reference_bom_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Engineering Bill of Materials (eBOM) Reference ID
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this manufacturing BOM (mBOM) to the originating engineering BOM (eBOM) in Siemens Teamcenter PLM or PTC Windchill. Enables traceability from shop floor execution back to the engineering design intent. The eBOM-to-mBOM transformation is managed via the PLM-the source system
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – BOM Management; PTC Windchill EDM; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3

tag_set.value: Engineering Bill of Materials (eBOM) Reference ID

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this manufacturing BOM received formal approval from the designated authority. Precedes the release_date in the BOM lifecycle workflow. Required for IATF 16949 documented information control.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5; SAP PP Workflow; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or employee identifier of the approving authority (e.g., Chief Engineer, Manufacturing Manager) who approved this BOM for production release. Distinct from released_by — approval may be a separate workflow step in Teamcenter PLM or the source system
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.3.3 – Design and Development Outputs; SAP PP Workflow; ISO 9001 Clause 8.3

attributes.name: apqp_phase
attributes.description: Current APQP phase associated with this BOM's program lifecycle. Phase 1=Plan and Define, Phase 2=Product Design and Development, Phase 3=Process Design and Development, Phase 4=Product and Process Validation, Phase 5=Launch/Feedback. Tracks BOM maturity relative to the program development gate.
attributes.references: AIAG APQP 2nd Edition; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3; SAP PP Program Management

attributes.name: assembly_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle is assembled as a Completely Built Unit (CBU), Completely Knocked Down (CKD) kit for overseas assembly, or Semi Knocked Down (SKD) kit. Determines the BOM structure, component packaging, and applicable customs/import regulations for the target market.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Production Type; UNECE Vehicle Regulations; Customs Tariff Regulations

attributes.name: base_quantity
attributes.description: The base quantity of the header material for which the BOM component quantities are defined (e.g., 1 vehicle). All component quantities in the BOM are expressed relative to this base quantity. Corresponds to the the source system base quantity field.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Header Base Quantity; ISO 9001 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the BOM base quantity (e.g., 'EA' for each/vehicle, 'PC' for piece, 'SET' for set). Corresponds to the the source system base unit of measure. Ensures consistent quantity calculations during MRP explosion and production order processing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|PC|KG|L|M|M2|M3|SET — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Unit of Measure; ISO 80000-1 Quantities and Units

attributes.name: bom_alternative
attributes.description: the source system identifier (e.g., '01', '02') distinguishing multiple valid BOM configurations for the same material and plant. Supports variant BOMs for different production lines or regional configurations (e.g., LHD vs RHD, CKD vs SKD).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module – BOM Alternative; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: bom_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the manufacturing BOM, typically including the vehicle model, model year, plant, and key configuration attributes (e.g., '2025 F-150 XLT 3.5L EcoBoost AWD – Detroit Assembly Plant – MY2025 Production BOM'). Used for display in the source system, Teamcenter PLM, and reporting tools.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Header Description; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: bom_level
attributes.description: The maximum depth/level of the BOM hierarchy for this manufacturing BOM (e.g., 1 = single-level, 5 = five levels deep). Used to understand BOM complexity and to control multi-level BOM explosion in MRP and production scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Multi-Level BOM; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: bom_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the manufacturing BOM. 'draft' indicates the BOM is under engineering review. 'released' means it has been authorized for production use. 'frozen' indicates no further changes are permitted (e.g., during active production run). 'superseded' means a newer BOM version has replaced it. 'obsolete' means the BOM is no longer valid.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module – BOM Status; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; Siemens Teamcenter PLM BOM Management

attributes.name: bom_type
attributes.description: Classification of the BOM by its intended use in the manufacturing process. 'production' is the standard mBOM used on the shop floor. 'phantom' represents sub-assemblies that are not stocked. 'sales' is used for variant configuration. 'spare_parts' is for after-sales service. 'co_product' is for by-products in manufacturing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module – BOM Category; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: bom_usage
attributes.description: the source system indicator defining the organizational context in which the BOM is applied. 'production' (the source system is the standard for shop floor manufacturing. 'engineering' (the source system is for design/development. 'universal' (the source system applies across all usages. Determines which BOM is selected during MRP and production order processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Usage (T415); IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: bom_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the manufacturing BOM (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.3'). Incremented each time the BOM is revised through an approved Engineering Change Order. Enables version history tracking and rollback capability for quality investigations.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – BOM Versioning; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5; SAP PP BOM Change History

attributes.name: change_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the business reason for creating or modifying this BOM version (e.g., 'Cost reduction – substitute supplier for part X', 'Regulatory compliance – CARB Tier 3 emission update', 'Quality improvement – NVH fix per TSB-2024-001'). Required for IATF 16949 change control documentation.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.6 – Control of Changes; SAP PP Change Master; ISO 9001 Clause 8.5.6

attributes.name: component_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct component line items (BOM positions) in this manufacturing BOM. Provides a quick indicator of BOM complexity and is used for completeness validation during BOM release. Does not include phantom sub-assembly components.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Item Count; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this manufacturing BOM record was first created in the source system (the source system Teamcenter PLM). Represents the business event of BOM creation, not the ETL load time. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per enterprise data standards.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5; SAP PP BOM Header

attributes.name: eco_number
attributes.description: The Engineering Change Order (ECO) number that authorized the creation or last modification of this manufacturing BOM. Provides full traceability from the shop floor BOM back to the formal engineering change management process in Teamcenter PLM. Required for IATF 16949 change control compliance.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Engineering Change Management; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.6; SAP PP ECO Integration

attributes.name: effectivity_end_date
attributes.description: The date after which this manufacturing BOM version is no longer valid for production use. Corresponds to the the source system To' date. Null indicates the BOM is open-ended with no planned expiry. Used to manage BOM transitions during model year changeovers and End of Production (EOP).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Effectivity; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: effectivity_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this manufacturing BOM version becomes effective and valid for production use. Corresponds to the the source system From' date. Used for date-effective BOM explosion in MRP and production order creation. Aligns with Start of Production (SOP) planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Effectivity; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; SAE J1739

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: The planned or actual End of Production (EOP) date for the vehicle program associated with this BOM. Marks the milestone when serial production of this vehicle configuration ceases. Used for last-time-buy planning, spare parts provisioning, and regulatory compliance archiving.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; SAP PP Production Planning; APQP

attributes.name: homologation_status
attributes.description: Status of the regulatory homologation (type approval) for the vehicle configuration defined by this BOM in the target regulatory market. 'approved' is required before vehicles built to this BOM can be legally sold in the target market. Managed through the Regulatory Compliance and Homologation process.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 567 – Certification; UNECE WP.29 Type Approval; Euro NCAP; DOT FMVSS

attributes.name: is_configurable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BOM uses the source system (VC) to support multiple vehicle variants from a single configurable BOM structure. True = configurable BOM with characteristic-based component selection. False = fixed BOM for a single specific vehicle configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Variant Configuration (LO-VC); IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: is_phantom_assembly
attributes.description: Indicates whether the header material of this BOM is a phantom assembly — a logical grouping of components that is not physically stocked or produced as a discrete unit. Phantom assemblies are 'exploded through' during MRP and production order processing. Common for sub-assemblies in JIS manufacturing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Phantom Assembly (Special Procurement Key 50); IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this manufacturing BOM record in the source system. Used to detect changes during incremental data loads into the Databricks Silver Layer and to support BOM change history auditing required by IATF 16949.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; SAP PP BOM Change History; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: the source system of the header material (finished vehicle or major assembly) for which this BOM is defined. This is the top-level material in the BOM hierarchy, corresponding to the vehicle configuration or assembly unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM – Material Master (MM60); SAP PP BOM Header

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The four-digit automotive Model Year (MY) for which this manufacturing BOM is valid (e.g., 2025). Determines the applicable regulatory standards, feature content, and homologation requirements. Aligns with NHTSA and EPA model year definitions.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 – VIN; SAP PP Material Master; IATF 16949

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: the source system identifying the specific manufacturing facility where this mBOM is used for production (e.g., 'P001' for Detroit Assembly, 'P002' for Osaka Plant). Determines plant-specific routing, work centers, and local regulatory compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MM – Plant Master; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle powertrain technology for which this BOM is defined. ICE = Internal Combustion Engine, HEV = Hybrid Electric Vehicle, PHEV = Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle, BEV = Battery Electric Vehicle, FCEV = Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle. Determines applicable emissions regulations (EPA, CARB, WLTP) and BOM component sets.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 86 – Emissions Standards; CARB Title 13; CAFE Standards; SAE J1711

attributes.name: ppap_status
attributes.description: Status of the Production Part Approval Process (PPAP) for the components in this BOM. PPAP is the AIAG/IATF 16949 process that verifies supplier components meet design and specification requirements before production launch. 'approved' is required before the BOM can be released to production.
attributes.references: AIAG PPAP 4th Edition; IATF 16949 Clause 8.4.1; SAP QM – Quality Notifications

attributes.name: predecessor_bom_number
attributes.description: BOM number of the previous manufacturing BOM version that this BOM supersedes. Enables backward navigation in the BOM version chain for change impact analysis and quality investigations. Null for the initial BOM version.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Change History; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.6; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: production_line_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific production line or assembly line within the plant for which this BOM is configured (e.g., 'LINE-A', 'TRIM-CHASSIS-1'). Used in Apriso/Dassault MES for shop floor routing and JIS (Just-in-Sequence) scheduling.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES – Shop Floor Execution; SAP PP Work Center; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: regulatory_market_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the target regulatory market for which this BOM is homologated (e.g., 'US-FEDERAL', 'US-CARB', 'EU-EURO6', 'JP-JC08', 'CN-CHINA6'). Determines applicable emissions standards (EPA, CARB, Euro 6, WLTP), safety regulations (NHTSA FMVSS, UNECE), and CAFE compliance requirements.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR – FMVSS; EPA 40 CFR Part 86; CARB Title 13; Euro NCAP; UNECE WP.29; CAFE Standards

attributes.name: release_date
attributes.description: The date on which this manufacturing BOM was formally released to production (status changed to 'released'). Marks the point at which the BOM is authorized for use in production orders and MRP planning. Corresponds to the the source system date.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Release; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1; APQP Phase 4

attributes.name: released_by
attributes.description: User ID or employee identifier of the manufacturing engineer or release authority who formally released this BOM to production in the source system Teamcenter PLM. Required for audit trail and change control compliance under IATF 16949.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; SAP PP Authorization; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: revision_level
attributes.description: Alphanumeric revision level of the BOM (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'C' or '01', '02'). Used in conjunction with bom_version to track incremental changes within a version. Aligns with the source system level and Teamcenter PLM revision management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Revision; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: the source system linking this manufacturing BOM to the associated production routing (sequence of operations, work centers, and standard times). The BOM and routing together define the complete manufacturing recipe for the vehicle. Corresponds to the source system header (CA01).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Routing (CA01/CA02); IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: The planned or actual Start of Production (SOP) date for the vehicle program associated with this BOM. Marks the milestone when serial production begins using this BOM configuration. Critical for program management, supplier readiness, and PPAP completion tracking.
attributes.references: APQP Phase 4 – Product and Process Validation; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3; SAP PP Production Planning

attributes.name: superseded_by_bom_number
attributes.description: BOM number of the newer manufacturing BOM that has replaced this one (populated when bom_status = 'superseded'). Enables forward navigation in the BOM version chain for traceability and historical analysis. Null when this is the current active BOM.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – BOM Change History; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.6; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: vehicle_configuration_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific vehicle configuration (variant) for which this BOM is defined, including body style, drivetrain, trim level, and market variant (e.g., 'SUV-AWD-PREMIUM-NA'). Used in the source system (VC) to select the correct BOM components for a specific vehicle order.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP – Variant Configuration; Dassault ENOVIA Configuration Management; IATF 16949

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Internal OEM code identifying the vehicle model (nameplate) for which this mBOM is defined (e.g., 'F150', 'RAV4', 'MODEL3'). Used to associate the BOM with the correct vehicle program in PLM and the source system.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Product Structure; SAP PP Material Master

products.name: manufacturing_bom_component
products.description: Line-item record within a manufacturing BOM representing a single component or sub-assembly required to build a vehicle. Captures component part number, description, quantity per vehicle, unit of measure, installation work center, installation sequence, alternative part references, effectivity start/end dates, and scrap factor. Supports JIT/JIS material call-offs and shop floor assembly instructions.
products.reference: SAP PP BOM Item / Teamcenter BOM Line

attributes.name: manufacturing_bom_component_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a single line-item record within a manufacturing Bill of Materials (BOM). Serves as the primary key for this entity in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Module; Siemens Teamcenter PLM BOM Management

attributes.name: engineering_bom_component_id
attributes.description: SSOT reference to engineering.engineering_bom_component (cross-domain duplicate reconciliation; engineering designated SSOT owner for bom_component).

attributes.name: model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.model. Business justification: Component Specification Process tracks components per vehicle model, enabling model‑specific quality and cost analysis.

attributes.name: part_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.part_master. Business justification: BOM components need a direct link to part_master for detailed specs; part_number/description are denormalized and will be removed.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant or assembly facility where this BOM component is consumed. Determines plant-specific BOM validity and material availability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Organizational Structure; IATF 16949

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the preferred or primary approved supplier for this component. Used in MRP source determination and JIT call-off scheduling to identify the default supply source.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Source List; PTC Windchill Supplier Collaboration; JIT
