attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Order

attributes.name: nominal_value
attributes.description: The engineering-specified nominal or target value for this process parameter as defined in the control plan. Used as the centre line for SPC charting and deviation calculation.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG APQP Manual; AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition

attributes.name: non_conformance_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the Non-Conformance Report (NCR) raised in the quality management system (the source system this parameter reading resulted in a fail disposition. Null when pass_fail_status is 'pass'.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.7 — Control of Nonconforming Outputs; SAP S/4HANA QM Module

attributes.name: parameter_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the specific process parameter definition (e.g., WELD_CURR_01, TORQUE_BOLT_A, PAINT_FILM_T). Sourced from the PLC/SCADA parameter catalogue in Apriso MES.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; SAE J4001 — Manufacturing Process Audit

attributes.name: parameter_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the process parameter being measured (e.g., 'Weld Current', 'Torque Value', 'Paint Film Thickness', 'Oven Temperature', 'Press Force', 'Adhesive Bead Width').

attributes.name: parameter_type
attributes.description: Classification of the process parameter by its physical or process nature. Drives SPC charting rules and control limit interpretation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weld_current|weld_time|torque|paint_film_thickness|oven_temperature|press_force|adhesive_bead_width|coolant_pressure|cure_time|voltage|current|speed|flow_rate|humidity — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Result of the automated conformance check comparing the measured value against the specification limits. 'pass' = within LSL/USL; 'fail' = outside LSL/USL; 'warning' = within spec but outside UCL/LCL (statistically out of control); 'rework_required' = fail with rework disposition; 'inconclusive' = sensor error or missing reference limits.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.6

attributes.name: plc_tag_code
attributes.description: Unique tag identifier from the Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) or SCADA system that is the source of this parameter reading. Enables traceability back to the originating control system data point.
attributes.references: IEC 61131-3 — PLC Programming Standards; SCADA System Integration

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain type of the vehicle being built: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), or FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Certain process parameters (e.g., battery cell compression) are powertrain-specific.
attributes.references: SAE J1715 — Hybrid Electric Vehicle Terminology; IATF 16949:2016

attributes.name: reaction_plan_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether the control plan reaction plan was triggered as a result of this parameter reading (True = reaction plan activated due to out-of-spec or out-of-control condition). Supports IATF 16949 audit evidence.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG APQP Manual — Control Plan Reaction Plan

attributes.name: reading_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when the process parameter value was measured by the PLC/SCADA system. This is the principal business event timestamp for this record, representing the real-world moment of measurement.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this process parameter record was first ingested into the data platform (silver layer). Distinct from reading_timestamp which represents the actual measurement event time.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 — Date and Time Formats; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this process parameter record in the data platform. Used for incremental load tracking and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: ISO 8601 — Date and Time Formats; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information

attributes.name: sample_number
attributes.description: Sequential sample number within the SPC subgroup or sampling plan for this parameter at this work center. Used to construct X-bar/R charts and other SPC control charts.
attributes.references: AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: scada_system_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) System ID
attributes.description: Identifier of the SCADA system instance that collected and transmitted this process parameter reading to the MES/data platform.
attributes.references: IEC 62443 — Industrial Automation and Control Systems Security; Apriso/Dassault MES Integration

tag_set.value: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) System ID

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the production shift during which this parameter reading was captured (e.g., 'SHIFT_A', 'SHIFT_B', 'SHIFT_C'). Supports shift-level SPC analysis and quality reporting.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; SAP S/4HANA PP — Shift Planning

attributes.name: spc_rule_violated
attributes.description: Identifies the specific SPC detection rule that was violated when is_out_of_control is True (e.g., 'RULE_1_BEYOND_3SIGMA', 'RULE_2_NINE_CONSECUTIVE', 'RULE_3_SIX_TRENDING'). Null when no rule is violated.
attributes.references: AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition — Western Electric Rules; ISO 7870-2

attributes.name: subgroup_number
attributes.description: Identifier of the SPC rational subgroup to which this reading belongs. Subgroups are used to calculate control limits and assess process variation in X-bar/R or X-bar/S charts.
attributes.references: AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition — Rational Subgrouping; ISO 7870-2

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Engineering unit of measure for the measured value (e.g., 'A' for amperes, 'Nm' for Newton-metres, 'µm' for micrometres, '°C' for Celsius, 'kN' for kilonewtons, 'mm' for millimetres, 'ms' for milliseconds). Follows SI unit conventions.
attributes.references: ISO 80000-1 — Quantities and Units; AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition

attributes.name: upper_control_limit
attributes.description: Statistical Upper Control Limit (UCL) for this process parameter as defined by SPC methodology. Readings above this value indicate the process is out of statistical control.
attributes.references: AIAG SPC Manual 2nd Edition; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; ISO 7870-2 — Control Charts

attributes.name: upper_spec_limit
attributes.description: Engineering Upper Specification Limit (USL) for this process parameter as defined in the control plan or engineering drawing. Readings above USL result in a non-conformance. Distinct from UCL which is a statistical control boundary.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; AIAG APQP Manual; ISO 9001:2015 Clause 8.6

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Internal vehicle model or platform code for the vehicle being built (e.g., 'F150', 'RAV4', 'MODEL_3'). Supports model-level process capability analysis and SPC stratification.
attributes.references: IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.1; SAP S/4HANA PP — Material Master

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) of the vehicle being processed at the time of this parameter reading. Enables full build traceability from process parameter to finished vehicle per NHTSA requirements.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 — VIN Requirements; IATF 16949:2016 Clause 8.5.2

products.name: agv_movement
products.description: Transactional record capturing Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) movement events on the shop floor. Tracks AGV unit ID, movement type (load, transport, unload, charge, idle), origin location, destination location, carried load (part number, VIN, carrier ID), movement start and end timestamps, route taken, and any fault or exception codes. Supports real-time material flow visibility and AGV fleet utilization reporting.
products.reference: AGV Fleet Management System / Apriso MES Material Flow

attributes.name: agv_movement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each AGV movement event record on the shop floor. Primary key for the agv_movement data product.

attributes.name: agv_employee_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the shop floor operator or MES user who manually initiated, overrode, or acknowledged this AGV movement task. Null for fully automated movements with no human intervention. Supports operator accountability and manual override tracking.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution; IATF 16949 — Traceability

attributes.name: agv_operator_employee_id
attributes.description: The identifier of the shop floor operator or MES user who manually initiated, overrode, or acknowledged this AGV movement task. Null for fully automated movements with no human intervention. Supports operator accountability and manual override tracking.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution; IATF 16949 — Traceability

attributes.name: agv_route_id
attributes.description: The predefined route identifier assigned to this movement by the AGV fleet management system. Routes define the physical path the AGV follows on the shop floor. Used for route utilization analysis, congestion detection, and route optimization.
attributes.references: Geotab/Bosch IoT — Fleet Management; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this AGV movement occurred. Links to the plant master for facility-level reporting and fleet utilization analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM — Plant Maintenance; IATF 16949

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production shift during which this AGV movement occurred. Enables shift-level fleet utilization reporting, throughput analysis, and comparison of AGV performance across shifts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Shift Management; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center or production zone where the AGV movement was initiated or completed. Supports work center-level material flow analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Work Center; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: agv_controller_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the AGV fleet management controller or traffic management system (e.g., a specific SCADA or AGV supervisor node) that dispatched and managed this movement. Supports multi-controller fleet architectures and fault isolation.
attributes.references: SCADA — Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition; Geotab/Bosch IoT Fleet Management

attributes.name: agv_unit_code
attributes.description: The unique physical identifier assigned to the AGV unit performing the movement. Used for fleet management, maintenance scheduling, and utilization tracking per individual vehicle.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — AGV Integration; Geotab/Bosch IoT Fleet Management

attributes.name: assembly_stage
attributes.description: The manufacturing assembly stage to which this AGV movement is associated (e.g., stamping, body shop, paint, trim, chassis, final assembly). Enables stage-level material flow analysis and supports multi-stage production traceability.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution; IATF 16949

attributes.name: average_speed_mps
attributes.description: The average travel speed of the AGV in metres per second during this movement. Used to identify speed anomalies, assess compliance with shop floor speed limits, and support throughput optimization.
attributes.references: Geotab/Bosch IoT — Fleet Management; SAE International AGV Safety Standards

attributes.name: battery_level_end_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: AGV Battery Level at Movement End (Percentage)
attributes.description: The AGV battery state of charge as a percentage at the time the movement task ended. Combined with battery_level_start_pct to calculate energy consumption per movement and model battery degradation over time.
attributes.references: Geotab/Bosch IoT — Fleet Management; SAE J1772

tag_set.value: AGV Battery Level at Movement End (Percentage)

attributes.name: battery_level_start_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: AGV Battery Level at Movement Start (Percentage)
attributes.description: The AGV battery state of charge as a percentage at the time the movement task began. Used for fleet energy management, charge scheduling optimization, and identifying movements that may have been impacted by low battery conditions.
attributes.references: Geotab/Bosch IoT — Fleet Management; SAE J1772 (EV Charging Standards)

tag_set.value: AGV Battery Level at Movement Start (Percentage)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this AGV movement record was first created in the MES or data platform. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: destination_location_code
attributes.description: The shop floor location code of the target delivery point for this AGV movement. Used to verify correct delivery to the intended assembly station or buffer zone and to support JIS (Just-in-Sequence) call-off validation.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Layout; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: destination_location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the destination location (e.g., 'Final Assembly Line 2 Station 14', 'Trim Shop Sequencing Buffer'). Supports operational dashboards and exception reporting.

attributes.name: distance_travelled_m
attributes.description: The total distance in metres travelled by the AGV during this movement event, as reported by the AGV's odometry or navigation system. Used for fleet utilization reporting, energy consumption modelling, and route efficiency analysis.
attributes.references: Geotab/Bosch IoT — Fleet Management; SAE International

attributes.name: fault_code
attributes.description: The fault or exception code reported by the AGV or fleet controller during this movement (e.g., obstacle detected, navigation error, battery low, load sensor failure). Null if no fault occurred. Used for predictive maintenance, FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis), and fleet reliability reporting.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Quality Control; SAP S/4HANA PM — Plant Maintenance; IATF 16949

attributes.name: fault_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the fault or exception that occurred during this movement. Provides operational context for maintenance technicians and MES operators beyond the structured fault_code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM — Maintenance Notification; IATF 16949

attributes.name: fault_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the fault or exception was detected during this AGV movement. Null if no fault occurred. Used for mean time between failures (MTBF) calculation and maintenance response time analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM — Plant Maintenance; IATF 16949; ISO 9001

attributes.name: is_manual_override
attributes.description: Indicates whether this AGV movement was manually overridden or initiated by a human operator rather than being fully automated by the MES or AGV fleet controller (True = manual override, False = fully automated). Used for automation rate reporting and exception analysis.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution; IATF 16949

attributes.name: jis_call_off_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this AGV movement was triggered by a JIS (Just-in-Sequence) call-off signal from the assembly line (True = JIS-triggered, False = standard replenishment or non-sequenced movement). Critical for sequencing compliance reporting and line-feed performance analysis.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — JIS Execution; SAP S/4HANA PP-JIS

attributes.name: load_weight_kg
attributes.description: The weight in kilograms of the load carried by the AGV during this movement, as measured by the AGV's onboard load sensor. Used for payload compliance monitoring, energy consumption analysis, and overload fault detection.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution; SAE International

attributes.name: mes_task_code
attributes.description: The unique task or dispatch identifier assigned by the MES (Manufacturing Execution System) — specifically Apriso/Dassault — to this AGV movement instruction. Used for cross-system reconciliation between the AGV fleet controller and the MES shop floor execution layer.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution; SAP S/4HANA PP-MES Integration

attributes.name: movement_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the AGV completed or terminated the movement task. Null if the movement is still in progress. Used with movement_start_timestamp to derive actual cycle time.

attributes.name: movement_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when the AGV began executing the movement task. Used for cycle time calculation, throughput analysis, and JIS (Just-in-Sequence) compliance verification.

attributes.name: movement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the AGV movement event. Tracks whether the movement is actively executing, successfully completed, aborted due to an obstacle, faulted due to a system error, or cancelled by the MES scheduler.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution; IATF 16949

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the AGV movement event: load (picking up a carrier/part), transport (moving between locations), unload (depositing a carrier/part), charge (returning to charging station), idle (stationary with no task), fault (movement interrupted by exception).
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution; SAE International AGV Standards

attributes.name: origin_location_code
attributes.description: The shop floor location code (e.g., storage lane, buffer zone, work station address) from which the AGV departed for this movement. Encoded per the plant's internal location addressing scheme (e.g., aisle-bay-level). Used for material flow mapping and route optimization.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Layout; SAP S/4HANA WM — Warehouse Management

attributes.name: origin_location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the origin location (e.g., 'Body Shop Buffer Lane 3', 'Paint Shop Entry Conveyor', 'Stamping Parts Supermarket'). Supports operational reporting and shop floor visualization dashboards.

attributes.name: part_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the part or component being transported (e.g., 'Front Door Inner Panel LH', 'Battery Module Assembly EV'). Supports operational reporting without requiring a join to the parts master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Master; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: The OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) part number of the primary component or assembly being transported by the AGV. Supports Bill of Materials (BOM) traceability and JIS (Just-in-Sequence) delivery verification at the assembly line.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Master; Siemens Teamcenter PLM — BOM Management

attributes.name: planned_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The MES-scheduled completion time for this AGV movement task. Compared against movement_end_timestamp to measure on-time delivery performance and identify bottlenecks in material flow.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Scheduling; SAP S/4HANA PP-MRP

attributes.name: planned_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The MES-scheduled start time for this AGV movement task. Compared against movement_start_timestamp to measure schedule adherence and identify JIS (Just-in-Sequence) delivery deviations.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Scheduling; SAP S/4HANA PP-MRP

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: The dispatch priority assigned to this AGV movement by the MES or AGV fleet controller. Critical and high priority movements are typically associated with JIS (Just-in-Sequence) call-offs or line-stop prevention. Used for queue management and SLA reporting.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Scheduling; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: quantity_transported
attributes.description: The number of parts, units, or assemblies carried by the AGV in this movement. Used for material flow volume reporting, inventory reconciliation, and JIT (Just-in-Time) delivery quantity verification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Goods Movement; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: route_deviation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the AGV deviated from its assigned route during this movement (True = deviation occurred, False = route followed as planned). Deviations may indicate obstacles, dynamic re-routing, or system faults requiring investigation.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution; IATF 16949

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the originating operational system that generated this AGV movement record (e.g., Apriso MES instance ID, Bosch IoT AGV controller node). Supports data lineage, multi-system reconciliation, and Silver layer provenance tracking in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES; Geotab/Bosch IoT; IATF 16949 — Traceability

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this AGV movement record was last modified, such as when a fault code was appended or movement status was updated to completed. Supports incremental data processing in the Databricks Silver layer.

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: The 17-character Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) of the vehicle being built when this AGV movement is directly associated with a specific vehicle build (e.g., transporting a body-in-white or sequenced component). Null for non-vehicle-specific movements such as bulk part replenishment. Enables build traceability per NHTSA requirements.
attributes.references: NHTSA — VIN Standard 49 CFR Part 565; ISO 3779

products.name: capacity_plan
products.description: Master record for plant and line capacity planning, capturing planned production capacity by plant, production line, shift pattern, and planning period (weekly/monthly). Includes rated capacity (JPH × available hours), demonstrated capacity, capacity utilization percentage, bottleneck work center, planned overtime hours, and capacity plan version. Supports S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) and capital investment decisions.

attributes.name: capacity_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each capacity plan record in the manufacturing domain. Primary key for the capacity_plan data product.

attributes.name: bottleneck_work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center identified as the capacity bottleneck constraining overall line throughput during this planning period. Used to prioritize capacity improvement investments and focus S&OP constraint management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Bottleneck Work Center (CM21); Theory of Constraints; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: capacity_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing or industrial engineering employee responsible for maintaining and updating this capacity plan. Supports accountability tracking in S&OP governance.

attributes.name: capacity_plan_owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing or industrial engineering employee responsible for maintaining and updating this capacity plan. Supports accountability tracking in S&OP governance.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant for which this capacity plan is defined. Links to the manufacturing.plant master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Work Center / Plant; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production line (e.g., final assembly line, body shop line, paint line) within the plant for which capacity is being planned. Links to the manufacturing.work_center or production line master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Line; Apriso/Dassault MES — Line Configuration

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Reference to the shift pattern (e.g., 1-shift, 2-shift, 3-shift) applied in this capacity plan. Shift pattern determines available production hours and directly impacts rated capacity calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Shift Definition; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: vehicle_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.vehicle_program. Business justification: Capacity planning aligns plant capacity with each vehicle program; capacity_plan needs vehicle_program reference.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the capacity plan was formally approved by the designated authority. Marks the transition from 'submitted' to 'approved' status in the S&OP governance process.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 5.3; SAP S/4HANA PP — Approval Workflow

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the S&OP or manufacturing leadership authority who approved this capacity plan. Required for audit trail and governance compliance under IATF 16949.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 5.3 — Organizational Roles; SAP S/4HANA PP — Approval Workflow

attributes.name: available_hours
attributes.description: Total scheduled production hours available in the planning period after accounting for planned downtime, shift breaks, and scheduled maintenance. Used in conjunction with rated_capacity_jph to compute rated capacity in units.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Available Capacity; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: bottleneck_constraint_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the primary capacity constraint at the bottleneck work center (e.g., 'Paint oven cycle time limits throughput to 58 JPH', 'Robotic welding cell maintenance window reduces available hours'). Supports root cause analysis and CapEx justification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning Notes; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: capacity_gap_units
attributes.description: Difference between planned_production_units and demonstrated_capacity_units, representing the capacity shortfall or surplus for the planning period. Positive value indicates a capacity gap requiring corrective action (overtime, additional shifts, CapEx); negative value indicates surplus capacity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Leveling; S&OP Process; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: capacity_plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the capacity planning methodology used. 'rough_cut' (RCCP — Rough Cut Capacity Planning) for high-level S&OP; 'detailed' for work-center-level CRP (Capacity Requirements Planning); 'constraint_based' for Theory of Constraints analysis; 'what_if' for scenario planning and CapEx evaluation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — RCCP/CRP; APICS CPIM Body of Knowledge

attributes.name: capacity_utilization_percent
attributes.description: Planned capacity utilization rate expressed as a percentage, calculated as (planned_production_units / rated_capacity_units) × 100. Drives S&OP decisions on overtime, additional shifts, and capital investment. Target thresholds are typically 85–95% for automotive assembly.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Utilization; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1; S&OP Best Practice

attributes.name: capex_amount
attributes.description: Estimated capital expenditure amount required to address the capacity gap identified in this plan. Expressed in the plant's operating currency. Used for CapEx budget submissions and investment approval processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Investment Management; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: capex_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capacity plan identifies a requirement for capital investment (CapEx) to close a capacity gap (e.g., new tooling, additional robots, facility expansion). Triggers CapEx approval workflow in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — CapEx Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: changeover_hours
attributes.description: Hours allocated for model changeovers, tooling changes, and line reconfigurations during the planning period. Relevant for mixed-model assembly lines producing multiple vehicle variants (e.g., ICE and BEV on the same line).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Setup Time; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this capacity plan record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for data lineage and compliance purposes.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values in this capacity plan record (e.g., USD, EUR, MXN, CNY). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-plant, multi-currency manufacturing operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI — Currency Configuration

attributes.name: daily_production_target
attributes.description: Planned number of vehicles to be produced per working day during the planning period, derived from planned_production_units / working_days. Used for daily MES scheduling and shift-level production targets.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Daily Production Target; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: demonstrated_capacity_units
attributes.description: Actual production output achieved in a comparable prior period, used as the realistic baseline for capacity planning. Reflects real-world constraints such as quality losses, minor stoppages, and changeovers. Key input to APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) capacity studies.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.4.1 — PPAP Capacity Study; APQP Reference Manual

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: Planned End of Production (EOP) date for the vehicle model or program covered by this capacity plan. Marks the milestone when production of the model is scheduled to cease. Used for capacity wind-down planning and asset redeployment decisions.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Program Milestones; APQP Reference Manual; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year (FY) to which this capacity plan belongs, used for CapEx (Capital Expenditure) alignment, budget planning, and financial reporting. Format: FY followed by 4-digit year (e.g., FY2025).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Fiscal Year; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: headcount_required
attributes.description: Total direct labor headcount required to execute the planned production volume during the planning period. Used for workforce planning, hiring decisions, and labor cost budgeting in SuccessFactors and the source system
attributes.references: SuccessFactors — Workforce Planning; SAP S/4HANA CO — Labor Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.2

attributes.name: is_bottleneck_constrained
attributes.description: Indicates whether the capacity plan is constrained by a bottleneck work center that limits overall line throughput below the planned production target. When True, the bottleneck_work_center_id and bottleneck_constraint_description fields are populated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Bottleneck Scheduling; Theory of Constraints; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Automotive model year (MY) for which this capacity plan is prepared. Capacity plans are typically aligned to MY production programs, SOP (Start of Production), and EOP (End of Production) milestones.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Program; NHTSA MY Designation

attributes.name: number_of_shifts
attributes.description: Number of production shifts planned per working day for this capacity plan (e.g., 1, 2, or 3 shifts). Directly determines available production hours and total capacity for the planning period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Shift Model; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: plan_end_date
attributes.description: Last calendar date of the planning period covered by this capacity plan record. Together with plan_start_date, defines the planning window for capacity supply and demand balancing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the capacity plan record, used in S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) communications, the source system planning transactions (CM01/CM21), and cross-functional reporting. Format: CP-{PLANT}-{YEAR}-{MONTH}-{SEQ}.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning (CM01); IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: plan_start_date
attributes.description: First calendar date of the planning period covered by this capacity plan record. Used to align capacity supply with demand signals from S&OP and MRP (Material Requirements Planning) runs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning; ISO 8601 Date Standard

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the capacity plan record. 'draft' indicates work-in-progress; 'submitted' indicates pending approval; 'approved' indicates sign-off by S&OP leadership; 'active' indicates the operative plan driving production scheduling; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer version; 'archived' indicates historical record.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 6.1; SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning

attributes.name: plan_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the capacity plan, enabling management of multiple planning iterations (e.g., v1.0, v2.0) within the same planning period. Supports S&OP cycle versioning and plan-over-plan variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: planned_downtime_hours
attributes.description: Total planned downtime hours for the production line during the planning period, including scheduled maintenance, tooling changeovers, model changeovers, and planned shutdowns. Reduces available production hours from the theoretical maximum.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM — Maintenance Planning; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: planned_maintenance_hours
attributes.description: Subset of planned downtime hours specifically allocated to preventive and predictive maintenance activities on production equipment. Tracked separately from changeover downtime for maintenance KPI reporting and the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM — Preventive Maintenance; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: planned_overtime_hours
attributes.description: Total overtime hours planned for the production line during the planning period to meet production targets beyond standard shift capacity. Feeds into workforce cost planning and labor budget in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO — Capacity Planning; SuccessFactors Workforce Planning

attributes.name: planned_production_units
attributes.description: Number of vehicles planned for production in the planning period as agreed in the S&OP process. Represents the demand signal that capacity must satisfy. Compared against rated and demonstrated capacity to identify gaps.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Program; S&OP Process

attributes.name: planning_period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the capacity planning horizon for this record. 'weekly' supports short-term MES scheduling; 'monthly' supports S&OP cycles; 'quarterly' and 'annual' support CapEx and strategic workforce planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning Horizon; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: planning_scenario
attributes.description: Demand scenario underpinning this capacity plan. 'base' reflects the consensus S&OP forecast; 'optimistic' reflects upside demand; 'pessimistic' reflects downside risk; 'stretch' reflects maximum achievable output. Enables scenario comparison for executive decision-making.
attributes.references: S&OP Best Practice; SAP S/4HANA PP — Planning Scenario

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain technology type planned for production in this capacity plan. ICE = Internal Combustion Engine; HEV = Hybrid Electric Vehicle; PHEV = Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle; BEV = Battery Electric Vehicle; FCEV = Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle. Impacts tooling, line configuration, and capacity requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Program; EPA Emissions Standards; CAFE Regulations

attributes.name: rated_capacity_jph
attributes.description: Theoretical maximum production rate expressed in Jobs Per Hour (JPH) for the production line under ideal conditions. Derived from takt time and line design specifications. Used as the baseline for capacity utilization calculations in S&OP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Definition; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1; SAE J3061

attributes.name: rated_capacity_units
attributes.description: Theoretical maximum number of vehicles that can be produced in the planning period, calculated as rated_capacity_jph × available_hours. Represents the upper bound of production capacity for S&OP and CapEx planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning (CM01); IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: sap_capacity_plan_code
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this capacity plan record in the source system (Production Planning) module, used for data lineage traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational ERP system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning (CM01/CM21); Data Lineage Best Practice

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: Planned Start of Production (SOP) date for the vehicle model or program covered by this capacity plan. Marks the milestone when full-rate production is scheduled to begin. Critical for capacity ramp-up planning and APQP milestone tracking.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Program Milestones; APQP Reference Manual; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

attributes.name: takt_time_seconds
attributes.description: Planned takt time in seconds for the production line during this planning period, representing the rate at which vehicles must be produced to meet customer demand. Takt time = available production time / planned production units. Core metric in JIS (Just-in-Sequence) and line balancing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Work Center Takt Time; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this capacity plan record was last modified. Tracks plan revisions through the S&OP cycle and supports change management auditing.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Internal OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) code identifying the vehicle model or program (e.g., platform code, nameplate code) for which this capacity plan is prepared. Enables capacity planning at the model/program level.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Product Structure; SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Program

attributes.name: working_days
attributes.description: Number of scheduled working days in the planning period after excluding weekends, public holidays, and planned plant shutdowns. Used to compute daily production targets and available hours.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP — Factory Calendar; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

products.name: changeover
products.description: Transactional record for production line changeover events when switching between vehicle models, body styles, or powertrain variants on a shared production line. Captures changeover type (model mix change, color change, tooling swap, line retooling), planned and actual changeover start/end times, duration, affected production line, changeover team, and production loss (units not produced). Supports SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) improvement programs.

attributes.name: changeover_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each production line changeover event record in the manufacturing execution system.

attributes.name: changeover_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production supervisor or line manager who authorized and oversaw the changeover event. Supports accountability tracking and sign-off compliance per IATF 16949.

attributes.name: changeover_supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production supervisor or line manager who authorized and oversaw the changeover event. Supports accountability tracking and sign-off compliance per IATF 16949.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the operator team or crew responsible for executing the changeover. Supports SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) team performance analysis and workforce accountability.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where the changeover event occurred.

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production or assembly line on which the changeover was performed.

attributes.name: shift_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production shift during which the changeover event occurred. Used for shift-level performance reporting and labor attribution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - Production Planning; IATF 16949

attributes.name: actual_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Actual elapsed time in minutes from changeover start to completion. Core metric for SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) analysis and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) calculations.

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the changeover was completed and the production line resumed normal operation, as recorded by MES (Manufacturing Execution System).
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES - Shop Floor Execution; IATF 16949

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the changeover physically commenced on the production line, as recorded by MES (Manufacturing Execution System) or operator input.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES - Shop Floor Execution; IATF 16949

attributes.name: agv_intervention_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle) systems were required to transport tooling, fixtures, or materials as part of the changeover process. Supports AGV utilization and changeover logistics analysis.
attributes.references: SAE International; Apriso/Dassault MES - Shop Floor Execution

attributes.name: assembly_stage
attributes.description: The specific manufacturing stage or shop where the changeover occurred (e.g., stamping, body shop, paint, trim, chassis, final assembly). Enables stage-level SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) benchmarking.

attributes.name: changeover_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the changeover event, used in MES (Manufacturing Execution System) and shop floor documentation. Format: CO-{PLANT}-{YYYYMMDD}-{SEQ}.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES - Shop Floor Execution; IATF 16949

attributes.name: changeover_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the changeover event as tracked in the MES (Manufacturing Execution System). Drives shop floor workflow and reporting.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES - Shop Floor Execution; IATF 16949

attributes.name: changeover_type
attributes.description: Classification of the changeover event indicating the nature of the switch on the production line. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: model_mix_change|color_change|tooling_swap|line_retooling|powertrain_variant|body_style_change — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) Methodology; SAE International J4000

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the changeover record was first created in the MES (Manufacturing Execution System) or data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - Record Control; ISO 9001 - Document Control

attributes.name: delay_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code capturing the primary reason for any variance between planned and actual changeover duration. Used for root cause analysis in SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) and continuous improvement programs.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - Corrective Action; SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: external_elements_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes spent on external changeover activities that can be performed while the production line is still running (e.g., pre-staging tooling). Core SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) metric for optimization.
attributes.references: SMED Methodology - Shigeo Shingo; SAE International

attributes.name: first_good_unit_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the first conforming vehicle unit passed quality inspection after the changeover was completed. Marks the effective end of production loss and resumption of normal throughput.

attributes.name: from_body_style_code
attributes.description: Body style classification of the vehicle being produced before the changeover (e.g., sedan, SUV, truck). Used to categorize body style changeover events.
attributes.references: SAE International J1100 - Vehicle Body Styles

attributes.name: from_exterior_color_code
attributes.description: Paint color code of the vehicle being produced before the changeover. Relevant for color change changeover events in the paint shop.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES - Quality Control; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: from_powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain variant being produced before the changeover. ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle).
attributes.references: SAE International J1715; EPA Emissions Standards

attributes.name: from_vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Vehicle model code of the product being produced on the line immediately before the changeover. Identifies the outgoing model in a model mix change scenario.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM - BOM Management; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: internal_elements_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total time in minutes spent on internal changeover activities that require the production line to be stopped (e.g., die removal, fixture swap). Core SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) metric for identifying conversion opportunities.
attributes.references: SMED Methodology - Shigeo Shingo; SAE International

attributes.name: is_planned
attributes.description: Indicates whether the changeover was a scheduled/planned event (True) or an unplanned/emergency changeover triggered by a quality issue, equipment failure, or urgent customer order change (False).
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - Production Planning; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: is_smed_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Is SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) Target
attributes.description: Flags whether this changeover event is designated as a target for SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) improvement analysis. Enables filtering of changeover records for lean manufacturing improvement programs.
attributes.references: SMED Methodology - Shigeo Shingo; SAE International

tag_set.value: Is SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) Target

attributes.name: line_verification_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Time in minutes spent on post-changeover line verification, first-off inspection, and quality gate checks before resuming full production. Supports APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) and PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) compliance.

attributes.name: mes_changeover_reference
attributes.description: Native changeover event identifier from the Apriso/Dassault MES (Manufacturing Execution System). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational MES source system.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES - Shop Floor Execution; IATF 16949

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Model Year (MY) of the vehicle being introduced on the production line after the changeover. Used for production planning, regulatory compliance, and homologation tracking.
attributes.references: NHTSA - Vehicle Identification; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: planned_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Planned duration of the changeover in minutes as defined in the production schedule. Baseline for SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) improvement tracking.

attributes.name: planned_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when the changeover was planned to be completed. Used to calculate planned changeover duration and production window impact.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - Production Planning; IATF 16949

attributes.name: planned_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when the changeover was planned to begin, as defined in the production schedule. Used for SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) baseline comparison.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - Production Planning; IATF 16949

attributes.name: production_loss_units
attributes.description: Number of vehicle units not produced due to the changeover downtime. Calculated as the difference between potential production capacity and actual output during the changeover window. Key metric for OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness) and capacity planning.

attributes.name: quality_gate_passed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the post-changeover quality gate inspection was passed (True) before resuming full production. A False value indicates the line was held pending rework or re-inspection per IATF 16949 quality control requirements.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - Quality Gates; APQP; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason that triggered the changeover event (e.g., scheduled model mix, customer order sequence, engineering change, maintenance requirement). Used for root cause analysis and frequency reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - Production Orders; IATF 16949

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing additional context for the changeover reason, supplementing the reason code with operator or supervisor notes.

attributes.name: sap_order_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the the source system order number associated with the post-changeover production run. Enables cost allocation and production confirmation reconciliation in the source system Planning).

attributes.name: scrap_units_during_changeover
attributes.description: Number of vehicle units scrapped or rejected during the changeover transition period before the first good unit was produced. Contributes to quality loss calculation in OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness).
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - Scrap Reporting; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: takt_time_seconds
attributes.description: Takt time in seconds applicable to the production line at the time of changeover. Used to calculate production loss units and assess changeover impact on line throughput.

attributes.name: to_body_style_code
attributes.description: Body style classification of the vehicle to be produced after the changeover (e.g., sedan, SUV, truck). Used to categorize body style changeover events.
attributes.references: SAE International J1100 - Vehicle Body Styles

attributes.name: to_exterior_color_code
attributes.description: Paint color code of the vehicle to be produced after the changeover. Relevant for color change changeover events in the paint shop.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES - Quality Control; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: to_powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain variant to be produced after the changeover. ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle).
attributes.references: SAE International J1715; EPA Emissions Standards

attributes.name: to_vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Vehicle model code of the product to be produced on the line immediately after the changeover. Identifies the incoming model in a model mix change scenario.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM - BOM Management; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: tooling_change_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the changeover required a physical tooling swap or die change (True) or was a parameter/program-only changeover (False). Drives tooling logistics planning and SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) categorization.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - Tooling Management; SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: tooling_setup_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Time in minutes required specifically for tooling installation, adjustment, and verification during the changeover. Subset of internal changeover elements used for tooling-specific SMED analysis.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the changeover record was last modified in the data platform. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and incremental load processing for the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - Record Control; ISO 9001 - Document Control

attributes.name: variance_minutes
attributes.description: Difference in minutes between actual and planned changeover duration (actual_duration_minutes minus planned_duration_minutes). Positive value indicates overrun; negative indicates early completion. Key SMED (Single-Minute Exchange of Die) performance indicator.

products.name: production_variant
products.description: Reference master defining the valid production variants (option combinations) that can be built on a specific production line for a given model year. Captures variant code, model, MY, powertrain type (ICE, HEV, PHEV, BEV), body style, trim level, market destination, and line compatibility flags. Supports build sequence feasibility validation and JIS sequencing rules. Distinct from the commercial product catalog — this is the manufacturing-feasible variant definition.
products.reference: Apriso MES Variant Configuration / SAP PP Configuration

attributes.name: production_variant_id
attributes.description: Primary key for production_variant

attributes.name: rebate_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the production variant record. Primary key for the manufacturing-feasible variant definition. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.

attributes.name: homologation_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.homologation_record. Business justification: Variant definitions are approved via homologation; linking ensures variant builds only when approved.

attributes.name: model_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.model. Business justification: Variant Definition Process links each variant to its vehicle model for configuration management and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this production variant is authorized to be built. Determines line compatibility, tooling availability, and regulatory homologation scope.

attributes.name: production_bom_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing BOM (Bill of Materials) version applicable to this production variant. Links to the BOM master in Siemens Teamcenter PLM or the source system Management) to resolve component lists for production planning and MRP (Material Requirements Planning) execution.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.3.5 — Design and Development Outputs; SAP MM BOM Management

attributes.name: production_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific production line within the plant on which this variant is authorized to be assembled. Drives JIS (Just-in-Sequence) feasibility validation and takt time allocation.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5 — Production and Service Provision

attributes.name: routing_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing routing (operation sequence) applicable to this production variant in the source system Planning). Defines the sequence of work centers, operations, and standard times required to build this variant from stamping through final assembly.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1 — Control of Production; SAP PP Routing

attributes.name: vehicle_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.vehicle_program. Business justification: Variants are defined under a vehicle program; variant management reports require vehicle_program_id.

attributes.name: adas_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Automation Level
attributes.description: SAE J3016 automation level of the ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) suite fitted to this production variant: L0 (no automation), L1 (driver assistance), L2 (partial automation), L2_PLUS (enhanced partial automation), L3 (conditional automation). Drives ECU (Electronic Control Unit) software configuration, OTA (Over-the-Air Update) eligibility, and UNECE UN R157 regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SAE J3016 — Taxonomy of Driving Automation; UNECE UN R157 — ALKS; NHTSA AV Policy

tag_set.value: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Automation Level

attributes.name: assembly_complexity_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (1–10) representing the relative assembly complexity of this production variant compared to the base variant on the same production line. Higher scores indicate more assembly operations, longer cycle times, or specialized tooling requirements. Used for JIS (Just-in-Sequence) sequencing optimization to balance line loading and avoid consecutive high-complexity builds.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1; SAE J4000 — Lean Manufacturing Assessment

attributes.name: battery_capacity_kwh
attributes.description: Usable battery pack capacity in kilowatt-hours (kWh) for BEV, PHEV, and HEV variants. Null for pure ICE variants. Drives assembly sequencing for battery marriage station, WLTP (Worldwide Harmonised Light Vehicles Test Procedure) range certification, and EPA electric range labelling.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 600 — Fuel Economy; WLTP Regulation (EU) 2017/1151; SAE J1634

attributes.name: body_style_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the vehicle body configuration for this production variant (e.g., SEDAN, SUV, TRUCK, COUPE, HATCHBACK, MINIVAN). Determines stamping die sets, body shop tooling, and paint booth configuration requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SEDAN|SUV|TRUCK|COUPE|HATCHBACK|MINIVAN|CONVERTIBLE|WAGON|VAN|CROSSOVER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAE J1100 — Vehicle Dimensions; ISO 3833 — Road Vehicles Types

attributes.name: co2_emission_g_per_km
attributes.description: Certified CO2 tailpipe emission in grams per kilometre (g/km) under WLTP or NEDC test cycle for this production variant. Used for EU CO2 fleet average compliance (Regulation (EU) 2019/631), CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) calculations, and vehicle taxation band classification in destination markets.
attributes.references: EU Regulation 2019/631 — CO2 Standards for Cars; EPA 40 CFR Part 86; CARB Title 13

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this production variant record was first created in the manufacturing master data system. Provides audit trail for data governance and IATF 16949 documented information control requirements.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: destination_market_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the primary market for which this production variant is homologated and destined (e.g., 'USA', 'DEU', 'JPN'). Governs regulatory compliance requirements (NHTSA FMVSS, Euro NCAP, UNECE), emission standards, and right-hand vs left-hand drive configuration.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; NHTSA FMVSS; UNECE Vehicle Regulations; Euro NCAP

attributes.name: drive_configuration
attributes.description: Drivetrain configuration specifying which axles receive motive power: FWD (Front-Wheel Drive), RWD (Rear-Wheel Drive), AWD (All-Wheel Drive), or 4WD (Four-Wheel Drive). Determines chassis assembly routing, driveshaft fitment, and NVH (Noise Vibration Harshness) validation requirements.

attributes.name: engine_displacement_cc
attributes.description: Total engine displacement in cubic centimetres (cc) for ICE (Internal Combustion Engine) and HEV/PHEV variants. Null for BEV and FCEV variants. Used for regulatory classification under EPA, CARB, and UNECE emissions standards, and for CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) fleet averaging calculations.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 86; UNECE Regulation No. 83 — Emissions

attributes.name: engineering_change_level
attributes.description: Current engineering change revision level for this production variant as managed in Siemens Teamcenter PLM or PTC Windchill (e.g., 'A', 'B', 'C1', 'REV3'). Tracks design maturity and ensures the correct BOM (Bill of Materials) version is applied during production. Incremented upon each approved engineering change notice (ECN).
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.3.6 — Design and Development Changes; Siemens Teamcenter PLM ECM

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: Date on which this production variant is scheduled to cease production (EOP — End of Production). Drives last-order scheduling, tooling decommissioning planning, and spare parts provisioning for after-sales service obligations.
attributes.references: APQP Phase 5 — Feedback, Assessment and Corrective Action; IATF 16949

attributes.name: fuel_economy_mpg
attributes.description: EPA-certified combined fuel economy in miles per gallon (MPG) for ICE, HEV, and PHEV variants in NAFTA markets. Null for BEV/FCEV variants. Used for CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) fleet compliance reporting to EPA and consumer window sticker labelling under 49 CFR Part 575.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 600 — Fuel Economy; CAFE Standards 49 CFR Part 533; NHTSA

attributes.name: gross_vehicle_weight_kg
attributes.description: Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) in kilograms for this production variant. Used for regulatory classification under DOT FMVSS, UNECE weight regulations, and CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) fleet averaging. Also drives chassis assembly torque specifications and suspension tuning parameters.
attributes.references: NHTSA FMVSS 120; UNECE Regulation No. 13 — Braking; DOT 49 CFR Part 571

attributes.name: hand_of_drive
attributes.description: Steering wheel position for this production variant: LHD (Left-Hand Drive) for markets such as USA, Germany; RHD (Right-Hand Drive) for markets such as UK, Japan, Australia. Determines instrument panel assembly variant, steering column routing, and body shop tooling configuration.
attributes.references: UNECE Regulation No. 48 — Installation of Lighting; ISO 4130

attributes.name: homologation_status
attributes.description: Regulatory type-approval and homologation status for this production variant in the target destination market: PENDING (application submitted), CERTIFIED (full approval granted), CONDITIONAL (provisional approval with conditions), EXPIRED (certification lapsed), NOT_REQUIRED. Governs whether the variant can be legally sold in the destination market.
attributes.references: UNECE WP.29 — Type Approval; NHTSA FMVSS Certification; Euro NCAP; DOT 49 CFR Part 567

attributes.name: is_ckd_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production variant can be produced as a CKD (Completely Knocked Down) kit for assembly at an overseas plant (True = CKD eligible). Drives export documentation, customs tariff classification, and overseas plant BOM (Bill of Materials) configuration in the source system
attributes.references: WTO Customs Valuation Agreement; SAP MM CKD Processing; IATF 16949

attributes.name: is_jis_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production variant is eligible for JIS (Just-in-Sequence) supplier call-off sequencing (True = JIS eligible). JIS-eligible variants require sequenced component delivery synchronized to the build sequence, impacting supplier logistics contracts and MES call-off trigger configuration.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.4 — Control of Externally Provided Processes; SAE J4000

attributes.name: is_line_compatible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production variant has been validated as feasible for assembly on the assigned production line (True = compatible, False = not compatible). Serves as the primary gate flag in MES (Manufacturing Execution System) build sequence feasibility validation and JIS (Just-in-Sequence) call-off authorization.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1 — Control of Production; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: is_ota_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production variant supports OTA (Over-the-Air) software updates for ECU (Electronic Control Unit) and infotainment systems (True = OTA capable). Drives connected vehicle service provisioning in Geotab/Bosch IoT platform and UNECE UN R156 software update regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: UNECE UN R156 — Software Update Processes; NHTSA Cybersecurity Best Practices; SAE J3101

attributes.name: max_consecutive_builds
attributes.description: Maximum number of consecutive units of this production variant that can be scheduled back-to-back in the build sequence without violating line balancing or ergonomic constraints. Enforced by MES (Manufacturing Execution System) JIS (Just-in-Sequence) sequencing rules to prevent operator fatigue and tooling overload.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1 — Control of Production; Apriso/Dassault MES Sequencing Rules

attributes.name: mes_variant_reference
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier for this production variant in the Apriso/Dassault MES (Manufacturing Execution System). Used for real-time build sequence call-off, WIP (Work in Progress) tracking, and quality gate routing on the shop floor.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES — Shop Floor Execution; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Four-digit model year (MY) for which this production variant is defined and authorized. Governs BOM (Bill of Materials) version applicability, regulatory homologation, and CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) compliance grouping. Range: 2000–2040.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 — VIN Requirements; EPA CAFE Standards

attributes.name: ncap_safety_rating
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Car Assessment Programme (NCAP) Safety Rating
attributes.description: Overall NCAP (New Car Assessment Programme) safety star rating achieved by this production variant (1 to 5 stars, or NOT_RATED if not yet assessed). Applicable to Euro NCAP, NHTSA NCAP, or ANCAP depending on destination market. Used for regulatory compliance reporting and marketing communications.
attributes.references: Euro NCAP Assessment Protocol; NHTSA 5-Star Safety Ratings Program; ANCAP

tag_set.value: New Car Assessment Programme (NCAP) Safety Rating

attributes.name: option_package_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the bundled option package associated with this production variant (e.g., 'TECH_PKG', 'SAFETY_PKG', 'LUXURY_PKG'). Maps to a specific set of BOM (Bill of Materials) components and assembly operations in Siemens Teamcenter PLM and the source system material management.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Variant Configuration; SAP PP — Configurable Materials (KMAT)

attributes.name: paint_process_type
attributes.description: Classification of the paint application process required for this production variant: STANDARD (solid colour), METALLIC, PEARL, MATTE, or TWO_TONE. Determines paint booth routing, cure cycle parameters, and paint material BOM (Bill of Materials) components in the body shop and paint shop assembly stages.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1 — Control of Production; ISO 12647 — Colour Standards

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle powertrain technology for this variant: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), or FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Drives assembly process routing, tooling requirements, and EPA/CARB emissions compliance classification.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 86 — Emissions Standards; CARB Title 13; SAE J1715

attributes.name: ppap_status
attributes.description: Current PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) approval status for this production variant. PPAP approval is a mandatory quality gate before SOP (Start of Production) under IATF 16949. Status values: NOT_REQUIRED, PENDING, SUBMITTED, APPROVED, REJECTED. Drives production release authorization in MES.
attributes.references: AIAG PPAP 4th Edition; IATF 16949 Clause 8.3.4 — Design and Development Controls

attributes.name: regulatory_region
attributes.description: Regulatory compliance region grouping for this production variant, used to apply the correct homologation ruleset: NAFTA (North America), EU (European Union), APAC (Asia-Pacific), LATAM (Latin America), MEA (Middle East & Africa), CHINA. Determines applicable NCAP (New Car Assessment Programme) standards, emissions regulations, and safety certification requirements.
attributes.references: UNECE WP.29 — World Forum for Harmonization of Vehicle Regulations; NHTSA; Euro NCAP

attributes.name: sap_material_number
attributes.description: the source system master number (MM module) corresponding to this production variant's configurable material (KMAT). Used for MRP (Material Requirements Planning), production order creation in the source system cost object controlling in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM — Material Master; SAP PP — Configurable Materials (KMAT); IATF 16949

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: Date on which this production variant is authorized to enter volume production (SOP — Start of Production). Used for production planning gate reviews, PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) milestone tracking, and supplier readiness confirmation.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Phase 4 — Product and Process Validation; IATF 16949

attributes.name: standard_build_hours
attributes.description: Standard labor hours required to complete the full assembly of this production variant from stamping through final assembly and PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection). Used for production cost standard setting, workforce planning, and the source system cost object calculation.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1; SAP CO Standard Cost Estimation

attributes.name: takt_time_seconds
attributes.description: Allocated takt time in seconds for building this production variant on the assigned production line. Represents the available production time divided by customer demand rate. Used for JIS (Just-in-Sequence) scheduling, capacity planning, and bottleneck identification in MES (Manufacturing Execution System).
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1 — Control of Production; SAE J4000 — Lean Manufacturing

attributes.name: teamcenter_variant_code
attributes.description: Cross-reference identifier for this production variant in Siemens Teamcenter PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) variant configuration module. Enables traceability between the manufacturing master data record and the engineering variant definition in the PLM system of record.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Variant Configuration; IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information

attributes.name: transmission_type
attributes.description: Type of transmission fitted in this production variant: AUTOMATIC (conventional automatic), MANUAL (manual gearbox), CVT (Continuously Variable Transmission), DCT (Dual-Clutch Transmission), or SINGLE_SPEED (for BEV/FCEV). Drives assembly routing to the correct powertrain marriage station and torque tooling specification.
attributes.references: SAE J1297 — Automatic Transmission Functions; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5

attributes.name: trim_level_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code identifying the equipment and feature trim level for this variant (e.g., 'BASE', 'XLE', 'PLATINUM', 'SPORT'). Determines option package applicability, BOM (Bill of Materials) component selection, and MSRP (Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price) tier in the commercial catalog.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Variant Configuration; SAP PP — Configurable Materials

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this production variant record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks Silver Layer pipeline and for engineering change audit trail compliance under IATF 16949 documented information control.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

attributes.name: v2x_capable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this production variant is equipped with V2X (Vehicle-to-Everything) communication hardware (True = V2X capable). Drives telematics module assembly sequencing, spectrum licensing compliance, and connected mobility service activation in Geotab/Bosch IoT platform.
attributes.references: SAE J2945 — V2X Communications; ETSI ITS Standards; FCC 47 CFR Part 95

attributes.name: variant_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this production variant within the manufacturing system. Used as the primary business key in MES (Manufacturing Execution System), PLM (Product Lifecycle Management), and the source system Planning) for variant identification and cross-system referencing. Sourced from Siemens Teamcenter PLM variant configuration.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.3 — Design and Development; SAP PP Variant Configuration

attributes.name: variant_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the production variant (e.g., 'F-Series SuperCrew 4x4 BEV Long Range'). Used in build sequence planning, shop floor documentation, and JIS (Just-in-Sequence) scheduling displays.

attributes.name: variant_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the production variant within the manufacturing master data: ACTIVE (currently buildable), PLANNED (approved for future SOP), INACTIVE (not currently scheduled), DISCONTINUED (past EOP), ON_HOLD (temporarily suspended pending engineering change or regulatory review). Drives MES build feasibility checks.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Clause 8.3 — Design and Development; SAP PP Material Status

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) internal model code identifying the vehicle platform or nameplate (e.g., 'F150', 'RAV4', 'MODEL3'). Links the production variant to the vehicle program in PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) and the source system Management).
attributes.references: SAE J1100 — Vehicle Dimensions; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: wltp_range_km
attributes.business_glossary_term: Worldwide Harmonised Light Vehicles Test Procedure (WLTP) Range (km)
attributes.description: Official WLTP (Worldwide Harmonised Light Vehicles Test Procedure) certified driving range in kilometres for BEV and PHEV variants. Null for ICE and HEV variants. Used for EU regulatory labelling, EPA range certification cross-reference, and consumer-facing range claims.
attributes.references: WLTP Regulation (EU) 2017/1151; EPA 40 CFR Part 600 — Fuel Economy Labelling

tag_set.value: Worldwide Harmonised Light Vehicles Test Procedure (WLTP) Range (km)

products.name: scrap_record
products.description: Transactional record capturing scrapped materials, components, or vehicle units during the manufacturing process. Tracks scrap item (part number or VIN), scrap quantity, scrap reason code, scrap location (work center, process stage), production order reference, scrap value, disposal method, and authorization reference. Feeds the source system variance accounting and quality PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate reporting.
products.reference: SAP PP/CO Scrap / Apriso MES Scrap Reporting

attributes.name: scrap_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each scrap record transaction in the manufacturing domain. Primary key for the scrap_record data product.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7 - Control of Nonconforming Outputs

attributes.name: authorizing_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supervisor or quality engineer who authorized the scrap disposition. Required for IATF 16949 nonconforming output control and the source system authorization.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7.1 - Control of Nonconforming Outputs; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: defect_record_id
attributes.description: Reference to the quality defect or nonconformance record in the the source system MES quality module that triggered this scrap event. Links scrap to the broader quality management workflow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM - Quality Notification; IATF 16949 Section 8.7

attributes.name: plant_id
