attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where the scrap event occurred. Used for plant-level PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate reporting and cost center allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the production order under which the scrapped material or component was being processed. Links scrap to the source system order for cost variance accounting.

attributes.name: work_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work center or process station where the scrap event was detected and recorded. Enables work-center-level scrap analysis and bottleneck identification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - Work Center; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: assembly_stage_code
attributes.description: The manufacturing assembly stage at which the scrap was detected. STAMP = Stamping, BODY = Body Shop, PAINT = Paint Shop, TRIM = Trim Assembly, CHASSIS = Chassis Assembly, FINAL = Final Assembly, PDI = Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI). Critical for stage-level scrap rate analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: STAMP|BODY|PAINT|TRIM|CHASSIS|FINAL|PDI — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES - Shop Floor Execution; SAP S/4HANA PP - Routing

attributes.name: bom_component_number
attributes.description: The BOM (Bill of Materials) component position number of the scrapped part within the vehicle BOM structure. Used for BOM-level scrap impact analysis and engineering change management in Siemens Teamcenter PLM.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM - BOM Management; SAP S/4HANA MM - BOM

attributes.name: co2_impact_kg
attributes.description: Estimated CO2 equivalent emissions impact in kilograms associated with the scrapped material, based on the material's embodied carbon factor. Used for environmental sustainability reporting and EPA/ISO 14001 carbon footprint tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 - Environmental Management; EPA - Greenhouse Gas Reporting; CARB Regulations

attributes.name: corrective_action_reference
attributes.description: Reference number to the corrective action report (CAR) or 8D problem-solving report initiated as a result of this scrap event. Links to the quality corrective action management system.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 10.2; SAP S/4HANA QM - Quality Notification; APQP

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: the source system center code to which the scrap cost variance is posted. Derived from the work center's cost center assignment. Enables departmental cost accountability for scrap losses.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this scrap record was first created in the source system (the source system Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the scrap_value and salvage_value amounts (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY, MXN). Aligns with the plant's company code currency in the source system
attributes.references: ISO 4217 - Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI - Company Code Currency

attributes.name: detection_method_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the inspection or detection method used to identify the defect leading to scrap. VISUAL = visual inspection; GAUGE = gauge measurement; CMM = Coordinate Measuring Machine; SPC = Statistical Process Control (SPC) chart alert; FUNCTIONAL = functional test failure; AUTOMATED = automated vision system; AUDIT = quality audit finding. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: VISUAL|GAUGE|CMM|SPC|FUNCTIONAL|AUTOMATED|AUDIT — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.6 - Release of Products; SAP S/4HANA QM; APQP Control Plan

attributes.name: disposal_method_code
attributes.description: Code indicating how the scrapped material is to be or was physically disposed of. RECYCLE = sent to recycling; LANDFILL = disposed to landfill; REWORK = redirected to rework process; RETURN_SUPPLIER = returned to supplier; INCINERATE = incinerated; RESALE = sold as scrap metal or secondary material.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 - Environmental Management; EPA - Waste Disposal Regulations; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: disposal_reference
attributes.description: Reference number for the disposal authorization document, waste manifest, or environmental permit associated with the scrapped material disposal. Required for EPA and ISO 14001 environmental compliance documentation.
attributes.references: EPA - Hazardous Waste Regulations; ISO 14001 Section 8.1; DOT - Hazardous Materials

attributes.name: inspection_point_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific quality gate or inspection point in the production routing where the defect was detected and the scrap decision was made. Aligns with the APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) control plan.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.6; APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning); SAP S/4HANA QM - Inspection Plan

attributes.name: is_hazardous_material
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scrapped material is classified as hazardous (e.g., battery electrolyte, paint solvents, hydraulic fluid). True = hazardous; requires special disposal handling per EPA and DOT regulations.
attributes.references: EPA - Resource Conservation and Recovery Act (RCRA); DOT 49 CFR - Hazardous Materials; ISO 14001

attributes.name: is_safety_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scrapped component is a safety-critical part (e.g., airbag, brake component, steering system part). True = safety-related; triggers mandatory FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) review and NHTSA notification assessment.
attributes.references: NHTSA - Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS); IATF 16949 Section 8.3.3; FMEA Methodology

attributes.name: is_warranty_relevant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the scrap event is relevant to warranty analysis, i.e., the defect type matches known warranty failure modes. True = relevant; used to correlate manufacturing scrap patterns with field warranty claims.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7; SAP S/4HANA QM - Warranty Management

attributes.name: mes_transaction_code
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier assigned by the Apriso/Dassault MES system when the scrap event was recorded on the shop floor. Used for cross-system traceability between MES and the source system.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES - Shop Floor Traceability; IATF 16949 Section 8.5.2 - Identification and Traceability

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The vehicle model year (MY) associated with the production order or vehicle unit being scrapped. Used for model-year-level scrap cost reporting and CAFE/regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: NHTSA - Model Year Definition; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: part_number
attributes.description: The the source system or BOM (Bill of Materials) component part number of the scrapped item. Null if the scrapped item is a complete vehicle unit (VIN-level scrap). Used for BOM-level scrap analysis and MRP (Material Requirements Planning) adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Material Master; PTC Windchill Parts Classification

attributes.name: ppm_contribution
attributes.description: The PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate contribution of this individual scrap event, calculated as (scrap_quantity / total production quantity) × 1,000,000. Used as a raw input for PPM defect rate KPI reporting to management and customers.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 - PPM Defect Rate Reporting; SAP S/4HANA QM; Customer-Specific Requirements

attributes.name: production_line_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific production line where the scrap event occurred. Used for line-level scrap rate trending and capacity impact analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - Work Center; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized root cause classification code assigned after investigation, used for corrective action tracking and FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) updates. Examples: TOOL_WEAR, PARAM_DRIFT, INCOMING_MATL, OPERATOR_SKILL, DESIGN_TOLERANCE. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: TOOL_WEAR|PARAM_DRIFT|INCOMING_MATL|OPERATOR_SKILL|DESIGN_TOLERANCE|MAINT_FAILURE|PROCESS_CHANGE|ENVIRONMENT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 10.2 - Nonconformity and Corrective Action; FMEA Methodology; SAP S/4HANA QM

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: The recoverable monetary value from the scrapped material after disposal (e.g., scrap metal resale, recycled material value). Net scrap cost = scrap_value minus salvage_value. Used in the source system reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Production Variance; ISO 14001 - Environmental Management

attributes.name: sap_movement_type
attributes.description: the source system movement type used to post the scrap transaction. 551 = Scrapping from unrestricted stock; 552 = Reversal of scrapping; 553 = Scrapping from quality inspection stock; 554 = Reversal of scrapping from QI stock. Critical for the source system posting reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Goods Movement; SAP S/4HANA CO - Production Variance

attributes.name: sap_posting_document_number
attributes.description: The the source system document number generated when the scrap value was posted to the production variance account. Null if not yet financially posted. Used for financial audit trail and period-end closing reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Accounting Document; SAP S/4HANA CO - Production Variance

attributes.name: scrap_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the scrap event origin for management reporting and corrective action routing. 'process' = manufacturing process failure; 'material' = incoming material defect; 'design' = engineering design issue; 'tooling' = tooling or fixture failure; 'supplier' = supplier-caused defect; 'operator_error' = human error.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Section 8.7; APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Methodology

attributes.name: scrap_document_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable document number assigned to this scrap transaction, typically generated by the source system movement (movement type 551/552). Used for audit trail and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Goods Movement; IATF 16949 Section 8.7

attributes.name: scrap_quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material or components scrapped in this transaction, expressed in the base unit of measure of the material (e.g., EA for each, KG for weight-based materials, M for length-based). Must be greater than zero.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Goods Movement Type 551; IATF 16949

attributes.name: scrap_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized reason code classifying the root cause of the scrap event, sourced from the the source system catalog or MES reason code library. Examples: DMGD (Damaged), WELD_FAIL (Weld Failure), PAINT_DEF (Paint Defect), DIM_OOT (Dimensional Out of Tolerance), MATL_DEF (Material Defect). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DMGD|WELD_FAIL|PAINT_DEF|DIM_OOT|MATL_DEF|OPER_ERR|TOOLING|SETUP_ERR|DESIGN_DEF|SUPPLIER_DEF — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA QM - Defect Catalog; IATF 16949 Section 8.7; FMEA Methodology

attributes.name: scrap_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the scrap reason, providing additional context beyond the reason code. Entered by the operator or quality technician at the time of scrap recording in MES.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES - Quality Control; IATF 16949 Section 8.7

attributes.name: scrap_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the scrap record. 'pending' = awaiting supervisor confirmation; 'confirmed' = approved and posted to the source system = material physically removed; 'reversed' = scrap posting reversed; 'under_review' = flagged for quality investigation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Production Variance; IATF 16949 Section 8.7

attributes.name: scrap_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time when the scrap event was recorded on the shop floor via MES (Manufacturing Execution System). This is the principal business event timestamp, distinct from record audit timestamps.
attributes.references: Apriso/Dassault MES - Shop Floor Traceability; IATF 16949

attributes.name: scrap_value
attributes.description: The gross standard cost value of the scrapped material or component, calculated as scrap quantity multiplied by the the source system rate. Posted to the source system variance account. Used for financial reporting of manufacturing losses.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Production Variance Accounting; IATF 16949

attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the production shift during which the scrap event occurred. D = Day, A = Afternoon, N = Night, E = Extended. Enables shift-level scrap pattern analysis for workforce and process improvement.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP - Shift Planning; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: supplier_code
attributes.description: the source system of the external supplier who provided the scrapped material or component, if the scrap root cause is supplier-related. Used for supplier PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate reporting and PPAP (Production Part Approval Process) review triggers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Vendor Master; IATF 16949 Section 8.4 - External Providers

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Base unit of measure for the scrap quantity, aligned with the source system UoM configuration. EA = Each, KG = Kilogram, M = Meter, L = Liter, M2 = Square Meter, M3 = Cubic Meter, PC = Piece. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|M|L|M2|M3|PC — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Material Master; ISO 80000 Units of Measurement

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this scrap record, such as status changes, quantity corrections, or authorization updates.

attributes.name: vehicle_model_code
attributes.description: Internal vehicle model or platform code associated with the scrapped component or vehicle unit (e.g., F150, RAV4, Model3). Enables model-level scrap rate analysis and BOM (Bill of Materials) impact assessment.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM - BOM Management; SAP S/4HANA PP

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) of the vehicle unit being scrapped, if the scrap event applies to a complete or partially assembled vehicle. Null for component-level scrap. Conforms to ISO 3779 VIN standard.
attributes.references: ISO 3779 - Vehicle Identification Number; NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565

attributes.name: weight_kg
attributes.description: Physical weight of the scrapped material in kilograms. Used for environmental reporting (ISO 14001 waste generation metrics), recycling tracking, and logistics planning for scrap removal.
attributes.references: ISO 14001 - Environmental Management; EPA - Waste Reporting; SAP S/4HANA WM

products.name: manufacturing_supply_agreement
products.description: Represents the contractual agreement between a manufacturing plant and a supplier. Each record captures the specific terms that apply to that plant‑supplier pair, such as lead time, minimum order quantity, pricing, and quality requirements.. Existence Justification: Each manufacturing plant can source materials from multiple suppliers, and each supplier can serve multiple plants. The business manages these plant‑supplier links through contracts that capture lead times, minimum order quantities, pricing, and other terms. The relationship is actively created, updated, and tracked as a distinct agreement.

attributes.name: manufacturing_supply_agreement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the SupplyAgreement association

attributes.name: packaging_specification_id
attributes.description: Reference to the packaging spec used for shipments to this plant

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the plant

attributes.name: procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the supplier

attributes.name: procurement_supply_agreement_id
attributes.description: SSOT reference to procurement.procurement_supply_agreement (cross-domain duplicate reconciliation; procurement designated SSOT owner for supply_agreement).

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date the agreement was approved

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the agreement (e.g., Approved, Pending)

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date the agreement expires or is terminated

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date the agreement becomes effective

attributes.name: freight_terms
attributes.description: Freight terms agreed (e.g., FOB, CIF)

attributes.name: is_preferred_supplier
attributes.description: Flag indicating if this supplier is the preferred source for the plant

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days from order to delivery for this plant‑supplier pair

attributes.name: manufacturing_supply_agreement_status
attributes.description: Current status of the agreement (Active, Inactive, Suspended)

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity the supplier will accept for this plant

attributes.name: quality_rating
attributes.description: Quality rating assigned to the supplier for this plant

attributes.name: shipping_method
attributes.description: Preferred shipping method for deliveries

products.name: vehicle_mobility_subscription
products.description: Represents the contractual relationship between a vehicle build and a mobility service. Each record captures the period of subscription, billing details, status, and the service tier applicable to that vehicle.. Existence Justification: Each vehicle build can be subscribed to multiple mobility services (e.g., remote diagnostics, OTA updates) and each mobility service can be subscribed by many vehicle builds across the fleet. The subscription is an operational contract that is created, updated, and terminated by business users, and it carries its own attributes such as start/end dates, billing amount, and status.

attributes.name: vehicle_mobility_subscription_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the VehicleMobilitySubscription association

attributes.name: service_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the mobility service offering

attributes.name: service_tier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the pricing tier applicable to this subscription

attributes.name: vehicle_build_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the vehicle build record

attributes.name: billing_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount billed for the subscription period

attributes.name: subscription_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the vehicle's subscription to the service ends or is scheduled to end

attributes.name: subscription_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the vehicle's subscription to the service begins

attributes.name: vehicle_mobility_subscription_status
attributes.description: Current status of the subscription (e.g., active, suspended, cancelled)

products.name: compliance_certification
products.description: This association product records the compliance certification of a production order against a specific regulatory requirement. It captures the compliance status, supporting evidence document path, and the date the certification was achieved for each order‑requirement pair.. Existence Justification: Each production order must be verified against multiple regulatory requirements, and each regulatory requirement applies to many production orders. The compliance status, supporting evidence, and certification date are recorded for every order‑requirement pair, and quality engineers actively create, update, and delete these records as part of the manufacturing compliance process.

attributes.name: compliance_certification_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the ComplianceCertification association

attributes.name: compliance_emissions_certification_id
attributes.description: SSOT reference to compliance.compliance_emissions_certification (cross-domain duplicate reconciliation; compliance designated SSOT owner for certification).

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the production order

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_id

Captures plant-specific supplier data including delivery address, unloading point, JIT/JIS delivery flag, lead time, minimum order quantity, packaging specification reference, and plant-level approval status. Enables plant-level sourcing decisions and inbound logistics planning. Reflects the source system extension (LFM1/LFM2).

products.name: sourcing_event

Captures event type, commodity group, target spend, SOR (Statement of Requirements) reference, sourcing strategy (single-source, dual-source, competitive bid), event status, award decision date, nominated suppliers, and responsible buyer. Supports global sourcing strategy execution and the source system

products.name: purchase_requisition

Captures requisition number, requestor, cost center, plant, material/service description, quantity, required delivery date, estimated value, account assignment category (cost center, project, asset), approval status, and conversion-to-PO status. Represents the demand signal that initiates the procure-to-pay cycle. Sourced from the source system or manually created purchase requisitions (BANF/EBAN).

products.name: procurement_purchase_order
products.description: Legally binding procurement document issued to a supplier for delivery of direct materials, indirect materials, MRO, tooling, or services. Captures PO number, PO type (standard, blanket, consignment, subcontracting, service), supplier, plant, delivery date, incoterms, payment terms, total net value, currency, tax code, account assignment, approval workflow status, and GR/IR (Goods Receipt/Invoice Receipt) control flags. Core transactional entity of the procure-to-pay process. Sourced from the source system

products.name: supplier_contract
products.description: Long-term procurement contract (outline agreement) with a supplier covering pricing, volume commitments, delivery schedules, quality requirements, and commercial terms for direct or indirect materials. Serves as the foundational spend cube for category management, supplier rationalization, and savings tracking. Derived from confirmed goods receipts and posted invoices.

products.name: program_supplier_contract
products.description: Represents the contractual agreement between a vehicle development program and a supplier. Each record links one vehicle_program to one supplier and stores contract‑specific data that is relevant only to that pairing.. Existence Justification: Vehicle development programs engage multiple suppliers for parts, services, and components, and each supplier can provide for many different vehicle programs. The business creates and manages a contract for each program‑supplier pairing, capturing contract details such as number, type, effective dates, and price escalation clauses.

products.name: procurement_supply_agreement
products.description: Represents the contractual relationship between a supplier and a spare part catalog entry. Each record links one supplier to one spare part and stores attributes that are specific to that supplier‑part combination, such as price and lead time.. Existence Justification: A supplier can provide many spare parts, and each spare part can be sourced from multiple approved suppliers. The business actively manages a supply agreement for each supplier‑part pair, capturing unit price, lead time, and contract identifier. These agreements are created, updated, and retired as part of procurement planning.

Captures test date, test facility, drive cycle phases (low, medium, high, extra-high), CO2 emissions (g/km), fuel consumption (L/100km), electric range (km for EV/PHEV), NOx and particulate values, and homologation certificate reference. Supports EPA, CARB, and EU type-approval compliance.
products.reference: WLTP - Worldwide Harmonised Light Vehicles Test Procedure (UNECE R154)

products.name: ppm_record
products.description: Parts Per Million (PPM) defect rate record tracking supplier or internal process quality performance over a defined period. Captures supplier or plant code, part number, reporting period (month/quarter), total parts received or produced, total defective parts, PPM value, defect category breakdown, and trend vs. target. Supports supplier quality scorecards and IATF 16949 supplier monitoring requirements.

domains.name: logistics
domains.description: Outbound logistics and distribution including finished vehicle transportation, vehicle storage yards, compound operations, carrier management, and delivery scheduling. Manages vehicle shipment from plant to dealer, rail/truck/vessel logistics, port processing, last-mile delivery, and CKD/SKD kit logistics. products.name: vehicle_shipment_assignment
products.description: Represents the assignment of a connected vehicle to a specific outbound shipment. Each record captures the relationship between one shipment and one connected vehicle and includes attributes that are specific to that assignment, such as the vehicle's position in the container and its status within the shipment.. attributes.description: Method by which customer will take delivery of vehicle. Dealer pickup is standard; home delivery, port pickup (for imports), and factory pickup (for premium brands) are alternatives.

attributes.name: destination_charge
attributes.description: Freight and delivery charge from manufacturing plant to dealer. Typically a fixed amount per vehicle set by OEM.

attributes.name: doc_fee

attributes.name: down_payment

attributes.description: Internal code identifying the specific engine or electric motor configuration. Used for parts ordering and service documentation.

attributes.name: estimated_delivery_date
attributes.description: Estimated date when vehicle will be available for customer delivery. For in-stock vehicles, typically within days; for build-to-order, may be weeks or months.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the quote expires and pricing/terms are no longer valid. Typically 30-90 days from quote_date depending on market and vehicle type.

attributes.name: exterior_color_code
attributes.description: Code representing the exterior paint color selected by customer. Links to color master data and may affect pricing for premium colors.

attributes.description: Indicates whether financing terms are included in this quote. True if quote includes loan or lease options, false for cash-only quotes.

attributes.name: interior_color_code
attributes.description: Code representing the interior upholstery and trim color selected by customer.

attributes.name: lease_annual_mileage

attributes.name: lease_monthly_payment
attributes.description: Estimated monthly lease payment if lease is offered. Based on capitalized cost, residual value, money factor, and term.

attributes.name: lease_offered
attributes.description: Indicates whether lease terms are included in this quote as an alternative to purchase financing.

attributes.name: lease_term_months

attributes.name: model_year

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this quote record. Audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this quote record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates and revisions.

attributes.name: monthly_payment
attributes.description: Estimated monthly payment amount if financing is offered. Calculated from amount financed, APR, and term. Subject to credit approval.

attributes.name: msrp_base
attributes.description: Base MSRP for the vehicle model and trim before options, accessories, and destination charges. Published pricing from OEM.

attributes.description: Final vehicle price after all incentives and trade-in allowance. Calculated as subtotal_amount - incentive_total - trade_in_allowance + trade_in_payoff. Base for tax calculation.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments about the quote. May include special customer requests, configuration details, or sales rep observations.

attributes.description: Total value of factory-installed options and packages selected by customer (e.g., ADAS, premium audio, sunroof). Sum of individual option prices.

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Type of powertrain: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Critical for incentive eligibility and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: quote_date
attributes.description: Date when the quote was issued to the customer or prospect. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: quote_number

attributes.name: quote_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the quote. Tracks progression from draft through approval to conversion or expiry. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|rejected|expired|converted|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sales_region
attributes.description: Geographic sales region code where quote was issued. Used for regional pricing, incentive eligibility, and sales performance tracking.

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: Subtotal before incentives, trade-in, taxes, and fees. Calculated as msrp_base + options_total + accessories_total + destination_charge.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax calculated on net_selling_price based on customer delivery location jurisdiction. May include state, county, and local taxes.

attributes.description: Final total amount customer must pay. Calculated as net_selling_price + tax_amount + registration_fee + doc_fee. Used for financing calculation or cash payment.

attributes.description: Value credited to customer for trade-in vehicle. Based on used vehicle appraisal. Reduces amount due from customer.

attributes.description: Outstanding loan balance on trade-in vehicle that must be paid off. If greater than trade_in_allowance, creates negative equity rolled into new financing.

attributes.name: trade_in_vin
attributes.description: VIN of the customer's trade-in vehicle if applicable. Used for appraisal lookup and title transfer processing.

attributes.name: transmission_type
attributes.description: Type of transmission: manual, automatic, CVT (Continuously Variable Transmission), DCT (Dual Clutch Transmission), or single-speed (for EVs).

attributes.name: trim_level
attributes.description: Trim or grade level of the vehicle (e.g., Base, Sport, Luxury, Premium). Determines standard equipment and base pricing.

attributes.description: Version number of the quote. Increments when quote is revised with updated pricing, configuration, or terms. Supports quote revision history and audit trail.

attributes.description: Commission rate applied to this line item for sales representative compensation. Expressed as a decimal percentage. May vary by product type and sales program.

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: eligible_model_years

attributes.name: eligible_nameplates

attributes.name: eligible_powertrain_types

attributes.name: financing_type

attributes.name: government_contract_flag

attributes.name: gsa_schedule_number

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: lease_term_months
attributes.description: Duration of lease agreement in months if financing_type is lease. Typical fleet lease terms are 24, 36, or 48 months. Null for cash purchases.

attributes.name: maintenance_included_flag

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum number of vehicles that must be ordered in a single transaction to qualify for fleet contract pricing.

attributes.name: multi_location_delivery_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vehicles under this contract will be delivered to multiple locations. True for national fleet accounts with regional distribution.

attributes.name: national_fleet_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a national fleet account with centralized purchasing and multi-region delivery. National accounts receive special pricing and dedicated account management.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Standard payment terms governing when payment is due after vehicle delivery. Net 30/60/90 are common for corporate fleets; government contracts may have custom terms.

attributes.name: primary_delivery_location
attributes.description: Primary geographic location or facility where fleet vehicles will be delivered. May be a corporate headquarters, fleet depot, or distribution center.

attributes.name: remaining_volume
attributes.description: Number of vehicles remaining to be delivered under the committed volume. Calculated as committed_volume minus delivered_volume.

attributes.name: renewal_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this fleet contract is eligible for renewal upon expiration. Based on customer performance, payment history, and strategic account status.

attributes.name: sales_region

attributes.name: special_terms_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special terms, conditions, or negotiated provisions unique to this fleet contract that are not captured in standard fields.

attributes.name: termination_date

attributes.name: termination_reason

attributes.name: volume_tier_discount_percentage

attributes.name: warranty_extension_months

attributes.name: destination_country_code

attributes.name: fleet_use_type

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: trim_level

products.name: contract
products.description: Executed legal sales contract between the OEM or dealer and the customer formalizing the vehicle purchase or lease agreement. Captures contract type (retail purchase, lease, fleet purchase agreement, government contract), contract date, contracting parties, vehicle reference, agreed terms (price, financing, warranty, delivery), contract status (draft, executed, cancelled, completed), and document reference. Distinct from fleet_contract which is a pre-execution commercial framework; this is the executed legal instrument per transaction.
products.reference: SAP SD Contract (VA41) / Retail Purchase Agreement

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the executed sales contract. Primary key for the sales contract entity.

attributes.name: compliance_document_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_document. Business justification: Contracts must attach the specific compliance certification documents required for the vehicle sale.

attributes.name: contract_customer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who is the purchasing party in this sales contract. Links to the customer master data.

attributes.name: contract_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who is the purchasing party in this sales contract. Links to the customer master data.

attributes.name: contract_rep_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative who facilitated the contract execution. Links to employee or dealer personnel master data.

attributes.name: contract_sales_representative_rep_id
attributes.description: Reference to the sales representative who facilitated the contract execution. Links to employee or dealer personnel master data.

attributes.name: contract_vehicle_vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific vehicle being sold under this contract. Links to vehicle master data.

attributes.name: contract_vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific vehicle being sold under this contract. Links to vehicle master data.

attributes.name: dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership that facilitated or executed the sales contract. Null for direct OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) sales.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or manager who provided final approval for the contract. Null for contracts not requiring approval.

attributes.name: fleet_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the master fleet contract framework if this sales contract is executed under a pre-negotiated fleet agreement. Null for non-fleet transactions.

attributes.name: vehicle_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle order that preceded this contract. Links the contract to the original order placement.

attributes.name: agreed_price
attributes.description: The final negotiated selling price for the vehicle as agreed in the contract, before taxes and fees.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract received final internal approval from authorized personnel. Null for contracts not requiring approval.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_code
attributes.description: Reference to the user or manager who provided final approval for the contract. Null for contracts not requiring approval.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract was cancelled or voided. Null for active, completed, or terminated contracts.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the contract was cancelled. Includes customer request, financing denial, vehicle unavailability, or other business reasons. Null for non-cancelled contracts.
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Document Rejection Reasons

attributes.name: contract_date
attributes.description: The date when the sales contract was executed and became legally binding. This is the principal business event timestamp for the contract.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the sales contract. Used for customer communication, legal reference, and cross-system tracking.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the sales contract. Draft indicates initial creation, pending approval awaits authorization, executed means signed by all parties, active indicates in-force, completed means fulfilled, cancelled means voided before execution, terminated means ended after execution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|executed|active|completed|cancelled|terminated — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the sales contract indicating the nature of the transaction. Retail purchase is standard consumer sale, lease is rental agreement, fleet purchase is bulk commercial order, government contract is public sector procurement, commercial sale is business-to-business transaction, demo sale is demonstrator vehicle sale.

attributes.name: contracting_party_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the selling party (OEM or dealership) as it appears on the contract. Used for legal documentation and compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the contract record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this contract.

attributes.name: customer_legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the customer as it appears on the executed contract. May differ from customer master name for legal entities.

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: Scheduled or actual date when the vehicle is to be delivered to the customer as specified in the contract.

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: Physical location where the vehicle will be delivered to the customer. May be dealership address, customer address, or alternate location.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to the MSRP (Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price) to arrive at the agreed price. Includes dealer discounts and negotiated reductions.

attributes.name: document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URI to the physical or digital contract document stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: down_payment_amount
attributes.description: Initial payment made by the customer at contract execution. Null for full financing or lease agreements with no down payment.
attributes.references: Truth in Lending Act - Regulation Z

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the contract terms expire or the agreement concludes. Nullable for indefinite or single-transaction contracts.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the contract terms become effective and obligations begin. May differ from contract date for future-dated agreements.

attributes.name: fees_amount
attributes.description: Total additional fees included in the contract such as documentation fees, registration fees, delivery charges, and dealer administrative fees.

attributes.name: financing_term_months
attributes.description: Duration of the financing or lease agreement in months. Null for cash purchases.

attributes.name: financing_type
attributes.description: Method of payment or financing arrangement specified in the contract. Cash is full payment, loan is third-party financing, lease is rental agreement, captive finance is OEM financial services, third party finance is external lender, fleet finance is commercial fleet financing.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the contract was executed. Used for financial reporting and sales performance tracking.

attributes.name: incentive_amount
attributes.description: Total manufacturer or dealer incentives applied to this contract. Includes rebates, loyalty bonuses, conquest incentives, and promotional offers.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual percentage rate (APR) for financed purchases. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0499 for 4.99%). Null for cash purchases and leases.
attributes.references: Truth in Lending Act - Regulation Z

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Model year of the vehicle being sold. Represents the manufacturer's designated year for the vehicle model, which may differ from calendar year.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 - Model Year Definition

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the contract record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: monthly_payment_amount
attributes.description: Recurring monthly payment amount for financed or leased vehicles. Null for cash purchases.

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: The manufacturer's suggested retail price for the vehicle at the time of contract execution. Used for discount calculation and reporting.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Geographic region code where the contract was executed. Used for regional sales reporting and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: sales_channel
attributes.description: Distribution channel through which the sale was executed. Dealer retail is traditional dealership, direct OEM is manufacturer direct-to-consumer, fleet sales is commercial bulk, online is digital sales platform, auction is wholesale auction, broker is third-party intermediary.

attributes.name: signed_date
attributes.description: Date when all parties signed the contract and it became legally binding. May differ from contract date for backdated or future-dated agreements.

attributes.name: special_terms
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any special conditions, clauses, or negotiated terms specific to this contract that are not captured in standard fields.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax, value-added tax, or other government-mandated taxes applied to the transaction as specified in the contract.

attributes.name: total_contract_value
attributes.description: The total amount payable by the customer including agreed price, taxes, fees, less trade-in value. This is the final contract obligation amount.

attributes.name: trade_in_value
attributes.description: Agreed value of the customer's trade-in vehicle applied as credit toward the purchase. Null if no trade-in is involved.

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: The 17-character unique identifier assigned to the vehicle being sold. Globally unique identifier per ISO 3779 standard.
attributes.references: ISO 3779 - VIN Standard, NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565

attributes.name: warranty_mileage_limit
attributes.description: Maximum mileage covered under warranty terms. Expressed in miles or kilometers depending on region. Null if no mileage limit applies.

attributes.name: warranty_term_months
attributes.description: Duration of warranty coverage in months from delivery date. Null if no warranty is provided.

attributes.name: warranty_type
attributes.description: Type of warranty coverage included in the contract. Standard is manufacturer base warranty, extended is purchased additional coverage, certified pre-owned is CPO (Certified Pre-Owned) program warranty, none for as-is sales.

products.name: regional_sales_plan
products.description: Annual or quarterly sales volume and mix plan for a specific sales region or market zone, defining target unit volumes by nameplate, powertrain type (ICE/EV/HEV/PHEV), and channel. Supports top-down quota cascading and regional performance management. Distinct from individual quota records which are assigned to reps or dealers.

domains.name: dealer
domains.description: Dealer network management including dealer profiles, franchise agreements, territory assignments, and dealer performance scorecards. Manages dealer inventory allocation, vehicle allocation rules, dealer incentive programs, and DMS (Dealer Management System) integration. Tracks dealer sales performance, customer satisfaction scores, service capacity, and parts inventory at dealer locations. Supports both OEM-owned and independent franchise dealer models. Integrates with CDK Global DMS.

products.name: dealership
products.description: Master record for each dealer location in the OEM franchise network. Captures dealer legal entity, DMS (Dealer Management System) integration identifiers (CDK Global), franchise type (OEM-owned vs independent), physical address, contact details, operational status, market region, and channel classification. This is the SSOT for dealer identity across the enterprise.

attributes.name: dealership_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each dealer location in the OEM franchise network. Primary key for the dealership master record and the enterprise Single Source of Truth (SSOT) for dealer identity.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_account. Business justification: Required for finance: each dealership must be linked to its primary billing account for invoice generation and payment reconciliation, a standard practice in automotive dealer finance operations.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Financial consolidation reports require each dealership to be assigned to a legal company code for statutory reporting; dealers know their company code.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Expense allocation and internal budgeting are performed per dealership via a dedicated cost center; required for cost‑center expense statements.

attributes.name: payment_term_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.payment_term. Business justification: Required for billing: dealership default payment terms are needed for all invoices, enabling consistent net‑due days and discount calculations per dealer.

attributes.name: region_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dealer.dealer_region. Business justification: Dealerships are assigned to a region; add dealer_region_id FK to link each dealership to its region.

attributes.name: activation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the dealership was formally activated in the OEM dealer network and became eligible to receive vehicle allocations and participate in OEM programs.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; NHTSA Dealer Regulations

attributes.name: adas_certified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Certified Dealer Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealership is certified to perform Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) calibration and repair. Required for servicing vehicles equipped with cameras, radar, and LiDAR-based safety systems.
attributes.references: NHTSA FMVSS; Euro NCAP; SAE International

tag_set.value: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Certified Dealer Flag

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the dealership physical location. Used for logistics, customer navigation, regulatory filings, and Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) vehicle delivery coordination.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for the dealership (suite, unit, building number). Supplements address_line1 for precise location identification.

attributes.name: cdk_dealer_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: CDK Global Dealer Management System (DMS) Dealer ID
attributes.description: Unique dealer identifier assigned within the CDK Global Dealer Management System (DMS). This is the integration key used for all data exchanges between the OEM lakehouse and the CDK DMS platform including inventory, F&I, and service scheduling feeds.

tag_set.value: CDK Global Dealer Management System (DMS) Dealer ID

attributes.name: channel_classification
attributes.description: Categorizes the dealer's primary sales channel model. Retail covers traditional showroom sales; fleet covers B2B volume sales; agency model covers OEM-set pricing arrangements; export covers cross-border sales points.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City in which the dealership is physically located. Used for geographic market analysis, territory assignment, and customer proximity reporting.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the country in which the dealership is physically located (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX, GBR, DEU). Drives regulatory compliance, currency, and tax treatment.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the dealership was deactivated or terminated from the OEM dealer network. Nullable for currently active dealers. Used for franchise termination tracking and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: dealer_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code assigned by the OEM to uniquely identify the dealer location across all enterprise systems including the source system Global DMS, and the source system Used on all inter-system communications, vehicle allocations, and incentive programs.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA SD; IATF 16949

attributes.name: dealer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dealership within the OEM franchise network. Controls eligibility for vehicle allocation, incentive programs, and DMS integration. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|inactive|suspended|pending_approval|terminated|under_review — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NHTSA Dealer Regulations; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: dealer_tier
attributes.description: OEM-assigned performance tier classification for the dealership based on annual sales volume, customer satisfaction scores, and compliance metrics. Determines eligibility for premium vehicle allocations, co-op marketing funds, and incentive program tiers.

attributes.name: dms_go_live_date
attributes.description: Date on which the CDK Global DMS integration for this dealership went live and began transmitting data to the OEM enterprise systems. Used for integration tenure tracking and data completeness assessments.

attributes.name: dms_integration_status
attributes.description: Current status of the CDK Global DMS data integration feed for this dealership. Indicates whether real-time inventory, sales, and service data is flowing correctly into the OEM lakehouse.

attributes.name: ev_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealership has completed OEM Electric Vehicle (EV) certification requirements including technician training, charging infrastructure installation, and EV-specific tooling. Required for allocation of BEV and PHEV models.

attributes.name: ev_charger_count
attributes.description: Number of EV charging stations installed at the dealership for customer and demo vehicle use. Relevant for EV certification compliance and customer experience reporting.

attributes.name: franchise_agreement_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the active franchise agreement between the OEM and the dealer entity. Used to link the dealership master record to the franchise agreement contract for legal and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: franchise_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current franchise agreement is scheduled to expire or must be renewed. Nullable for perpetual agreements. Triggers renewal workflow when within the notice period.

attributes.name: franchise_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current franchise agreement between the OEM and the dealer became effective. Used for tenure calculations, renewal scheduling, and performance baseline setting.

attributes.name: franchise_type
attributes.description: Classification of the dealer's franchise arrangement with the OEM. Distinguishes OEM-owned (captive) outlets from independent franchise dealers, authorized repairers, fleet-only points, used vehicle specialists, and satellite locations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: oem_owned|independent_franchise|authorized_repairer|fleet_only|used_vehicle_only|satellite — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; NHTSA Dealer Regulations

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (WGS 84 decimal degrees) of the dealership location. Enables spatial analytics, territory mapping, and customer proximity calculations for dealer locator services.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full registered legal name of the dealer entity as recorded with the relevant state or national business registry. Used for franchise agreements, regulatory filings, and financial settlements.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (WGS 84 decimal degrees) of the dealership location. Enables spatial analytics, territory mapping, and customer proximity calculations for dealer locator services.

attributes.name: lot_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of vehicles that can be stored on the dealer lot (outdoor inventory storage). Used for vehicle allocation limits, inventory aging analysis, and logistics planning.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: market_region_code
attributes.description: OEM-defined market region code to which this dealership belongs (e.g., NORTHEAST, MIDWEST, SOUTHWEST, WEST, SOUTHEAST). Used for territory management, regional incentive programs, and sales performance reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: new_vehicle_sales_capacity
attributes.description: OEM-assessed annual new vehicle sales capacity (unit count) for this dealership based on facility size, staffing, and market area. Used as the denominator for allocation planning and sales target setting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: oem_brand_codes
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of OEM brand codes (e.g., BRAND_A|BRAND_B) that this dealership is franchised to sell and service. A single dealer point may hold multi-brand authorizations (e.g., passenger car and commercial vehicle brands).
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: ownership_group_name
attributes.description: Name of the dealer group or automotive retail group that owns this dealership location (e.g., AutoNation, Penske, Lithia). Enables group-level performance aggregation, consolidated incentive calculations, and multi-point dealer management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: parts_warehouse_area_sqm
attributes.description: Total floor area in square metres of the dealership's parts storage facility. Used for parts inventory capacity planning, MRP replenishment calculations, and Just-in-Time (JIT) parts delivery scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: pdi_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealership is certified to perform Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) on new vehicles prior to customer handover. PDI certification is required for new vehicle delivery authorization.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the dealership's physical location. Used for geographic market segmentation, territory boundary analysis, and customer catchment area reporting.

attributes.name: primary_email
attributes.description: Primary business email address for the dealership used for OEM communications, vehicle allocation notifications, incentive program updates, and Technical Service Bulletin (TSB) distribution.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: primary_phone
attributes.description: Main switchboard or primary contact telephone number for the dealership. Used for OEM-to-dealer communications, customer service escalations, and directory listings.

attributes.name: principal_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the primary OEM relationship contact at the dealership. Used for franchise communications, incentive program notifications, and regulatory bulletin distribution.

attributes.name: principal_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the primary OEM relationship contact at the dealership (typically the Dealer Principal or General Manager). Used for OEM communications, franchise agreement correspondence, and escalation routing.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the dealership master record was first created in the enterprise data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record age analysis.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the dealership master record in the enterprise data platform. Follows ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change detection, data freshness monitoring, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: sales_district_code
attributes.description: OEM-defined sales district code representing the sub-regional territory assignment for this dealership. Used for district sales manager (DSM) alignment, vehicle allocation quotas, and performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: sap_customer_number
attributes.description: the source system master number (SD module) assigned to this dealership for vehicle order processing, invoicing, and financial settlement. Links dealership to the source system orders and FI accounts receivable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: service_bay_count
attributes.description: Total number of service bays available at the dealership for vehicle maintenance and repair operations. Used for after-sales capacity planning, warranty repair throughput analysis, and service scheduling optimization.

attributes.name: showroom_display_capacity
attributes.description: Maximum number of vehicles that can be displayed simultaneously in the dealership showroom. Used for vehicle allocation planning, demo fleet sizing, and facility investment decisions.

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-2 state or province code for the dealership's physical location (e.g., CA, TX, NY, ON). Used for CAFE compliance reporting, CARB emissions zone classification, and state-level dealer franchise law compliance.

attributes.name: trading_name
attributes.description: The public-facing 'doing business as' (DBA) name of the dealership as displayed to customers, on signage, and in marketing materials. May differ from the legal entity name.

attributes.name: used_vehicle_sales_capacity
attributes.description: OEM-assessed annual used vehicle sales capacity (unit count) for this dealership. Used for certified pre-owned (CPO) program eligibility and used vehicle allocation planning.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: warranty_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealership is authorized to perform OEM warranty repairs and submit warranty claims. Drives warranty claim processing eligibility in the source system DMS.
attributes.references: IATF 16949; CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: Public-facing website URL for the dealership. Used for digital marketing integration, online inventory syndication, and customer-facing dealer locator services.

products.name: franchise_agreement
products.description: Formal franchise contract between the OEM and an independent or OEM-owned dealer. Tracks agreement effective dates, expiration, renewal terms, franchise tier, authorized vehicle lines (nameplates), territory rights, performance obligations, and agreement status. Supports both new franchise grants and renewals.

attributes.name: franchise_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the franchise agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: franchise_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer entity that is party to this franchise agreement.

attributes.name: franchise_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer entity that is party to this franchise agreement.

attributes.name: agreement_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all financial terms in the franchise agreement (quotas, fees, investment requirements). Example: USD, EUR, JPY.

attributes.name: agreement_document_url
attributes.description: Secure URL or file path to the digitally stored franchise agreement contract document (PDF or scanned image).

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the franchise agreement, typically including dealer name and location.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the franchise agreement. Format: FA-NNNNNNNN.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the franchise agreement: draft (being negotiated), pending approval (awaiting OEM sign-off), active (in force), suspended (temporarily inactive), terminated (ended before expiration), or expired (reached end date).

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the franchise agreement based on its purpose: new franchise grant, renewal of existing agreement, amendment to terms, territory expansion, or termination agreement.

attributes.name: allocation_priority_tier
attributes.description: Priority tier for vehicle inventory allocation. Higher tiers receive preferential allocation of high-demand models and limited-production vehicles. Tier 1 = highest priority.

attributes.name: authorized_nameplates
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of vehicle nameplates (brands, model lines) that the dealer is authorized to sell under this franchise agreement. Examples: Sedan, SUV, Truck, EV (Electric Vehicle), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle).

attributes.name: authorized_vehicle_lines
attributes.description: Specific vehicle lines or series the dealer is authorized to sell, such as luxury, commercial, electric, or performance segments.

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the franchise agreement automatically renews at expiration unless either party provides notice. True = auto-renews, False = requires explicit renewal.

attributes.name: certified_pre_owned_authorized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer is authorized to sell OEM-certified pre-owned vehicles under the manufacturer's CPO program. True = authorized, False = not authorized.

attributes.name: commercial_fleet_authorized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer is authorized to sell vehicles to commercial fleet customers and participate in fleet sales programs. True = authorized, False = not authorized.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this franchise agreement record was first created in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_target_score
attributes.description: Minimum Net Promoter Score (NPS) or customer satisfaction score the dealer must achieve to maintain franchise agreement in good standing. Typically measured on a scale of 0-100.

attributes.name: dealer_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the dealer authorized representative (typically dealer principal or owner) who signed the franchise agreement.

attributes.name: digital_retailing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer must offer digital retailing capabilities (online sales, virtual showroom, e-commerce) as required by the franchise agreement. True = required, False = optional.

attributes.name: dms_integration_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dealer Management System (DMS) Integration Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer must integrate their DMS (Dealer Management System) with OEM systems for real-time inventory, sales, and service data sharing. True = required, False = optional.

tag_set.value: Dealer Management System (DMS) Integration Required Flag

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the franchise agreement becomes legally binding and operational. Marks the start of the dealer's franchise rights and obligations.

attributes.name: ev_charging_infrastructure_required_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging Infrastructure Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer must install and maintain EV (Electric Vehicle) charging infrastructure at their facility as a condition of selling electric or hybrid vehicles. True = required, False = optional.

tag_set.value: Electric Vehicle (EV) Charging Infrastructure Required Flag

attributes.name: exclusive_territory_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer has exclusive rights to sell in the assigned territory. True = exclusive (no other dealers in territory), False = non-exclusive (shared territory).

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the franchise agreement is scheduled to end. Nullable for open-ended or perpetual agreements subject to performance review.

attributes.name: facility_investment_requirement_amount
attributes.description: Minimum capital expenditure (CapEx) the dealer must invest in facility improvements, showroom standards, service equipment, and infrastructure to meet OEM brand standards.

attributes.name: franchise_tier
attributes.description: Tier or level of the franchise agreement indicating dealer status, privileges, and performance expectations. Higher tiers typically receive preferential allocation and incentives.

attributes.name: governing_law_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Legal jurisdiction and governing law that applies to the franchise agreement, typically the state or country where the dealer operates or where the OEM is headquartered.

attributes.name: incentive_program_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer is eligible to participate in OEM dealer incentive programs, volume bonuses, and performance rewards. True = eligible, False = not eligible.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this franchise agreement record was last updated in the system. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: minimum_sales_quota_annual
attributes.description: Minimum number of vehicle units the dealer must sell annually to maintain franchise agreement in good standing. Performance obligation defined in agreement.

attributes.name: minimum_service_capacity
attributes.description: Minimum number of vehicles the dealer must be capable of servicing per month to meet franchise agreement service obligations.

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days advance notice required by either party to terminate or not renew the franchise agreement. Typical values are 30, 60, 90, or 180 days.

attributes.name: oem_signatory_name
attributes.description: Full name of the OEM authorized representative who signed the franchise agreement on behalf of the manufacturer.

attributes.name: ownership_model
attributes.description: Classification of dealer ownership structure: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) owned, independent franchise, joint venture, or corporate store.

attributes.name: parts_inventory_requirement_amount
attributes.description: Minimum dollar value of OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) parts inventory the dealer must maintain at all times to meet franchise agreement obligations.

attributes.name: performance_review_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the OEM conducts formal performance reviews of the dealer against franchise agreement obligations and performance metrics.

attributes.name: recall_service_authorized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer is authorized to perform recall repairs and service campaigns issued by the OEM or NHTSA (National Highway Traffic Safety Administration). True = authorized, False = not authorized.

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: Date when the franchise agreement was last renewed or is scheduled for renewal review. Used for tracking renewal cycles.

attributes.name: renewal_term_months
attributes.description: Duration in months for each renewal period of the franchise agreement. Typical values are 12, 24, 36, or 60 months.

attributes.name: signed_date
attributes.description: Date when the franchise agreement was formally signed by both the dealer and OEM authorized representatives, making it legally binding.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the franchise agreement was terminated, if applicable. Populated only for agreements that ended before their scheduled expiration.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation of why the franchise agreement was terminated early, including performance issues, dealer request, market consolidation, or regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: territory_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the geographic territory assigned to the dealer under this franchise agreement, including cities, counties, postal codes, or radius from dealer location.

attributes.name: territory_radius_km
attributes.description: Radius in kilometers from the dealer's primary location defining the franchise territory boundary, if territory is defined by radius rather than geographic boundaries.

attributes.name: training_certification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether dealer staff must complete OEM-mandated training and certification programs as a condition of the franchise agreement. True = required, False = optional.

attributes.name: warranty_administration_authorized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer is authorized to process and submit warranty claims on behalf of customers under OEM warranty programs. True = authorized, False = not authorized.

products.name: dealer_territory
products.description: Geographic sales territory assigned to a dealership. Defines primary area of responsibility (PAR), zip/postal code coverage, county or region boundaries, territory type (exclusive, shared, open), effective dates, and overlap rules. Used for vehicle allocation, market representation planning, and dealer performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: dealer_territory_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dealer territory assignment. Primary key.

attributes.name: franchise_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the franchise agreement that governs this territory assignment. Links territory rights to contractual terms.
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Dealer Franchise Agreements

attributes.name: jurisdiction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Territory planning aligns with the legal jurisdiction for emissions and safety regulations; linking enables jurisdiction‑specific reporting.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Territory manager assignment needed for territory performance reporting and incentive eligibility.

attributes.name: primary_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership that owns or is assigned this territory.

attributes.name: sales_territory_id
attributes.description: SSOT reference to sales.sales_territory (cross-domain duplicate reconciliation; sales designated SSOT owner for territory).

attributes.name: allocation_quota_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of regional or national vehicle allocation assigned to this territory. Sum of all territory percentages within a region should equal 100.
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Vehicle Allocation Rules

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the territory assignment or modification was formally approved by OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) management.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) executive or manager who approved this territory assignment or modification.
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Approval Authority Matrix

attributes.name: city_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of cities or municipalities included in the territory coverage area.

attributes.name: competitive_intensity_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of competitive pressure within the territory based on number of competing brands, dealer density, and market saturation.
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Market Analysis Standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the territory location (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX).

attributes.name: county_region
attributes.description: County, district, or regional subdivision name within the state/province that defines part of the territory boundary.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this territory assignment record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: dms_integration_status
attributes.description: Status of territory data synchronization with the dealer's DMS (Dealer Management System), specifically CDK Global DMS. Indicates whether territory boundaries are reflected in dealer systems.

attributes.name: dms_last_sync_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dealer Management System (DMS) Last Synchronization Timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the last successful synchronization of territory data with the dealer's DMS (Dealer Management System). Used to monitor data freshness and integration health.

tag_set.value: Dealer Management System (DMS) Last Synchronization Timestamp

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the territory assignment expires or is terminated. Null indicates an open-ended assignment.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the territory assignment becomes active and the dealer assumes responsibility for the defined area.

attributes.name: geographic_boundary_description
attributes.description: Textual description of territory boundaries using landmarks, highways, or natural features (e.g., 'North of I-40, East of Highway 101').
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Territory Management Standards

attributes.name: household_count_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated number of households within the territory. Used for market penetration analysis and vehicle allocation planning.

attributes.name: incentive_program_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether dealers in this territory are eligible for special OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) incentive programs or bonuses. True = eligible; False = not eligible.
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Dealer Incentive Programs

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this territory assignment record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date when the territory assignment was last reviewed or audited by OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) management. Used to track compliance with periodic review requirements.

attributes.name: manager_email
attributes.description: Email address of the OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) territory manager. Used for dealer communications and escalations.

attributes.name: manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) regional or territory manager responsible for overseeing this territory and dealer relationship.

attributes.name: manager_phone
attributes.description: Contact phone number for the OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) territory manager.
