attributes.name: market_segment_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the territory market type based on population density and urbanization level. Influences vehicle mix allocation and marketing strategies.
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Market Segmentation Standards

attributes.name: modification_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for the most recent change to the territory assignment (e.g., market expansion, dealer consolidation, performance adjustment).
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Territory Management Standards

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next territory assignment review. Ensures regular evaluation of territory boundaries and dealer performance.

attributes.name: overlap_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this territory can overlap with other dealer territories. True allows shared coverage; False enforces exclusive boundaries.
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Dealer Franchise Agreements

attributes.name: overlap_rule_description
attributes.description: Business rules governing how overlapping territories are managed, including priority rules, customer assignment logic, and conflict resolution procedures.
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Territory Management Standards

attributes.name: performance_benchmark_group
attributes.description: Peer group or cohort used for dealer performance benchmarking. Territories with similar characteristics are grouped for fair comparison.
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Dealer Performance Standards

attributes.name: population_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated total population within the territory boundaries. Used for market sizing and dealer performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: postal_code_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated or range-based list of postal/zip codes included in the territory (e.g., '90001-90099,91000'). Used for precise geographic allocation.
attributes.references: Universal Postal Union - Postal Code Standards

attributes.name: primary_area_of_responsibility
attributes.description: Geographic description of the core territory where the dealer has primary sales and service responsibility. May include city names, county boundaries, or regional descriptors.
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Dealer Franchise Agreements

attributes.name: sales_potential_index
attributes.description: Numeric index representing the relative sales potential of the territory compared to a baseline (e.g., 100 = average, 150 = 50% above average). Used for vehicle allocation and quota setting.
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Market Analysis Standards

attributes.name: special_program_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing any special programs, pilot initiatives, or unique conditions applicable to this territory (e.g., EV (Electric Vehicle) launch market, rural incentive zone).
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Territory Management Standards

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: Two or three-letter code for the state, province, or administrative region (e.g., CA, TX, ON).

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric code identifying the territory within the dealer network. Used for vehicle allocation and market planning.
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Territory Management Standards

attributes.name: territory_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name or description of the territory (e.g., 'Metro East Region', 'Downtown District').
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Territory Management Standards

attributes.name: territory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the territory assignment. Active territories are operational; pending awaits approval; suspended is temporarily halted; terminated is closed.
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Territory Management Standards

attributes.name: territory_type
attributes.description: Classification of territory assignment model: exclusive (single dealer), shared (multiple dealers), open (no restrictions), primary (main responsibility), secondary (backup coverage), overlay (special program).
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Dealer Franchise Agreements

attributes.name: vehicle_allocation_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for vehicle inventory allocation to this territory. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used during supply constraints.
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Vehicle Allocation Rules

products.name: dealer_certification
products.description: Tracks OEM-issued certifications and program enrollments for a dealership, such as EV-certified dealer, ADAS service authorization, luxury brand certification, and IATF 16949 compliance status. Includes certification type, issuing body, issue date, expiry date, renewal requirements, and current status. Drives eligibility for vehicle allocation and incentive programs.
products.reference: OEM Dealer Standards and Certification Program

attributes.name: dealer_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dealer certification record. Primary key.

attributes.name: compliance_emissions_certification_id
attributes.description: SSOT reference to compliance.compliance_emissions_certification (cross-domain duplicate reconciliation; compliance designated SSOT owner for certification).

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_obligation. Business justification: Regulatory compliance requires each dealer certification to be linked to the specific compliance obligation it satisfies, enabling audit of certification against obligations.

attributes.name: primary_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership that holds this certification. Links to the dealer master record.

attributes.name: allocation_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification makes the dealer eligible for preferential vehicle allocation (e.g., EV-certified dealers receive priority allocation of electric vehicles).
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Dealer Program Standards

attributes.name: annual_maintenance_cost_amount
attributes.description: Estimated annual cost to maintain this certification, including renewal fees, ongoing training, and audit costs. Expressed in the OEM's reporting currency.

attributes.name: audit_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the most recent audit (e.g., passed, passed with conditions, failed). Determines whether certification remains in good standing.

attributes.name: audit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer must undergo periodic audits to maintain this certification.

attributes.name: audit_score
attributes.description: Numerical score or rating achieved in the most recent audit (e.g., 0-100 scale, or percentage). Reflects compliance quality and performance.

attributes.name: authorized_vehicle_lines
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of vehicle model lines or platforms the dealer is authorized to sell or service under this certification (e.g., 'Model S, Model X, Model 3' for EV certification).

attributes.name: certification_level
attributes.description: Tier or grade of certification achieved by the dealer within a tiered program (e.g., Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum). Higher levels may unlock additional benefits.
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Dealer Program Standards

attributes.name: certification_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the certification program or credential (e.g., 'Electric Vehicle Sales and Service Certification', 'Advanced Driver Assistance Systems Authorized Service Center').

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: Unique alphanumeric identifier assigned by the issuing body for this certification. Externally-known business identifier.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certification. Determines whether the dealer is currently authorized under this certification program.
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Dealer Program Standards

attributes.name: certification_type
attributes.description: Category of certification awarded to the dealer. Defines the specialized capability or program enrollment (e.g., EV-certified dealer, ADAS service authorization, luxury brand certification).
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Dealer Program Standards

attributes.name: compliance_standard
attributes.description: Name of the industry standard or regulatory framework this certification demonstrates compliance with (e.g., IATF 16949, ISO 9001, EPA emissions standards, NHTSA safety standards).

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred by the dealer to obtain this certification, including training, equipment, facility upgrades, and application fees. Expressed in the OEM's reporting currency.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the certification becomes active and the dealer is authorized to operate under this certification. May differ from issue date if there is a grace period.

attributes.name: equipment_requirements
attributes.description: Description of specialized tools, diagnostic equipment, or technology the dealer must possess for this certification (e.g., high-voltage battery diagnostic tools, ADAS radar calibration systems).

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when the certification expires and the dealer must renew to maintain authorization. Nullable for certifications with no expiration.

attributes.name: facility_requirements
attributes.description: Description of physical facility requirements the dealer must meet for this certification (e.g., dedicated EV charging bays, ADAS calibration equipment, climate-controlled service area).

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic coverage level of this certification (e.g., global, regional, national, state/provincial, local). Defines where the certification is recognized.

attributes.name: incentive_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this certification qualifies the dealer for special incentive programs, rebates, or performance bonuses.
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Dealer Program Standards

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the certification was originally issued to the dealer. Marks the start of the certification validity period.

attributes.name: issuing_body
attributes.description: Name of the organization or authority that issued the certification (e.g., OEM corporate, IATF, SAE International, regional OEM division).

attributes.name: issuing_body_type
attributes.description: Classification of the entity that issued the certification (e.g., OEM corporate, industry association, regulatory body, third-party auditor).

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent audit conducted for this certification. Used to track audit compliance and schedule next audit.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this certification record was most recently updated. Audit trail for data lineage and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_renewal_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent renewal or recertification event. Tracks ongoing compliance and re-qualification.

attributes.name: minimum_certified_technicians
attributes.description: Minimum number of technicians who must hold individual certification credentials for the dealer to maintain this certification.

attributes.name: next_audit_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next audit must be completed to maintain certification compliance.

attributes.name: next_renewal_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the dealer must complete renewal requirements to maintain active certification status. Used for proactive renewal management.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special conditions, or contextual information about this certification record.

attributes.name: personnel_requirements
attributes.description: Description of staffing requirements for this certification (e.g., minimum number of certified technicians, specific role qualifications, training credentials).

attributes.name: reinstatement_date
attributes.description: Date when a previously suspended certification was reinstated to active status. Nullable if never suspended or not yet reinstated.

attributes.name: renewal_frequency_months
attributes.description: Number of months between required renewal cycles for this certification (e.g., 12 for annual, 24 for biennial, 36 for triennial).

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date when the certification was permanently revoked. Nullable if never revoked.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the certification was permanently revoked, if applicable (e.g., serious compliance violations, fraudulent activity, repeated failures). Nullable if never revoked.
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Dealer Program Standards

attributes.name: suspension_date
attributes.description: Date when the certification was suspended. Nullable if never suspended.

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the certification was suspended, if applicable (e.g., failed audit, non-compliance with training requirements, facility deficiencies). Nullable if never suspended.
attributes.references: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) Dealer Program Standards

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the dealer completed the required training program for this certification. Nullable if training is not required or not yet completed.

attributes.name: training_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether dealer personnel must complete specific training programs to obtain or maintain this certification.

products.name: vehicle_allocation
products.description: Records the OEM's allocation of specific vehicle units (by VIN or allocation batch) to a dealership for a given model year and production period. Captures allocation quantity, nameplate, trim, powertrain type (ICE/HEV/PHEV/EV), allocation rule applied, priority tier, acceptance status, and delivery window. Core operational record linking manufacturing output to dealer inventory pipeline.
products.reference: OEM Vehicle Allocation and Distribution System

attributes.name: vehicle_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each vehicle allocation record linking a specific vehicle unit or allocation batch from OEM manufacturing output to a dealership inventory pipeline.

attributes.name: production_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing production order that produced the allocated vehicle units. Links manufacturing output to dealer allocation pipeline.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Allocation planning reports require linking each allocated vehicle to its SKU for capacity, cost, and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: vehicle_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership receiving this vehicle allocation. Links to the dealer master record in the dealer network.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: vehicle_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership receiving this vehicle allocation. Links to the dealer master record in the dealer network.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: acceptance_deadline
attributes.description: Date by which the dealer must formally accept or reject this allocation. Failure to respond by this date may result in automatic acceptance or reallocation per OEM dealer agreement terms.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Franchise Agreement; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: acceptance_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact timestamp when the dealer formally accepted this vehicle allocation via the dealer portal or DMS integration. Provides precise audit trail for dealer commitment.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; Salesforce Automotive Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: accepted_quantity
attributes.description: Number of vehicle units formally accepted by the dealer from this allocation. May be less than allocated_quantity if the dealer partially accepts or rejects units.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Actual date the allocated vehicle(s) were physically delivered to and received by the dealership. Used for On-Time Delivery (OTD) performance measurement and dealer satisfaction tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS; OTD KPI Standards

attributes.name: allocation_batch_number
attributes.description: Identifier grouping multiple allocation records issued in the same OEM allocation run or production release cycle. Enables batch-level tracking, reporting, and dealer communication.

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The business event date on which the OEM formally allocated the vehicle unit(s) to the dealership. Represents the principal real-world event time for this transaction.

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this allocation transaction, used in dealer communications, DMS integration, and OEM-dealer correspondence. Format: ALLOC-{MY}-{sequence}.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: allocation_rule_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific allocation rule or algorithm applied to determine this dealer's vehicle entitlement (e.g., turn-and-earn, market share, historical sales, regional quota). Drives transparency and auditability of allocation decisions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; OEM Dealer Agreement Standards

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the vehicle allocation record. Tracks progression from OEM-initiated pending through dealer acceptance or rejection to final delivery confirmation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the allocation purpose: standard retail inventory, priority customer order fulfillment, constrained supply allocation, fleet customer, dealer demonstrator vehicle, or loaner vehicle program.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allocation record was first captured in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this allocation record (MSRP, dealer invoice price, incentive amounts). Supports multi-currency dealer networks in international markets.

attributes.name: dealer_invoice_price
attributes.description: The price at which the OEM invoices the dealer for the allocated vehicle, net of holdback and before dealer incentives. Represents the dealer's cost basis for inventory financing and margin calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD FI; CDK Global DMS F&I Module

attributes.name: dms_reference_number
attributes.description: The corresponding allocation or stock order reference number in the dealer's CDK Global Dealer Management System (DMS). Enables end-to-end reconciliation between OEM allocation records and dealer inventory systems.

attributes.name: estimated_delivery_date
attributes.description: Estimated date the allocated vehicle(s) are expected to arrive at the dealership. Calculated based on production schedule, transport lead time, and PDI processing time. Communicated to dealers for inventory planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS; OTD Standards

attributes.name: hold_code
attributes.description: Code indicating any active hold placed on the allocated vehicle(s) preventing retail sale (e.g., safety recall hold, quality hold, regulatory compliance hold, stop-sale order). Null when no hold is active. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: safety_recall|quality_hold|regulatory|stop_sale|tsb_hold|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NHTSA Recall Regulations; SAP S/4HANA QM; IATF 16949

attributes.name: incentive_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the dealer incentive or bonus applicable to this specific allocation record. Represents the financial benefit to the dealer for accepting and retailing this vehicle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Rebate Management; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: incentive_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the OEM dealer incentive program applicable to this allocation (e.g., volume bonus, stair-step program, conquest incentive). Links to the dealer incentive program master for payout calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Rebate Management; OEM Dealer Incentive Policy

attributes.name: is_customer_order
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation is fulfilling a specific retail customer order (sold order) rather than being allocated to dealer stock inventory. Drives order fulfillment priority and customer communication workflows.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) for the allocated vehicle unit in the base transaction currency. Used for dealer invoice calculation, incentive program application, and consumer pricing guidance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing; FTC Dealer Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, special handling instructions, or dealer-specific comments associated with this allocation record. Used by zone managers and dealer relations teams.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: pdi_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) has been completed for the allocated vehicle(s) at the dealership. Required before vehicle can be retailed to a customer.
attributes.references: IATF 16949; OEM PDI Standards; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: pdi_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) is required for the allocated vehicle(s) before retail handover. Drives dealer service scheduling and PDI cost recovery processes.
attributes.references: IATF 16949; OEM PDI Standards; CDK Global DMS Service Module

attributes.name: port_of_entry_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the port or processing compound through which imported or CKD/SKD vehicles pass before onward delivery to the dealer. Relevant for international allocation flows and customs compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Import; UNECE Vehicle Regulations; DOT

attributes.name: priority_tier
attributes.description: Dealer priority tier assigned for this allocation cycle, determining precedence when vehicle supply is constrained. Tier 1 dealers receive first allocation rights based on performance metrics, sales volume, or strategic importance.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Network Policy; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: production_plant_code
attributes.description: the source system identifying the manufacturing facility where the allocated vehicle(s) were or will be produced. Used for logistics routing, transport cost calculation, and supply chain traceability.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: OEM regional zone code (e.g., NORTHEAST, SOUTHEAST, CENTRAL, WEST) grouping territories for macro-level allocation planning, regional incentive programs, and zone manager oversight.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; OEM Regional Distribution Policy

attributes.name: rejection_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the dealer's reason for rejecting this allocation (e.g., excess inventory, wrong specification, cash flow constraints, market demand mismatch). Null when allocation is accepted. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: excess_inventory|wrong_spec|cash_flow|demand_mismatch|facility_capacity|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; OEM Dealer Agreement Standards

attributes.name: scheduled_production_date
attributes.description: Planned date on which the allocated vehicle unit(s) are scheduled to enter the production line. Derived from the Start of Production (SOP) schedule and used for delivery window planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP; Apriso/Dassault MES; APQP Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this allocation record. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and multi-system integration auditing across the source system CDK Global DMS, and the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: OEM-defined sales territory code within which the dealer operates. Used for regional allocation quota management, zone-level supply balancing, and territory performance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; Salesforce Automotive Cloud Territory Management

attributes.name: transport_mode
attributes.description: Primary mode of transportation used to deliver the allocated vehicle(s) from the production plant or port of entry to the dealership. Drives logistics cost allocation and delivery lead time estimation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Transportation Management; DOT Regulations

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this allocation record. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) assigned to a specific vehicle unit within this allocation. Populated for unit-level allocations; null for batch-level allocations where VINs are not yet assigned.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; ISO 3779; SAE J272

products.name: allocation_rule
products.description: Business rules governing how vehicles are distributed across the dealer network. Defines rule type (volume-based, performance-based, geographic, model mix), applicable nameplates, MY (Model Year), priority weighting, minimum and maximum allocation thresholds, and effective period. Used by the allocation engine to generate vehicle_allocation records.

attributes.name: allocation_rule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the vehicle allocation rule record in the dealer network management system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: dealer_incentive_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer incentive program that this allocation rule is linked to. When allocation_basis is incentive-based, dealers enrolled in the referenced program receive preferential allocation treatment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Rebate Management; CDK Global DMS; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: superseded_by_rule_allocation_rule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the allocation_rule_id of the newer rule that replaces this rule when it is superseded. Null if this rule has not been replaced. Enables rule lineage tracking across model year and program transitions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: allocation_basis
attributes.description: The primary metric or data source used to calculate each dealer's share of the total allocation pool under this rule. Retail sales uses prior-period retail units sold; wholesale_orders uses dealer order history; days_supply targets a specific inventory days-supply level; market_share uses regional market penetration; scorecard_rank uses the dealer performance scorecard ranking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: allocation_cycle
attributes.description: Frequency at which the allocation engine applies this rule to generate vehicle_allocation records. Determines the cadence of dealer inventory replenishment under this rule.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS Production Scheduling

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status of the allocation rule. Rules must be approved before transitioning to active status. Supports multi-level OEM approval workflows for allocation policy governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Workflow; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the OEM personnel who approved this allocation rule for activation. Supports audit trail and governance requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; IATF 16949 Document Control

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which this allocation rule received final approval and was authorized for activation in the allocation engine.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Workflow; IATF 16949 Document Control

attributes.name: body_style
attributes.description: Body style segment to which this allocation rule applies. Used to enforce model mix targets across the dealer network. 'all' indicates the rule applies regardless of body style. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sedan|suv|truck|van|coupe|convertible|wagon|all — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAE J1100; SAP S/4HANA MM Product Classification

attributes.name: carryover_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether unallocated units from a prior cycle can be carried over and added to the next cycle's pool under this rule. True enables carryover; False requires the pool to be reset each cycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS Inventory Rollover

attributes.name: conflict_resolution
attributes.description: Method used by the allocation engine when this rule conflicts with another active rule for the same dealer and nameplate. Highest_priority applies the rule with the highest priority_weight; sum combines allocations; average takes the mean; manual flags for human review.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS Allocation Engine

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this allocation rule record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Record Control; ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: dealer_tier
attributes.description: Dealer performance tier classification to which this rule applies. Tier 1 dealers (top performers) typically receive preferential allocation; Tier 2 and Tier 3 receive proportionally lower allocations. 'all' applies the rule across all tiers.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; Salesforce Automotive Cloud Dealer Portal

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The calendar date from which this allocation rule becomes active and is applied by the allocation engine to generate vehicle_allocation records. Aligns with OEM model year launch or program start dates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Validity Period; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The calendar date after which this allocation rule is no longer applied by the allocation engine. Null indicates an open-ended rule with no defined expiry. Typically aligned with model year end or program end dates.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Validity Period; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: eop_date
attributes.description: End of Production (EOP) date for the model year and nameplate covered by this rule. Allocation rules are typically deactivated at or after EOP to manage wind-down inventory distribution.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP; APQP Standards

attributes.name: external_rule_ref
attributes.description: The rule identifier or document reference as recorded in the originating source system (e.g., the source system number, CDK rule ID). Enables cross-system reconciliation and traceability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Records; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: franchise_type
attributes.description: Dealer franchise model to which this rule applies: OEM-owned (factory store), independent franchise, dual franchise (carrying multiple OEM brands), or 'all' for rules spanning all franchise types.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; Salesforce Automotive Cloud; DOT Franchise Regulations

attributes.name: lookback_period_days
attributes.description: Number of historical days used to calculate the allocation basis metric (e.g., 90 days of retail sales history). Defines the rolling window for performance-based and volume-based allocation calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS Analytics

attributes.name: max_allocation_units
attributes.description: Maximum number of vehicle units that can be allocated to a qualifying dealer under this rule per allocation cycle. Prevents over-concentration of inventory at high-volume dealers and supports equitable network distribution.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA SD; Dealer Franchise Agreement

attributes.name: min_allocation_units
attributes.description: Minimum number of vehicle units that must be allocated to a qualifying dealer under this rule per allocation cycle. Ensures floor-level inventory support for smaller dealers and contractual franchise minimums.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA SD; Dealer Franchise Agreement

attributes.name: min_csi_score
attributes.description: Minimum Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI) score a dealer must maintain to qualify for allocation under this rule. CSI is measured via OEM customer surveys post-purchase and post-service. Dealers below this threshold may be excluded or receive reduced allocation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud CRM; J.D. Power CSI Standards; NHTSA Consumer Satisfaction

attributes.name: min_scorecard_score
attributes.description: Minimum dealer performance scorecard score required for a dealer to qualify for allocation under this rule. Used for performance-based rules to restrict allocation to dealers meeting OEM performance standards.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; CDK Global DMS; IATF 16949 Dealer Standards

attributes.name: model_mix_target_pct
attributes.description: Target percentage of the allocated units that should be of the specified nameplate or powertrain type within the dealer's total inventory mix. Used for model_mix rule types to enforce portfolio balance (e.g., 20% EV mix target).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CAFE Standards; CARB ZEV Mandate

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The vehicle Model Year (MY) to which this allocation rule applies, expressed as a four-digit calendar year (e.g., 2024, 2025). Aligns with OEM production planning cycles and the source system model year configuration.
attributes.references: NHTSA MY Definition; SAP S/4HANA PP; UNECE Vehicle Regulations

attributes.name: nameplate_code
attributes.description: OEM-assigned code identifying the vehicle nameplate (model line) to which this allocation rule applies (e.g., F-150, Silverado, Camry, Model 3). Corresponds to the nameplate/model line in the PLM system.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SAP S/4HANA MM; NHTSA VIN Standard

attributes.name: override_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether authorized OEM personnel can manually override the allocation quantities generated by this rule for individual dealers. Supports exception handling for special dealer circumstances.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA SD Authorization Management

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: the source system identifying the manufacturing or assembly plant that is the source of vehicles allocated under this rule. Ties the allocation rule to a specific production source for supply chain planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PP/MM Plant Configuration; Apriso/Dassault MES

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain technology segment to which this rule applies: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle), or 'all' for rules spanning all powertrain types. Supports EV transition planning and CAFE compliance allocation strategies.
attributes.references: EPA CAFE Standards; CARB ZEV Mandate; SAE J1715

attributes.name: priority_weight
attributes.description: Numeric weighting factor (0.00–100.00) assigned to this rule when multiple allocation rules apply simultaneously. Higher weights cause the allocation engine to favor this rule over lower-weighted rules during conflict resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Allocation Management; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: OEM-defined sales region code to which this allocation rule applies (e.g., NE for Northeast, MW for Midwest, SW for Southwest). Drives geographic allocation logic and territory-based distribution. Null indicates a national rule.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Sales Organization; CDK Global DMS Territory Management

attributes.name: rule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the allocation rule, used in dealer communications, DMS integration, and allocation engine references (e.g., ALLOC-VOL-2024-001).
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: rule_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the allocation rule's business purpose, special conditions, or exceptions. Provides context for allocation analysts and dealer network managers reviewing rule configurations.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: rule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the allocation rule, used in reporting dashboards and dealer portal displays (e.g., 'Q1 2024 F-Series Volume Allocation - Northeast Region').
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: rule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the allocation rule. Draft rules are under review; active rules are used by the allocation engine; suspended rules are temporarily paused; expired rules have passed their effective end date; cancelled rules have been voided before activation.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: rule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the allocation rule governing how vehicles are distributed. Volume-based uses historical sales volume; performance-based uses dealer scorecard metrics; geographic uses territory boundaries; model_mix enforces nameplate portfolio balance; incentive_based ties allocation to dealer incentive program participation; priority_based uses explicit dealer priority tiers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: volume_based|performance_based|geographic|model_mix|incentive_based|priority_based — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS; IATF 16949

attributes.name: sop_date
attributes.description: Start of Production (SOP) date for the model year and nameplate covered by this rule. Used to align allocation rule activation with production availability and prevent premature dealer allocation commitments.
attributes.references: Siemens Teamcenter PLM; SAP S/4HANA PP; APQP Standards

attributes.name: stackable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this allocation rule can be combined (stacked) with other active allocation rules for the same dealer, nameplate, and model year. Non-stackable rules are applied exclusively when triggered.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Condition Technique; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: target_days_supply
attributes.description: Target inventory days-supply level that this allocation rule aims to achieve at qualifying dealers. Days supply = (current inventory units) / (average daily retail sales rate). Used when allocation_basis is 'days_supply'.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Inventory Management; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: total_pool_units
attributes.description: Total number of vehicle units available in the allocation pool governed by this rule for the current allocation cycle. The allocation engine distributes these units across qualifying dealers according to the rule logic.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Allocation Management; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this allocation rule record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change detection in ETL pipelines and audit compliance.
attributes.references: IATF 16949 Record Control; ISO 9001 Document Control

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this allocation rule, incremented each time the rule parameters are materially modified. Supports rule change history tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Change Management; IATF 16949 Document Control

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Sub-regional distribution zone code within the sales region to which this rule applies. Zones represent finer geographic groupings of dealers used for allocation granularity below the region level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD; CDK Global DMS

products.name: dealer_inventory
products.description: Real-time inventory of vehicles physically on-hand or in-transit at a dealership. Tracks VIN, nameplate, model year, trim, exterior/interior color, powertrain, days-on-lot, acquisition cost, current asking price, inventory status (available, sold, demo, loaner, in-transit), and PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection) completion flag. Sourced from CDK Global DMS inventory module.

attributes.name: dealer_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each dealer inventory record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this data product.

attributes.name: connected_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mobility.connected_vehicle. Business justification: Inventory Turnover Optimization monitors connectivity status of inventory vehicles to prioritize sales of connected models.

attributes.name: finished_vehicle_stock_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.finished_vehicle_stock. Business justification: REQUIRED: Allocation traceability report needs to map each dealer inventory record to the originating finished‑vehicle stock for compliance and recall tracking.

attributes.name: homologation_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.homologation_record. Business justification: Inventory management must ensure each stocked vehicle model is homologated for the market; linking inventory to homologation records supports compliance checks.

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Inventory manager ownership is tracked for inventory reconciliation and loss prevention reporting.

attributes.name: primary_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership that physically holds or is allocated this inventory unit. Sourced from CDK Global DMS dealer master.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Inventory management report requires linking each dealer inventory record to the SKU definition for pricing, specs, warranty and compliance.

attributes.name: vehicle_build_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.vehicle_build. Business justification: Needed for Vehicle Traceability report, connecting each inventory record to its exact build record for warranty and recall actions.

attributes.name: vehicle_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.vehicle_order. Business justification: Inventory allocation report needs to know which OEM vehicle order supplied each stocked vehicle.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Dealer inventory management report requires each inventory record to be linked to the VIN registry for warranty, recall, and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: acquisition_cost
attributes.description: The dealer's total landed cost for this vehicle unit, including invoice price, transportation/destination charges, PDI costs, and any dealer-installed accessories. Used for gross profit calculation and inventory valuation.
attributes.references: NADA Dealer Financial Standards; GAAP ASC 330 – Inventory

attributes.name: allocation_order_number
attributes.description: The OEM-assigned order or allocation number associated with this vehicle unit, linking the dealer inventory record back to the factory production order. Used for order tracking, allocation management, and OEM-dealer reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD – Sales Order; OEM Dealer Allocation System

attributes.name: asking_price
attributes.description: The dealer's current advertised or asking retail price for this vehicle unit. May differ from MSRP due to market adjustments, dealer markups, or promotional discounts. Updated dynamically based on market conditions and days-on-lot.
attributes.references: FTC Used Car Rule; CDK Global DMS – Pricing Module

attributes.name: body_style
attributes.description: The vehicle body style classification (e.g., sedan, SUV, pickup truck, van). Used for inventory segmentation, lot management, and sales reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sedan|coupe|SUV|crossover|pickup_truck|van|minivan|wagon|convertible|hatchback — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAE J1100 – Vehicle Body Style Classification

attributes.name: certified_pre_owned
attributes.description: Indicates whether this used vehicle unit has been certified under the OEM's Certified Pre-Owned (CPO) program, meeting specific age, mileage, inspection, and reconditioning standards. True = CPO certified; False = not CPO certified. CPO vehicles carry extended warranty coverage and premium pricing.
attributes.references: OEM CPO Program Standards; FTC Used Car Rule

attributes.name: days_on_lot
attributes.description: The number of calendar days this vehicle unit has been physically present on the dealer's lot since the received date. A key inventory aging metric used to trigger price adjustments, incentive programs, and wholesale decisions. Aged inventory (typically >60 days) incurs floor plan interest costs.
attributes.references: NADA Dealer Financial Standards; CDK Global DMS – Inventory Aging

attributes.name: dms_record_reference
attributes.description: The source system record identifier from CDK Global DMS for this inventory unit. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and incremental load processing between the DMS source and the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Inventory Module; Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: drivetrain
attributes.description: Drivetrain configuration of the vehicle: FWD (Front-Wheel Drive), RWD (Rear-Wheel Drive), AWD (All-Wheel Drive), or 4WD (Four-Wheel Drive). Key inventory search and customer preference attribute.
attributes.references: SAE J1297; CDK Global DMS – Vehicle Specifications

attributes.name: engine_description
attributes.description: Descriptive label for the engine or powertrain configuration (e.g., '2.5L 4-Cylinder', '3.5L V6 EcoBoost', '75 kWh Electric Motor'). Supports customer consultation and technical service identification.
attributes.references: SAE J1349 – Engine Power Test Code; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: estimated_arrival_date
attributes.description: The estimated date the vehicle unit is expected to arrive at the dealership from the OEM or transport carrier. Relevant for in-transit inventory. Used for customer pre-order management and lot planning.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Vehicle Tracking; OEM Logistics

attributes.name: exterior_color_code
attributes.description: OEM-assigned paint/exterior color code for this vehicle unit (e.g., 'NH-883P' for Sonic Gray Pearl). Used for inventory search, customer matching, and lot locator functions within CDK Global DMS.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Inventory Module; OEM Color Codes

attributes.name: exterior_color_name
attributes.description: Human-readable marketing name of the exterior paint color (e.g., 'Sonic Gray Pearl', 'Midnight Black Metallic'). Used for customer-facing display and sales consultation.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Inventory Module; OEM Marketing Materials

attributes.name: floor_plan_date
attributes.description: The date on which floor plan financing commenced for this vehicle unit. Used to calculate accrued floor plan interest costs and curtailment schedules. Null for vehicles not financed via floor plan.
attributes.references: NADA Dealer Financial Standards; CDK Global DMS – F&I Module

attributes.name: floor_plan_lender
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution providing floor plan (wholesale) financing for this vehicle unit (e.g., 'Ford Motor Credit', 'Ally Financial', 'Chase Auto Finance'). Floor plan financing is the short-term credit line dealers use to fund vehicle inventory.
attributes.references: NADA Dealer Financial Standards; Dodd-Frank Act

attributes.name: fuel_economy_city_mpg
attributes.description: EPA-rated city fuel economy for this vehicle configuration in miles per gallon (MPG), or MPGe for electric/hybrid vehicles. Required disclosure on the Monroney label and used for CAFE compliance reporting.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 600 – Fuel Economy; CAFE Standards

attributes.name: fuel_economy_highway_mpg
attributes.description: EPA-rated highway fuel economy for this vehicle configuration in miles per gallon (MPG), or MPGe for electric/hybrid vehicles. Required disclosure on the Monroney label and used for CAFE compliance reporting.
attributes.references: EPA 40 CFR Part 600 – Fuel Economy; CAFE Standards

attributes.name: in_service_date
attributes.description: The date the vehicle was placed into service (sold and delivered to a retail customer, or placed into demo/loaner service). Marks the start of the OEM warranty period. Null if the vehicle has not yet been placed in service.
attributes.references: OEM Warranty Policy; NHTSA Recall Tracking

attributes.name: interior_color_code
attributes.description: OEM-assigned interior color/trim code for this vehicle unit (e.g., 'BK' for Black). Used for inventory matching and customer preference alignment.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Inventory Module; OEM Interior Codes

attributes.name: interior_color_name
attributes.description: Human-readable marketing name of the interior color and material (e.g., 'Black Leather', 'Sandstone Cloth'). Used for customer-facing display and sales consultation.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Inventory Module; OEM Marketing Materials

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current disposition status of the vehicle unit within the dealer inventory lifecycle. 'available' = on-lot and saleable; 'sold' = retail sale completed; 'demo' = dealer demonstration unit; 'loaner' = service loaner vehicle; 'in_transit' = allocated but not yet physically received; 'reserved' = held for a specific customer; 'wholesale' = designated for wholesale/auction disposal. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: available|sold|demo|loaner|in_transit|reserved|wholesale — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Inventory Status Codes; NADA Guidelines

attributes.name: inventory_type
attributes.description: Classification of the vehicle unit by its condition and ownership history: 'new' = new vehicle never titled; 'used' = previously owned/titled vehicle; 'certified_pre_owned' = OEM-certified used vehicle meeting specific age/mileage criteria; 'demo' = dealer demonstration vehicle; 'loaner' = service loaner vehicle. Governs applicable pricing, warranty, and financing programs.
attributes.references: FTC Used Car Rule; OEM CPO Program Standards; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: invoice_price
attributes.description: The OEM invoice price charged to the dealer for this vehicle unit, representing the dealer's acquisition cost from the manufacturer before holdback, dealer cash, or other incentives. Confidential commercial pricing data.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Agreement; NADA Dealer Financial Standards

attributes.name: last_price_update_date
attributes.description: The date on which the asking price for this vehicle unit was most recently updated in the CDK Global DMS. Used to track pricing strategy cadence and ensure market-aligned pricing for aged inventory.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Pricing Module; NADA Market Pricing Guidelines

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: The physical lot or storage location code within the dealership where this vehicle is parked (e.g., 'LOT-A-12', 'SHOWROOM-3', 'OVERFLOW-B'). Used for lot management, vehicle locator, and PDI workflow routing within CDK Global DMS.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Lot Management Module

attributes.name: msrp
attributes.description: The Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) for this specific vehicle unit including all factory-installed options and packages, expressed in the local currency (USD). Established by the OEM and used as the baseline for dealer pricing and incentive calculations.
attributes.references: Monroney Sticker Price Act (15 U.S.C. § 1231); FTC Regulations

attributes.name: odometer_reading
attributes.description: Current odometer reading of the vehicle in miles at the time of inventory check-in or last update. Critical for used, demo, and loaner vehicles to determine CPO eligibility, warranty coverage, and pricing. For new vehicles, reflects delivery mileage.
attributes.references: Federal Odometer Act (49 U.S.C. § 32701); CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: pdi_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) has been completed for this vehicle unit. PDI is a mandatory dealer quality check performed before vehicle delivery to a customer, verifying all systems, fluids, and accessories meet OEM standards. True = PDI completed; False = PDI pending.
attributes.references: OEM PDI Standards; IATF 16949 – Dealer Quality Requirements

attributes.name: pdi_completed_date
attributes.description: The date on which the Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) was completed and signed off by the dealer's service technician. Null if PDI has not yet been performed.

attributes.name: recall_campaign_number
attributes.description: The NHTSA-assigned recall campaign number if this vehicle is subject to an active safety recall (e.g., '23V-123'). Null if no active recall. Used for recall remedy tracking and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 573; NHTSA Recall Database

attributes.name: recall_hold
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vehicle unit is subject to an active NHTSA safety recall that prevents retail sale or delivery until the recall remedy has been performed. True = vehicle is on recall hold and cannot be sold; False = no active recall hold. Critical for regulatory compliance and consumer safety.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 573 – Safety Recall Reporting; FAST Act Section 24109

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: The date the vehicle unit was physically received and checked into the dealer's inventory from the OEM transport carrier or trade-in. Marks the start of the days-on-lot aging clock and floor plan financing period.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Inventory Check-In; NADA Floor Plan Standards

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this dealer inventory record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this dealer inventory record was most recently updated in the Silver Layer lakehouse, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, incremental processing, and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Indicates how the dealer acquired this vehicle unit: 'factory_order' = ordered directly from OEM; 'dealer_trade' = acquired via dealer-to-dealer trade; 'auction' = purchased at wholesale auction; 'trade_in' = accepted as customer trade-in; 'fleet_return' = returned from fleet/rental program; 'lease_return' = returned at end of lease term.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Vehicle Acquisition; NADA Guidelines

attributes.name: stock_number
attributes.description: Dealer-assigned internal stock number used within the CDK Global DMS to identify and locate this vehicle on the lot. Unique within a dealership but not globally unique.

attributes.name: transmission_type
attributes.description: Type of transmission fitted to the vehicle: automatic, manual, CVT (Continuously Variable Transmission), DCT (Dual-Clutch Transmission), or single_speed (for BEV). Used for inventory filtering and customer preference matching.
attributes.references: SAE J1297; CDK Global DMS – Vehicle Specifications

attributes.name: transport_status
attributes.description: Current transportation status for vehicles in the delivery pipeline from OEM plant to dealership: 'not_shipped' = awaiting dispatch from plant; 'in_transit' = en route via carrier; 'delivered' = arrived at dealer; 'rail' = currently on rail transport; 'truck' = currently on truck transport.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS – Vehicle Tracking; OEM Logistics System

attributes.name: window_sticker_url
attributes.description: URL link to the digital Monroney window sticker (required by the Automobile Information Disclosure Act) for this vehicle unit, hosted by the OEM or a third-party service. Contains MSRP, standard equipment, options, fuel economy ratings, and safety information.
attributes.references: Automobile Information Disclosure Act (15 U.S.C. § 1231); EPA Fuel Economy Label

products.name: parts_inventory
products.description: Dealer-level parts and accessories inventory managed through the CDK Global DMS parts module. Tracks OEM part number, SKU, description, quantity on hand, quantity on order, bin location, reorder point, supersession chain, price, and parts classification (mechanical, body, electrical, accessories). Supports service operations and parts counter sales.

attributes.name: parts_inventory_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each parts inventory record at the dealer location. Primary key for the dealer parts inventory entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: inbound_part_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.inbound_part. Business justification: Traceability for recalls and quality requires linking each dealer part stock item to its inbound part record.

attributes.name: parts_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer location where this parts inventory record is maintained. Links to the dealer master entity in the dealer domain.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: parts_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer location where this parts inventory record is maintained. Links to the dealer master entity in the dealer domain.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: procurement_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Needed for Parts Inventory Management to associate each part stock with its supplying vendor for ordering, pricing, and compliance.

attributes.name: sku_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to inventory.sku_master. Business justification: REQUIRED: Parts pricing, valuation and regulatory compliance reports require linking dealer parts stock to the master SKU definition.

attributes.name: spare_parts_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.spare_parts_catalog. Business justification: Parts inventory must reference the master parts catalog for pricing, compliance, and warranty reporting; this is required for the Parts Pricing & Compliance Report.

attributes.name: average_monthly_demand
attributes.description: Rolling average monthly sales or usage quantity for this part at the dealer location, as calculated and stored by the CDK DMS parts analysis engine. Used for reorder point setting and stocking level optimization. Stored as a DMS-sourced field, not a lakehouse-computed metric.

attributes.name: bin_location
attributes.description: Physical storage bin, shelf, or rack location code within the dealer parts warehouse or stockroom where this part is stored. Used by parts staff for picking, receiving, and cycle counting. Managed within CDK Global DMS warehouse management.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; SAP S/4HANA WM

attributes.name: core_charge_amount
attributes.description: The refundable deposit amount charged to the customer for the return of the old/used core part. Applicable only when is_core_part is true. Tracked separately in CDK DMS for core deposit liability accounting.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this parts inventory record was first created in the CDK Global DMS parts module. Represents the business record creation event, not the ETL load time. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; IATF 16949 Record Control

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary price fields (dealer cost price, list price, retail price) for this parts inventory record. Supports multi-currency dealer networks in international markets.

attributes.name: dealer_cost_price
attributes.description: The price at which the dealer procures this part from the OEM or authorized distributor, net of any dealer program discounts. Used for gross margin calculation and parts profitability analysis. Confidential commercial pricing data.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; SAP S/4HANA SD Pricing

attributes.name: inventory_snapshot_date
attributes.description: The business date as of which this inventory record reflects the parts quantities and status. Represents the effective date of the CDK DMS data extract loaded into the Silver Layer. Enables point-in-time inventory reporting and trend analysis.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: inventory_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the part in the dealer inventory. Active parts are available for sale and service. Discontinued parts are no longer manufactured. Superseded parts have been replaced by a newer part number. Backordered parts are on order but not yet received. Restricted parts require special authorization. Obsolete parts are no longer supported. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: active|discontinued|superseded|backordered|restricted|obsolete — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: is_core_part
attributes.description: Indicates whether this part has a core charge associated with it, requiring the customer to return the old/used part (core) for a refund. Common for remanufactured parts such as alternators, starters, and brake calipers. Drives core deposit tracking in CDK DMS.

attributes.name: is_hazardous_material
attributes.description: Indicates whether this part or fluid is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, storage, and disposal procedures under EPA, DOT, and OSHA regulations. Affects shipping documentation and storage bin assignment.
attributes.references: EPA Hazardous Materials Regulations; DOT 49 CFR; ISO 14001

attributes.name: is_serialized
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual units of this part are tracked by unique serial number for warranty, recall, and traceability purposes. Serialized parts (e.g., ECUs, airbag modules) require serial number capture at point of sale and installation.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; NHTSA Recall Regulations; IATF 16949

attributes.name: last_count_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent physical inventory count or cycle count was performed for this part at the dealer location. Used to assess inventory accuracy and schedule next count per IATF 16949 inventory control requirements.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; IATF 16949

attributes.name: last_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent stock receipt (goods receipt) was posted for this part at the dealer location. Used to assess inventory freshness, identify slow-moving stock, and support cycle count scheduling.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: last_sale_date
attributes.description: Date on which this part was most recently sold or issued from the dealer's parts inventory, either over the parts counter or via a repair order. Key metric for identifying slow-moving and non-moving (dead stock) inventory.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this parts inventory record in the CDK Global DMS, including quantity adjustments, price updates, bin location changes, or status changes. Used for change detection in incremental Silver Layer loads.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; IATF 16949 Record Control

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Expected number of calendar days from purchase order placement to receipt of this part at the dealer location. Used to set reorder points and manage customer promise dates for back-ordered parts.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; SAP S/4HANA MM MRP

attributes.name: list_price
attributes.description: OEM published list price for this part as defined in the official parts price book. Serves as the baseline for retail pricing and customer quotations at the parts counter. Updated periodically via OEM price file updates in CDK DMS.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: lost_sales_quantity
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of lost sales recorded for this part when a customer requested the part but it was not available in stock. Tracked in CDK DMS to support stocking level adjustments and identify demand not captured by sales history.

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: Upper inventory limit for this part at the dealer location. Prevents over-stocking and excess capital tied up in slow-moving parts. Used in conjunction with reorder point for min-max inventory management in CDK DMS.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: model_year_applicability
attributes.description: The vehicle Model Year (MY) range for which this part is applicable, expressed as a single year (e.g., 2022) or a range (e.g., 2019-2024). Used by parts counter staff to verify fitment and avoid incorrect part installation.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; SAP S/4HANA MM; NHTSA

attributes.name: months_supply
attributes.description: Number of months the current on-hand quantity is expected to last based on the trailing average monthly demand. Sourced directly from CDK DMS parts analysis module. Used to identify overstocked and understocked parts for return-to-OEM decisions.

attributes.name: oem_part_number
attributes.description: The official OEM-assigned part number as defined in the parts catalog and PLM system. This is the primary catalog identifier used for ordering, supersession tracking, and warranty claims. Sourced from Siemens Teamcenter PLM and the source system master.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; Siemens Teamcenter PLM; IATF 16949

attributes.name: parts_classification
attributes.description: High-level classification category of the part used for inventory segmentation, reporting, and stocking strategy. Categories include mechanical (engine, drivetrain, suspension), body (panels, glass, trim), electrical (ECU, sensors, wiring), accessories (OEM-approved add-ons), fluids, and consumables. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: mechanical|body|electrical|accessories|fluids|consumables — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; SAP S/4HANA MM Material Type

attributes.name: parts_group_code
attributes.description: OEM-defined parts group or commodity code that further classifies the part within the parts classification hierarchy. Used for bulk ordering, supplier management, and warranty analysis. Aligns with the source system group.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM; PTC Windchill Parts Classification

attributes.name: quantity_available
attributes.description: Net quantity available for immediate sale or service fulfillment, calculated as quantity on hand minus quantity reserved. Represents the unreserved, physically present stock. Stored as a business field from CDK DMS to avoid real-time recalculation in reporting.

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand
attributes.description: Current physical quantity of the part available in the dealer's parts stockroom as recorded in the CDK DMS. Represents the actual counted or system-tracked stock level used for service fulfillment and parts counter sales.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: quantity_on_order
attributes.description: Total quantity of this part currently on open purchase orders submitted to the OEM or aftermarket supplier but not yet received at the dealer. Used for demand planning and avoiding duplicate orders.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; SAP S/4HANA MM MRP

attributes.name: quantity_reserved
attributes.description: Quantity of this part that has been reserved or allocated to open repair orders, customer back-orders, or service appointments but not yet consumed. Reduces available-to-promise quantity for new service requests.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: recall_campaign_number
attributes.description: NHTSA or OEM-assigned recall campaign identifier associated with this part when recall_flag is true. Used to link parts inventory to specific recall campaigns for compliance tracking and OEM reimbursement claims.
attributes.references: NHTSA Safety Recall Regulations; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: recall_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this part is associated with an active NHTSA safety recall or OEM field action. Recall-flagged parts may have restricted sale or mandatory installation requirements. Supports compliance with NHTSA recall management obligations.
attributes.references: NHTSA Safety Recall Regulations; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: reorder_point
attributes.description: Minimum stock level threshold at which a replenishment order should be triggered for this part. When quantity on hand falls to or below this level, the DMS generates a replenishment recommendation. Set based on historical demand and lead time.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; SAP S/4HANA MM MRP

attributes.name: reorder_quantity
attributes.description: Standard order quantity to be placed when the reorder point is reached. Represents the economic order quantity (EOQ) or OEM-mandated minimum order quantity for this part at this dealer location.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; SAP S/4HANA MM MRP

attributes.name: retail_price
attributes.description: Dealer-set retail selling price for this part at the parts counter or in service repair orders. May differ from OEM list price based on dealer markup strategy, local market conditions, or promotional pricing.

attributes.name: sku
attributes.description: Dealer-level Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) code used within the CDK Global DMS parts module for inventory tracking, bin management, and point-of-sale transactions. May differ from OEM part number when dealer applies local stocking codes.

attributes.name: storage_condition
attributes.description: Required storage condition for this part to maintain quality and safety compliance. Drives bin assignment and warehouse layout decisions. Flammable and hazardous parts require segregated storage per EPA and DOT regulations.
attributes.references: EPA; DOT 49 CFR; ISO 14001; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: superseded_by_date
attributes.description: The date on which this part number was officially superseded by the superseding part number as communicated by the OEM. Used to manage transition inventory and inform service advisors of part number changes.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: superseding_part_number
attributes.description: The OEM part number that replaces this part when it has been superseded. Populated when inventory_status is 'superseded'. Enables the parts counter to automatically redirect orders to the current valid part number. Part of the supersession chain managed in the OEM parts catalog.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: supplier_part_number
attributes.description: The part number assigned by the OEM distributor or aftermarket supplier for cross-reference purposes. Used when ordering from non-OEM sources or when the dealer stocks approved aftermarket alternatives alongside OEM parts.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; SAP S/4HANA MM

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure in which the part is stocked, ordered, and sold. EA (each) is most common for discrete parts; KG/L for fluids and chemicals; SET/PAIR for grouped components. Aligns with the source system unit of measure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|KG|L|M|SET|BOX|PAIR|ROLL — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vehicle_model_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of vehicle model names or platform codes for which this part is applicable (e.g., F-150, Explorer, Mustang). Supports fitment verification at the parts counter and in service repair order creation.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; Siemens Teamcenter PLM

attributes.name: warranty_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this part is eligible for OEM warranty claim submission when installed during a warranty repair. Non-warranty-eligible parts (e.g., customer-pay accessories) are excluded from warranty billing to the OEM.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Parts Module; NHTSA; OEM Warranty Policy

products.name: retail_sale
products.description: Records the retail sale of a new or used vehicle by a dealership to an end customer. Captures VIN, sale date, sale price, MSRP, discount amount, trade-in details, financing type (cash, retail finance, lease), F&I products sold, salesperson, and deal status. Sourced from CDK Global DMS F&I module. SSOT for dealer-level vehicle sales transactions.
products.reference: CDK Global DMS F&I Deal Jacket

attributes.name: retail_sale_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each retail vehicle sale transaction record in the dealer domain. Primary key for the retail_sale data product.

attributes.name: opportunity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.opportunity. Business justification: Retail sale conversion analysis links the final sale back to the originating sales opportunity for win‑loss tracking.

attributes.name: retail_customer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail customer (buyer) who purchased the vehicle. Links to the customer master record.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud CRM; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: retail_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership that executed the retail sale transaction. Links to the dealer master record in the dealer domain.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: retail_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership that executed the retail sale transaction. Links to the dealer master record in the dealer domain.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: retail_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership salesperson (finance and insurance associate or sales consultant) who managed and closed the retail deal.

attributes.name: retail_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the retail customer (buyer) who purchased the vehicle. Links to the customer master record.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud CRM; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: retail_salesperson_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealership salesperson (finance and insurance associate or sales consultant) who managed and closed the retail deal.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Retail sale transaction must reference the SKU for warranty registration, service history, and post‑sale reporting.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Retail sale reporting and warranty registration depend on linking the sold vehicle to its VIN registry entry.

attributes.name: apr
attributes.description: The Annual Percentage Rate (APR) on the retail installment contract as disclosed to the customer under Regulation Z. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0699 for 6.99%). Null for cash and lease deals.
attributes.references: Truth in Lending Act (TILA) Regulation Z; CFPB; CDK Global DMS F&I

attributes.name: back_end_gross
