attributes.description: Gross profit earned from F&I products and dealer reserve on the financing (back-end), representing the total F&I department contribution to the deal. Key dealer profitability metric.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; NADA Dealer Financial Profile

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the retail sale record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer ingestion). Conforms to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; IATF 16949 Record Retention; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this retail sale record (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR). Supports multi-market dealer network operations.

attributes.name: deal_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric deal reference number assigned by the CDK Global DMS F&I module at the time the deal is opened. Used for cross-referencing with dealer records, lender submissions, and OEM reporting.

attributes.name: deal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the retail sale deal. 'draft' indicates deal is being structured; 'pending' indicates awaiting lender funding approval; 'funded' indicates lender has funded the deal; 'unwound' indicates a previously funded deal that was reversed; 'cancelled' indicates deal was voided before funding.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; NHTSA Dealer Reporting

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: The date the vehicle was physically delivered to the customer following Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI). May differ from sale_date when delivery is deferred. Used for warranty start date determination and OEM retail reporting.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; NHTSA; OEM Warranty Policy

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total discount applied to the vehicle sale, calculated as MSRP minus sale price. Includes dealer discounts, OEM incentive discounts, and employee pricing adjustments. Used for dealer margin analysis and OEM incentive reconciliation.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; OEM Incentive Program Guidelines

attributes.name: dms_deal_reference
attributes.description: The native deal identifier assigned by the CDK Global DMS F&I module. Used for source system traceability, reconciliation, and integration with downstream OEM reporting and lender portals.

attributes.name: doc_fee
attributes.description: Dealer-charged documentation and processing fee included in the deal. Subject to state-level regulatory caps in many jurisdictions. Disclosed on the buyer's order.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; State DMV Regulations; FTC

attributes.name: down_payment
attributes.description: Cash down payment made by the customer at the time of sale, excluding trade-in allowance. Reduces the amount financed. Used for deal structure analysis and lender submission.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; CFPB

attributes.name: fi_product_revenue
attributes.description: Total gross revenue generated from Finance and Insurance (F&I) aftermarket products sold as part of the deal, including extended service contracts, GAP insurance, paint protection, tire and wheel protection, and credit life/disability insurance.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; NADA F&I Guidelines

attributes.name: finance_amount
attributes.description: The total amount financed by the customer under the retail installment contract, including vehicle price, F&I products, taxes, and fees, less down payment and trade-in allowance. Null for cash deals.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; Truth in Lending Act (TILA) Regulation Z; CFPB

attributes.name: financing_type
attributes.description: The method by which the customer is financing the vehicle purchase. 'cash' = outright purchase; 'retail_finance' = retail installment contract through a lender; 'lease' = closed-end consumer lease; 'balloon' = balloon payment retail contract.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; CFPB; Truth in Lending Act (TILA); Consumer Leasing Act

attributes.name: fleet_sale
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vehicle was sold as part of a fleet or commercial account transaction rather than a retail consumer sale. Fleet sales are tracked separately for CAFE compliance, OEM fleet incentive programs, and sales mix reporting.
attributes.references: CAFE 49 CFR Part 533; EPA; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: front_end_gross
attributes.description: Gross profit earned on the vehicle sale itself (front-end), calculated as sale price minus dealer invoice cost and pack. Excludes F&I product revenue. Key dealer profitability metric reported in DMS and OEM dealer scorecards.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; NADA Dealer Financial Profile

attributes.name: lender_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution (captive finance company, bank, credit union) that approved and funded the retail installment contract or lease. Null for cash deals. Used for lender mix reporting and dealer reserve analysis.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; CFPB Auto Lending

attributes.name: loan_term_months
attributes.description: The contractual term of the retail installment contract expressed in months (e.g., 36, 48, 60, 72, 84). Used for lender mix analysis, payment affordability reporting, and portfolio risk assessment.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; CFPB Auto Lending

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The Model Year (MY) of the vehicle sold, as defined by the OEM and NHTSA. Used for CAFE compliance reporting, incentive program eligibility, and sales mix analytics.
attributes.references: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; CAFE Reporting; EPA

attributes.name: monthly_payment
attributes.description: The customer's contracted monthly payment amount under the retail installment contract or lease agreement. Used for affordability analysis and customer financial profiling.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; Truth in Lending Act (TILA) Regulation Z

attributes.name: msrp_amount
attributes.description: The Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) of the vehicle as stickered, inclusive of all factory-installed options and destination charges. Expressed in the local currency (USD). Used as the baseline for discount calculation, incentive reporting, and dealer margin analysis.
attributes.references: Monroney Sticker Act (15 U.S.C. § 1231); CDK Global DMS F&I

attributes.name: oem_incentive_amount
attributes.description: Total value of OEM-funded customer incentives applied to the deal, including cash-back rebates, conquest bonuses, loyalty bonuses, and special program pricing. Sourced from OEM incentive program data and reconciled against dealer statements.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Incentive Program; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: oem_program_code
attributes.description: OEM-assigned program code identifying the specific incentive or sales program under which the vehicle was sold (e.g., employee pricing, conquest, loyalty, fleet, rental). Used for OEM incentive claim submission and program performance reporting.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Incentive Program Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: pdi_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI) was completed and signed off by the dealer technician prior to vehicle delivery to the customer. PDI completion is required for warranty activation and OEM delivery standards compliance.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Service Module; OEM PDI Standards; IATF 16949

attributes.name: sale_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the retail vehicle sale was consummated — i.e., the date the buyer signed the retail installment contract or cash purchase agreement. This is the principal business event date used for sales reporting, OEM incentive eligibility, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; SAP S/4HANA SD; NHTSA

attributes.name: sale_price
attributes.description: The agreed-upon selling price of the vehicle as negotiated between the dealer and the customer, before trade-in allowance, taxes, and fees. This is the gross capitalized cost for lease deals or the selling price for retail finance and cash deals.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; SAP S/4HANA SD

attributes.name: sales_tax_amount
attributes.description: State and local sales tax assessed on the vehicle sale transaction. Calculated based on the taxable selling price and the applicable jurisdiction tax rate. Used for tax remittance reporting and deal cost reconciliation.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; State Revenue Authority Requirements

attributes.name: stock_number
attributes.description: Dealer-assigned inventory stock number for the vehicle unit at the time of sale. Used for dealer inventory management and reconciliation with CDK Global DMS inventory records.

attributes.name: trade_in_allowance
attributes.description: The agreed trade-in value credited to the customer for a vehicle traded in as part of the deal. Reduces the amount financed or cash due. Null if no trade-in vehicle was involved in the transaction.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; FTC Used Car Rule

attributes.name: trade_in_payoff_amount
attributes.description: The outstanding loan or lease payoff balance on the customer's trade-in vehicle at the time of the deal. If payoff exceeds trade-in allowance, the difference (negative equity) is typically rolled into the new deal.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS F&I Module; CFPB Auto Lending Guidelines

attributes.name: trade_in_vin
attributes.description: The 17-character VIN of the customer's trade-in vehicle, if applicable. Used for used vehicle inventory intake, auction disposition tracking, and trade-in equity analysis.
attributes.references: ISO 3779; NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the retail sale record was last modified in the data platform, reflecting deal amendments, status changes, or corrections sourced from CDK Global DMS. Conforms to ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; IATF 16949 Record Retention; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: vehicle_condition
attributes.description: Condition classification of the vehicle at point of sale. 'new' indicates a new, untitled vehicle; 'used' indicates a previously titled vehicle; 'certified_pre_owned' indicates a manufacturer-certified pre-owned vehicle meeting OEM CPO program standards.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS; OEM CPO Program Standards; FTC Used Car Rule

attributes.name: warranty_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the OEM new vehicle limited warranty period commences, typically aligned with the delivery_date or sale_date per OEM warranty policy. Used for warranty claim eligibility determination.
attributes.references: OEM Warranty Policy; Magnuson-Moss Warranty Act; CDK Global DMS

products.name: dealer_service_appointment
products.description: Scheduled service appointments at a dealership for vehicle maintenance, warranty repair, recall service, or customer-pay work. Tracks appointment date/time, customer, VIN, service type, advisor assigned, estimated duration, appointment status (scheduled, checked-in, in-progress, completed, no-show), and transportation option (loaner, shuttle, wait). Sourced from CDK Global DMS service scheduling module.

attributes.name: dealer_service_appointment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dealer_service_appointment data product (auto-inserted pre-linking).

attributes.name: aftersales_service_appointment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aftersales.service_appointment. Business justification: Business process: Dealer DMS schedules service appointments; aftersales processes them. Linking ensures appointment sync for parts, labor, and warranty tracking.

attributes.name: connected_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mobility.connected_vehicle. Business justification: Service Appointment Optimization uses real‑time vehicle location from the connected vehicle; required for scheduling and parts readiness.

attributes.name: dealership_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to dealer.dealership. Business justification: Dealer service appointments belong to a dealership; add dealership_id FK to link to dealership and remove redundant dealer_id column.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.party. Business justification: Service appointment scheduling needs to associate the customer (party) with the appointment for service history and follow‑up.

attributes.name: service_advisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Service appointments are assigned to a service advisor; required for labor costing and service KPI dashboards.

attributes.name: test_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.compliance_test_event. Business justification: Service appointments that include emissions or safety testing are recorded as compliance test events; linking captures that relationship.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Service appointment scheduling must reference the specific vehicle VIN to allocate resources and track service history.

products.name: dealer_repair_order
products.description: Detailed repair order (RO) record for each vehicle service event at a dealership. Captures RO number, open/close dates, VIN, mileage-in, complaint/cause/correction (3C), labor operations, technician assignments, parts consumed, warranty vs customer-pay vs internal split, total labor hours, total parts cost, and RO status. Core operational record for dealer service operations sourced from CDK Global DMS.

attributes.name: dealer_repair_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dealer_repair_order data product (auto-inserted pre-linking).

attributes.name: aftersales_repair_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to aftersales.repair_order. Business justification: Process: Dealer creates a repair order in DMS; it must reference the central aftersales repair order for warranty validation and labor costing.

attributes.name: connected_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to mobility.connected_vehicle. Business justification: Repair Order Diagnostic Integration pulls live diagnostic data from the connected vehicle to streamline repair workflow.

attributes.name: maintenance_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.maintenance_order. Business justification: Dealer repair orders are executed using the plant's maintenance order system, enabling unified cost, warranty, and downtime analysis.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.party. Business justification: Repair orders must be linked to the owning customer for warranty claim processing and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: technician_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Repair orders must record the technician performing work for warranty compliance and labor allocation.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Repair orders must be tied to the VIN registry to manage warranty repairs and parts usage per vehicle.

products.name: dealer_incentive_program
products.description: OEM-sponsored dealer incentive and bonus programs including volume bonuses, stair-step programs, customer satisfaction bonuses, EV adoption incentives, and floor plan assistance. Defines program name, type, eligible nameplates, MY, performance tiers, payout structure, measurement period, and eligibility criteria. Managed by OEM regional sales operations.

attributes.name: dealer_incentive_program_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the OEM-sponsored dealer incentive program record in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: nameplate_id
attributes.description: Reference to aftersales.aftersales_nameplate.aftersales_nameplate_id.

attributes.name: sales_incentive_program_id
attributes.description: SSOT reference to sales.sales_incentive_program (cross-domain duplicate reconciliation; sales designated SSOT owner for incentive_program).

attributes.name: vehicle_program_id
attributes.description: add column vehicle_program_id (BIGINT) with FK to engineering.vehicle_program.vehicle_program_id - dealer incentive programs target specific vehicle programs

attributes.name: announcement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the incentive program was formally announced to the dealer network via the dealer portal or official OEM communications. Precedes effective_start_date to allow dealer preparation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; NADA Dealer Communication Standards

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the OEM finance or sales leadership authority who formally approved this incentive program. Required for SOX compliance and internal audit purposes.
attributes.references: SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Compliance; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the incentive program was formally approved by OEM finance and sales leadership, transitioning from draft to active status. Required for SOX compliance audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; SOX (Sarbanes-Oxley Act) Compliance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the incentive program record was first created in the OEM system of record (the source system or the source system as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per enterprise data standards.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this incentive program (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR, MXN). Supports multi-market OEM operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: dealer_tier_eligibility
attributes.description: Specifies which dealer performance tier classification is eligible to participate in this program. Platinum/Gold/Silver/Bronze tiers are OEM-assigned based on prior-year sales volume and CSI scores. 'All' indicates no tier restriction.
attributes.references: NADA Dealer Standards; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: dealer_type_eligibility
attributes.description: Restricts program participation to specific dealer ownership models: franchise dealers, OEM-owned stores, or independent dealers. 'All' applies to both OEM-owned and independent franchise dealer models.
attributes.references: NADA Dealer Franchise Standards; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: dms_program_reference
attributes.description: The corresponding program identifier as recorded in CDK Global DMS used by dealer locations. Enables reconciliation between OEM master incentive records and dealer-side DMS reporting.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the incentive program measurement period closes and no further dealer performance accrual is accepted. Nullable for open-ended programs.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; NADA Dealer Incentive Standards

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the incentive program becomes active and dealers begin accruing credit toward performance tiers. Aligns with the measurement period start.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; NADA Dealer Incentive Standards

attributes.name: eligible_dealer_count
attributes.description: Number of dealer locations determined to be eligible for participation in this incentive program at the time of program launch. Used for budget planning and program reach analysis by OEM sales operations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: eligible_nameplates
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of vehicle nameplates (brand/model lines) eligible for this incentive program (e.g., 'F-150|Mustang Mach-E|Explorer'). Null if program applies to all nameplates. Managed in the source system vehicle catalog.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: eligible_powertrain_types
attributes.description: Powertrain technology types eligible for this program. ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), EV (Electric Vehicle), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), or all. Critical for EV adoption incentive programs aligned with CAFE and EPA compliance targets.
attributes.references: EPA Emissions Standards; CARB Regulations; CAFE Standards

attributes.name: floor_plan_rate_pct
attributes.description: For floor plan assistance programs, the percentage of dealer inventory financing cost subsidized by the OEM. Expressed as an annual percentage rate (APR) subsidy. Null for non-floor-plan program types.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; NADA Floor Plan Financing Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the incentive program record in the source system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail in the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: max_payout_amount
attributes.description: The maximum total monetary payout a single dealer can earn under this incentive program during the measurement period. Acts as a cap to control OEM financial exposure. Null if no cap is defined.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; NADA Dealer Incentive Standards

attributes.name: measurement_period_type
attributes.description: Defines the cadence over which dealer performance is measured for incentive qualification. Monthly and quarterly are most common for volume bonuses; annual for loyalty programs; custom for special campaigns.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: min_dealer_tenure_months
attributes.description: Minimum number of months a dealer must have been an active franchisee to be eligible for this program. Ensures new dealers meet a baseline operational maturity requirement.
attributes.references: NADA Dealer Franchise Standards; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The vehicle Model Year (MY) to which this incentive program applies. Restricts eligible vehicles to a specific MY production cycle (e.g., MY2024, MY2025). Null if program applies across all model years.
attributes.references: NHTSA Vehicle Identification Standards; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: oem_program_sponsor
attributes.description: Name or organizational unit of the OEM department sponsoring and funding this incentive program (e.g., 'North America Sales Operations', 'EV Business Unit', 'Truck Division'). Used for internal cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: payout_date
attributes.description: Scheduled calendar date on which OEM processes and disburses earned incentive payments to qualifying dealers. May differ from effective_end_date due to reconciliation periods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; NADA Dealer Incentive Standards

attributes.name: payout_structure_type
attributes.description: Defines how the incentive payout is calculated. Flat bonus: fixed dollar amount per tier. Per unit: dollar amount multiplied by units sold. Percentage of MSRP (Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price): payout as a percentage of vehicle MSRP. Percentage of invoice: payout as a percentage of dealer invoice price.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD/FI Module; NADA Dealer Incentive Standards

attributes.name: performance_metric
attributes.description: The primary KPI used to measure dealer performance for this incentive program. Units sold for volume bonuses; NPS (Net Promoter Score) or CSAT score for satisfaction bonuses; EV units sold for EV adoption programs; PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection) compliance rate for quality programs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: units_sold|nps_score|csat_score|ev_units_sold|market_share_pct|pdi_compliance_rate|revenue|floor_plan_days — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; NADA Dealer Performance Standards

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code assigned by OEM regional sales operations to uniquely identify the incentive program across systems including the source system and CDK Global DMS.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: program_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the program objectives, eligibility rules, and payout mechanics as communicated to the dealer network. Sourced from OEM regional sales operations documentation.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: program_manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the OEM regional sales operations manager responsible for administering this incentive program. Used for dealer escalation and program governance.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the dealer incentive program (e.g., 'Q3 2024 EV Adoption Bonus', 'Stair-Step Volume Bonus – Truck MY2024'). Used in dealer communications and DMS reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the incentive program. Draft: under design by OEM regional sales ops. Active: open for dealer participation and accrual. Suspended: temporarily paused. Closed: measurement period ended, payouts being processed. Cancelled: terminated before completion.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA SD Module; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the incentive program structure. Volume bonus rewards unit sales thresholds; stair-step provides escalating payouts per tier; CSAT bonus rewards customer satisfaction scores; EV adoption incentivizes electric vehicle sales; floor plan assistance subsidizes dealer inventory financing costs; market representation rewards geographic coverage. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: volume_bonus|stair_step|csat_bonus|ev_adoption|floor_plan_assistance|market_representation|loyalty_retention|conquest — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NADA (National Automobile Dealers Association) Dealer Incentive Standards; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: OEM-defined regional sales territory code identifying the geographic scope of the incentive program (e.g., 'NE', 'SE', 'MW', 'SW', 'W', 'NATIONAL'). Managed by OEM regional sales operations.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: requires_pdi_compliance
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer must maintain a minimum PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection) compliance rate as a prerequisite for incentive eligibility. True enforces PDI compliance gating; False means PDI compliance is not a condition.
attributes.references: NHTSA FMVSS; IATF 16949 Quality Standards; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: requires_training_certification
attributes.description: Indicates whether dealer sales or service staff must hold current OEM-mandated training certifications (e.g., EV product training, ADAS certification) as an eligibility prerequisite for this program.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; SAE International Training Standards

attributes.name: retroactive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the stair-step payout structure applies retroactively to all units sold once a higher tier is achieved (True), or only incrementally to units sold above each threshold (False). Critical for stair-step program financial modeling.
attributes.references: NADA Dealer Incentive Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: salesforce_program_reference
attributes.description: The the source system record ID for this incentive program. Enables bi-directional synchronization between the Databricks Silver Layer and the source system dealer portal visibility.

attributes.name: stackable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this incentive program can be combined (stacked) with other concurrent OEM incentive programs for the same dealer and vehicle. True allows stacking; False means the program is mutually exclusive with other programs.
attributes.references: NADA Dealer Incentive Standards; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: terms_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the program terms and conditions document (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.1'). Tracks amendments to program rules and ensures dealers are evaluated against the correct version of terms.
attributes.references: NADA Dealer Franchise Standards; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: tier1_payout_amount
attributes.description: Monetary payout amount (in program currency) awarded to dealers achieving Tier 1 performance threshold. May represent a flat bonus or per-unit amount depending on payout_structure_type.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; NADA Dealer Incentive Standards

attributes.name: tier1_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum performance metric value a dealer must achieve to qualify for Tier 1 (entry-level) payout. Units depend on performance_metric (e.g., number of vehicles sold, NPS score points).
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: tier2_payout_amount
attributes.description: Monetary payout amount (in program currency) awarded to dealers achieving Tier 2 performance threshold. Null if program has fewer than 2 tiers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; NADA Dealer Incentive Standards

attributes.name: tier2_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum performance metric value a dealer must achieve to qualify for Tier 2 payout. Must be greater than tier1_threshold. Null if program has fewer than 2 tiers.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: tier3_payout_amount
attributes.description: Monetary payout amount (in program currency) awarded to dealers achieving Tier 3 performance threshold. Null if program has fewer than 3 tiers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module; NADA Dealer Incentive Standards

attributes.name: tier3_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum performance metric value a dealer must achieve to qualify for Tier 3 payout. Must be greater than tier2_threshold. Null if program has fewer than 3 tiers.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: tier_count
attributes.description: Number of performance tiers defined within this incentive program (e.g., 3 for Bronze/Silver/Gold, 5 for stair-step programs). Determines the granularity of the payout structure.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud; SAP S/4HANA SD Module

attributes.name: total_program_budget
attributes.description: Total OEM-allocated budget for this incentive program across all participating dealers. Used by OEM regional sales operations for financial planning and CapEx/OpEx tracking in the source system
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; GAAP Financial Reporting Standards

products.name: dealer_incentive_claim
products.description: Individual dealer claims submitted against OEM incentive programs. Tracks claim submission date, program, claim period, claimed units or metric, supporting evidence, claim status (submitted, under review, approved, rejected, paid), approved amount, and payment reference. Integrates with the source system payout processing.

attributes.name: dealer_incentive_claim_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each dealer incentive claim record. Primary key for the incentive_claim data product.

attributes.name: dealer_incentive_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the OEM incentive program against which this claim is submitted. Links to the incentive program master record.

attributes.name: primary_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer submitting this incentive claim. Links to the dealer master record in the dealer domain.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the OEM staff member who reviewed and approved or rejected the claim. Supports audit trail, segregation of duties compliance, and workload reporting for the dealer incentive operations team.
attributes.references: SAP FI Workflow Authorization; SuccessFactors Employee Master; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: sales_incentive_claim_id
attributes.description: SSOT reference to sales.sales_incentive_claim (cross-domain duplicate reconciliation; sales designated SSOT owner for incentive_claim).

attributes.name: accrual_posted
attributes.description: Indicates whether a financial accrual has been posted in the source system this incentive claim liability. True = accrual posted; False = accrual not yet posted. Used for period-end financial close management and EBITDA reporting accuracy.
attributes.references: SAP FI Accrual Management; IFRS 15; SOX Financial Controls

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Net monetary adjustment applied by the OEM during claim review, representing the difference between claimed_amount and approved_amount. A negative value indicates a reduction; positive indicates an upward correction. Supports audit trail and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP FI Adjustment Posting; OEM Dealer Audit Policy

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why the approved_amount differs from the claimed_amount. Populated by the OEM reviewer when an adjustment is applied. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ineligible_units|duplicate_claim|missing_evidence|calculation_error|program_cap_exceeded|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Incentive Audit Policy; SAP FI Reason Codes

attributes.name: approved_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount approved by the OEM after review and validation of the dealer's claim. May differ from claimed_amount due to adjustments, disallowed units, or partial approvals. This is the amount committed for payment processing in the source system
attributes.references: SAP FI Payment Run; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: approved_units
attributes.description: Number of vehicle units or qualifying transactions validated and approved by the OEM reviewer. May be less than claimed_units if some units are found ineligible during audit. Used to calculate the approved_amount for volume-based programs.
attributes.references: OEM Volume Incentive Program Rules; SAP SD Sales Audit

attributes.name: claim_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable unique claim reference number assigned at submission. Used by dealers and OEM finance teams to track and reference the claim across systems including CDK Global DMS and the source system
attributes.references: SAP FI Document Numbering; CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: claim_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance or sales period covered by this incentive claim. Defines the close of the measurement window. Together with claim_period_start_date, establishes the claim period boundary for audit and reconciliation.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Incentive Program Terms; SAP SD Rebate Settlement

attributes.name: claim_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance or sales period covered by this incentive claim. Defines the beginning of the measurement window for which the dealer is claiming the incentive.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Incentive Program Terms; SAP SD Rebate Settlement

attributes.name: claim_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the incentive claim through the OEM review and payment lifecycle. Valid states: submitted (initial dealer submission), under_review (OEM audit in progress), approved (claim validated and approved for payment), rejected (claim denied), paid (payment disbursed via the source system (withdrawn by dealer or voided by OEM).
attributes.references: SAP FI Payment Processing; IATF 16949 Dealer Compliance

attributes.name: claim_type
attributes.description: Category of incentive claim being submitted, reflecting the nature of the OEM incentive program. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: volume_bonus|retail_incentive|floor_plan|marketing_support|customer_satisfaction|parts_sales|service_absorption — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP SD Condition Types; OEM Dealer Incentive Policy

attributes.name: claimed_amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary amount claimed by the dealer against the incentive program, expressed in the transaction currency. This is the dealer-submitted figure prior to OEM review and approval. Used for financial accrual and liability estimation.
attributes.references: SAP FI Accounts Payable; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: claimed_metric_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the claimed_metric_value field, indicating how the performance metric is expressed (e.g., units for vehicle count, percentage for service absorption rate, score for NPS/CSI, amount for revenue-based claims).

attributes.name: claimed_metric_value
attributes.description: The quantitative performance metric value being claimed by the dealer, applicable for non-unit-based programs such as customer satisfaction scores (NPS), service absorption rates, or parts sales amounts. Complements claimed_units for metric-driven incentive types.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Scorecard; NPS (Net Promoter Score) Methodology

attributes.name: claimed_units
attributes.description: Number of vehicle units or qualifying transactions the dealer is claiming against the incentive program for the claim period. Applicable for volume-based incentive programs such as volume bonus and retail incentive programs.
attributes.references: OEM Volume Incentive Program Rules; SAP SD Sales Statistics

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: the source system center code to which the incentive payout is charged. Used for internal cost allocation and management accounting of dealer incentive expenditure by brand, region, or program type.
attributes.references: SAP CO Cost Center Accounting; SAP S/4HANA CO Module

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the market in which the dealer operates and the claim is filed. Supports multi-market OEM operations and ensures correct regulatory and tax treatment of incentive payouts.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; SAP FI Company Code Configuration

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the incentive claim record was first created in the system. Represents the audit creation time (distinct from submission_date which is the business event date). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion tracking.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; SAP FI Document Creation; IATF 16949 Records Management

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this claim (claimed_amount, approved_amount, paid_amount). Supports multi-currency dealer networks operating in different markets.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: dealer_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the dealer representative responsible for this claim. Used for claim status notifications, evidence requests, and dispute correspondence. Classified as confidential PII per GDPR and applicable privacy regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CDK Global DMS; OEM Dealer Communication Policy

attributes.name: dealer_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the dealer-side representative who submitted or is responsible for this incentive claim. Used for communication, follow-up, and audit correspondence between OEM and dealer.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Dealer Contacts; OEM Dealer Agreement

attributes.name: dispute_date
attributes.description: Date on which the dealer formally raised a dispute against the OEM's claim decision. Populated only when dispute_flag is True. Used to track dispute aging and compliance with contractual dispute resolution timelines.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Agreement Dispute Resolution Clause

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer has formally disputed the OEM's decision on this claim (e.g., disputed rejection or adjusted amount). True = claim is under dispute; False = no dispute raised. Triggers escalation workflow in the source system
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Agreement Dispute Resolution Clause; Salesforce Automotive Cloud

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the outcome and resolution of a dealer dispute on this claim. Captures the agreed resolution, any revised approved amount, and the basis for the final decision. Supports audit trail and dealer relationship management.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Agreement; Salesforce Automotive Cloud Case Management

attributes.name: dms_claim_reference
attributes.description: Claim reference number as recorded in the dealer's CDK Global DMS system. Enables cross-system reconciliation between the OEM's incentive claim record and the dealer's own DMS records. Critical for audit and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Integration; OEM-Dealer Data Exchange Standards

attributes.name: evidence_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL pointing to the supporting evidence package submitted by the dealer with the claim (e.g., sales invoices, PDI records, customer satisfaction survey results, parts purchase orders). Stored in the document management system linked from CDK Global DMS or the source system
attributes.references: CDK Global DMS Document Management; IATF 16949 Records Control

attributes.name: evidence_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the OEM reviewer has verified the supporting evidence submitted with the claim. True = evidence reviewed and confirmed valid; False = evidence not yet verified or found insufficient. Used to gate claim approval workflow.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Incentive Audit Policy; IATF 16949 Clause 8.4

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: the source system ledger account code used to classify the incentive payout for financial reporting. Ensures correct P&L treatment of dealer incentive costs in accordance with IFRS 15 and OEM chart of accounts.
attributes.references: SAP FI Chart of Accounts; IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The vehicle model year (MY) associated with the units or transactions being claimed. Used to align incentive claims with specific model year programs and OEM production cycles (e.g., MY2024, MY2025).
attributes.references: SAP SD Sales Order; OEM Model Year Program Guidelines

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Actual monetary amount disbursed to the dealer for this claim. May differ from approved_amount due to netting, offsets, or partial payment arrangements. Populated upon payment confirmation from the source system
attributes.references: SAP FI Payment Document; IFRS 9 Financial Instruments

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date on which the approved incentive amount was disbursed to the dealer's bank account. Populated upon payment confirmation from the source system for cash flow reporting and dealer payment aging analysis.
attributes.references: SAP FI Payment Run; OEM Dealer Payment Terms

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: the source system document number or bank transfer reference assigned when the approved claim is paid. Links the incentive claim to the corresponding financial transaction in the source system Payable for reconciliation and audit.
attributes.references: SAP FI Payment Document; SAP FI-AP Module

attributes.name: powertrain_type
attributes.description: Powertrain technology category of the vehicles covered by this claim. Values: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), EV (Electric Vehicle), FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Used to track EV/electrification incentive program uptake and CAFE compliance reporting.
attributes.references: EPA Emissions Standards; CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) Regulations; CARB ZEV Mandate

attributes.name: program_quarter
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter of the OEM incentive program period covered by this claim (Q1–Q4). Used for quarterly accrual reporting, dealer performance benchmarking, and incentive budget variance analysis.
attributes.references: OEM Quarterly Incentive Program Schedule; SAP FI Period Accounting

attributes.name: program_year
attributes.description: Fiscal or calendar year of the OEM incentive program under which this claim is filed. Used to segregate claims by annual program cycle for budget tracking, accrual management, and year-end financial close in the source system
attributes.references: SAP FI Fiscal Year; OEM Annual Incentive Program Calendar

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: OEM sales region or zone code to which the submitting dealer belongs. Used for regional incentive program management, territory-based performance benchmarking, and regional finance reporting.
attributes.references: OEM Sales Region Hierarchy; SAP SD Sales Organization

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded explanation provided by the OEM reviewer when a claim is rejected (claim_status = rejected). Documents the specific grounds for denial to support dealer dispute resolution and compliance with IATF 16949 dealer management requirements.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the OEM completed the review of the incentive claim and updated the claim_status to approved or rejected. Used for SLA tracking of claim processing turnaround time.
attributes.references: OEM Dealer Incentive SLA Policy; SAP FI Workflow

attributes.name: sap_fi_document_number
attributes.description: the source system document number generated when the incentive claim liability or payment is posted in the general ledger. Provides direct traceability between the incentive claim and the the source system posting for audit and reconciliation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP FI Document Management; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the dealer formally submitted the incentive claim to the OEM. This is the principal business event date for the claim lifecycle and is used for period-end cut-off and aging analysis.
attributes.references: SAP FI Posting Date Rules; OEM Dealer Agreement

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the incentive claim record. Tracks the last modification for change data capture (CDC), audit trail, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: ISO 8601; Databricks Delta Lake CDC; IATF 16949 Records Management

attributes.name: vehicle_line_code
attributes.description: OEM product line or nameplate code identifying the vehicle model family associated with this claim (e.g., F-150, Silverado, Model 3). Used to segment incentive claims by vehicle line for program performance analysis and brand-level reporting.
attributes.references: SAP SD Material Master; OEM Vehicle Line Hierarchy

products.name: performance_scorecard
products.description: Periodic (monthly/quarterly) dealer performance scorecard capturing KPIs across sales, service, parts, customer satisfaction, and facility standards. Tracks new vehicle sales vs objective, used vehicle sales, service absorption rate, CSI (Customer Satisfaction Index) score, NPS (Net Promoter Score), parts fill rate, and overall composite score. Used for franchise compliance and incentive eligibility determination.

attributes.name: performance_scorecard_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dealer performance scorecard record.

attributes.name: performance_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer being evaluated in this scorecard.

attributes.name: performance_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer being evaluated in this scorecard.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Additional notes or commentary from the OEM regarding the dealer's performance during this period.

attributes.name: composite_score
attributes.description: The overall weighted composite performance score combining all KPI categories (sales, service, parts, customer satisfaction, facility standards) used for franchise compliance and incentive eligibility.

attributes.name: composite_score_benchmark
attributes.description: The minimum composite score required for franchise compliance and incentive program eligibility.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this scorecard record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: csi_benchmark
attributes.description: The target or industry benchmark CSI score the dealer is expected to meet or exceed.

attributes.name: csi_score
attributes.description: The Customer Satisfaction Index score measuring overall customer satisfaction with sales and service experience, typically on a scale of 0-100 or 0-1000 depending on OEM methodology.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this scorecard.

attributes.name: days_supply
attributes.description: The average number of days of inventory on hand at the dealer based on current sales rate.

attributes.name: dms_integration_source
attributes.description: The Dealer Management System from which raw performance data was extracted for this scorecard.

attributes.name: facility_standards_score
attributes.description: The score measuring dealer compliance with OEM facility image and standards requirements (showroom, service bays, signage, etc.).

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter (1-4) to which this scorecard period belongs, if applicable.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year to which this scorecard period belongs.

attributes.name: franchise_compliance_status
attributes.description: The dealer's franchise agreement compliance status based on this scorecard's performance results.

attributes.name: incentive_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer met the minimum performance thresholds to qualify for OEM incentive programs during this scorecard period.

attributes.name: inventory_turn_rate
attributes.description: The number of times the dealer's new vehicle inventory was sold and replaced during the scorecard period, calculated as sales divided by average inventory.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this scorecard record was last updated.

attributes.name: market_share_pct
attributes.description: The dealer's share of total new vehicle sales in their assigned territory or market area during the scorecard period.

attributes.name: new_vehicle_sales_actual
attributes.description: The actual number of new vehicles sold by the dealer during the scorecard period.

attributes.name: new_vehicle_sales_attainment_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the new vehicle sales objective achieved by the dealer (actual/objective * 100).

attributes.name: new_vehicle_sales_objective
attributes.description: The target number of new vehicles the dealer was expected to sell during the scorecard period.

attributes.name: nps_benchmark
attributes.description: The target or industry benchmark NPS score the dealer is expected to meet or exceed.

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: The Net Promoter Score measuring customer loyalty and likelihood to recommend the dealer, calculated as percentage of promoters minus percentage of detractors.

attributes.name: parts_fill_rate_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of parts orders fulfilled from dealer inventory without backorder during the scorecard period.

attributes.name: parts_revenue_actual
attributes.description: The actual parts department revenue generated during the scorecard period.

attributes.name: parts_revenue_objective
attributes.description: The target parts department revenue for the scorecard period.

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: The performance tier classification assigned to the dealer based on composite score and key metrics.

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: The frequency of the scorecard evaluation period.

attributes.name: published_date
attributes.description: The date this scorecard was officially published and communicated to the dealer.

attributes.name: reviewer_name
attributes.description: The name of the OEM regional manager or analyst who reviewed and approved this scorecard.

attributes.name: scorecard_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last day of the evaluation period covered by this scorecard.

attributes.name: scorecard_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first day of the evaluation period covered by this scorecard (monthly or quarterly).

attributes.name: scorecard_status
attributes.description: The current status of this scorecard record in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: service_absorption_rate_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of fixed operations expenses covered by service and parts gross profit, a key profitability metric for dealer operations.

attributes.name: service_revenue_actual
attributes.description: The actual service department revenue generated during the scorecard period.

attributes.name: service_revenue_objective
attributes.description: The target service department revenue for the scorecard period.

attributes.name: training_compliance_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of required OEM training programs completed by dealer staff during the scorecard period.

attributes.name: used_vehicle_sales_actual
attributes.description: The actual number of used vehicles sold by the dealer during the scorecard period.

attributes.name: used_vehicle_sales_attainment_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the used vehicle sales objective achieved by the dealer.

attributes.name: used_vehicle_sales_objective
attributes.description: The target number of used vehicles the dealer was expected to sell during the scorecard period.

attributes.name: warranty_claim_approval_rate_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of warranty claims submitted by the dealer that were approved by the OEM during the scorecard period.

products.name: csi_survey
products.description: Customer Satisfaction Index (CSI) survey responses collected post-sales and post-service at the dealership level. Captures survey type (sales satisfaction, service satisfaction), survey date, response channel, individual question scores, verbatim comments, overall satisfaction score, and OEM program compliance flag. Feeds dealer performance scorecards and franchise compliance reviews.
products.reference: OEM CSI / J.D. Power Survey Program

attributes.name: csi_survey_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the CSI survey response record.

attributes.name: csi_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the dealer location where the customer interaction occurred that triggered this survey.

attributes.name: csi_dealership_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the dealer location where the customer interaction occurred that triggered this survey.

attributes.name: csi_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the dealer order associated with this survey, if the survey is related to a sales transaction.

attributes.name: csi_repair_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the repair order associated with this survey, if the survey is related to a service transaction.

attributes.name: individual_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who completed the survey.

attributes.name: party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who completed the survey.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vehicle associated with the customer interaction that triggered this survey.

attributes.name: complaint_category
attributes.description: Category code classifying the nature of the customer complaint if complaint_flag is True (e.g., service_quality, pricing, staff_behavior, facility_issue).

attributes.name: complaint_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) whether the survey response contains a customer complaint requiring follow-up action.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this survey record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: days_to_response
attributes.description: Number of days between the customer interaction date and the survey completion date.

attributes.name: dealer_performance_impact_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) whether this survey response will be included in the dealer's official performance scorecard and franchise compliance review.

attributes.name: delivery_process_score
attributes.description: Customer satisfaction score for the vehicle delivery process, applicable to sales satisfaction surveys.

attributes.name: facility_cleanliness_score
attributes.description: Customer satisfaction score for the cleanliness and appearance of the dealership facility.

attributes.name: follow_up_completed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) whether the required follow-up action has been completed.

attributes.name: follow_up_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the follow-up action was completed, if applicable.

attributes.name: follow_up_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) whether the survey response requires dealer or OEM follow-up contact with the customer.

attributes.name: interaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the original customer interaction (sales delivery, service completion, etc.) that triggered this survey.

attributes.name: market_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code identifying the geographic market where the survey was conducted.

attributes.name: nps_category
attributes.description: Classification of the customer based on NPS score: promoter (9-10), passive (7-8), or detractor (0-6).

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Net Promoter Score indicating customer likelihood to recommend the dealer or brand, typically on a 0-10 scale.

attributes.name: oem_program_compliant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) Program Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) whether the survey response meets OEM CSI program compliance thresholds for dealer performance evaluation.

tag_set.value: Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) Program Compliant Flag

attributes.name: overall_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Overall customer satisfaction score, typically on a scale (e.g., 1-5, 1-10, or 0-100) as defined by the OEM CSI program.

attributes.name: pricing_transparency_score
attributes.description: Customer satisfaction score for the transparency and fairness of pricing communicated during the transaction.

attributes.name: problem_resolution_score
attributes.description: Customer satisfaction score for how effectively any issues or concerns were resolved.

attributes.name: response_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the customer submitted the survey response (email, phone, SMS, web portal, mobile app, postal mail, or in-person at dealership). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: email|phone|sms|web|mobile_app|mail|in_person — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sales_consultant_score
attributes.description: Customer satisfaction score for the sales consultant interaction, applicable to sales satisfaction surveys.

attributes.name: sales_region_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the OEM sales region or district to which the dealer belongs for regional performance aggregation.

attributes.name: sentiment_category
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the verbatim comment sentiment: positive, neutral, negative, or mixed.

attributes.name: sentiment_score
attributes.description: Automated sentiment analysis score derived from the verbatim comment, typically ranging from -1 (negative) to +1 (positive).

attributes.name: service_advisor_score
attributes.description: Customer satisfaction score for the service advisor interaction, applicable to service satisfaction surveys.

attributes.name: service_quality_score
attributes.description: Customer satisfaction score for the quality of service work performed, applicable to service satisfaction surveys.

attributes.name: service_timeliness_score
attributes.description: Customer satisfaction score for the timeliness of service completion, applicable to service satisfaction surveys.

attributes.name: staff_courtesy_score
attributes.description: Customer satisfaction score for the courtesy and professionalism of dealership staff.

attributes.name: survey_completion_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of survey questions answered by the customer, indicating survey completion rate (0-100).

attributes.name: survey_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer completed the survey.

attributes.name: survey_language_code
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code indicating the language in which the survey was presented and completed.

attributes.name: survey_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific OEM CSI survey program or campaign under which this survey was administered.

attributes.name: survey_status
attributes.description: Status of the survey response: completed (fully answered), partial (incomplete), abandoned (started but not submitted), or invalid (failed validation).

attributes.name: survey_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the customer submitted the survey response.

attributes.name: survey_type
attributes.description: Type of CSI survey indicating the customer interaction being evaluated (sales, service, delivery, parts, general, or Pre-Delivery Inspection).

attributes.name: survey_vendor_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the third-party vendor or platform that administered the survey (e.g., Medallia, Qualtrics, internal OEM system).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this survey record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: vehicle_condition_score
attributes.description: Customer satisfaction score for the condition of the vehicle at delivery or service completion.

attributes.name: verbatim_comment
attributes.description: Free-text comment provided by the customer describing their experience, concerns, or suggestions.

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number of the vehicle associated with this survey response.

products.name: service_capacity
products.description: Dealer service department capacity configuration including number of service bays, technician headcount by skill level (A/B/C tech), available labor hours per day, specialty certifications (EV, ADAS, body shop), loaner fleet size, and current utilization rate. Used for service appointment scheduling optimization and capacity planning.
products.reference: CDK Global DMS Service Capacity Planning

attributes.name: service_capacity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the service capacity configuration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: service_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer location that owns this service capacity configuration.

attributes.name: service_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer location that owns this service capacity configuration.

attributes.name: a_tech_headcount
attributes.description: Number of A-level (master) technicians certified for complex diagnostics, ECU (Electronic Control Unit) programming, and advanced repair work.

attributes.name: adas_certified_tech_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Certified Technician Count
attributes.description: Number of technicians certified for ADAS calibration, sensor diagnostics, and autonomous driving system service.

tag_set.value: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Certified Technician Count

attributes.name: adas_service_bays
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Service Bays
attributes.description: Number of service bays equipped with ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) calibration equipment for sensor alignment and diagnostic work.

tag_set.value: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Service Bays

attributes.name: available_labor_hours_per_day
attributes.description: Total productive labor hours available per day across all technicians, calculated as (technician headcount × hours per shift × efficiency factor). Used for service appointment scheduling and capacity utilization analysis.

attributes.name: avg_ro_cycle_time_hours
attributes.business_glossary_term: Average Repair Order (RO) Cycle Time Hours
attributes.description: Average time in hours from RO (Repair Order) open to close. Used for scheduling optimization and capacity planning.

tag_set.value: Average Repair Order (RO) Cycle Time Hours

attributes.name: b_tech_headcount
attributes.description: Number of B-level (journeyman) technicians certified for general maintenance and standard repair operations.

attributes.name: body_shop_bays
attributes.description: Number of service bays designated for collision repair, body work, and paint operations.

attributes.name: body_shop_tech_count
attributes.description: Number of technicians certified for collision repair, body work, and paint operations.

attributes.name: c_tech_headcount
attributes.description: Number of C-level (apprentice) technicians performing basic maintenance tasks and assisting senior technicians.

attributes.name: capacity_config_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the service capacity configuration, typically used in DMS (Dealer Management System) integration and capacity planning reports.

attributes.name: capacity_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes regarding capacity constraints, planned expansions, seasonal adjustments, or special considerations for service scheduling.

attributes.name: capacity_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the service capacity configuration. Active indicates normal operations, seasonal indicates temporary capacity adjustments, reduced/expanded indicate capacity changes, under_review indicates pending capacity assessment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service capacity configuration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: current_capacity_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Current utilization rate of service capacity expressed as a percentage. Calculated as (actual labor hours used / available labor hours) × 100. Used for capacity planning and scheduling optimization.

attributes.name: customer_pay_capacity_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total service capacity allocated for customer pay (non-warranty) repair orders. Typically 60-70% of total capacity.

attributes.name: diagnostic_equipment_level
attributes.description: Classification of diagnostic equipment capability. Basic: OBD scanners. Standard: factory scan tools. Advanced: ECU programming and ADAS calibration. Premium: full factory diagnostic suite with remote technical assistance.

attributes.name: dms_capacity_record_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dealer Management System (DMS) Capacity Record ID
attributes.description: External identifier for this capacity configuration in the source DMS system. Used for data lineage and integration reconciliation.

tag_set.value: Dealer Management System (DMS) Capacity Record ID

attributes.name: dms_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the DMS platform used by the dealer for service scheduling and capacity management. Primary integration point for capacity data synchronization.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this service capacity configuration expires or is superseded. Nullable for open-ended configurations.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this service capacity configuration becomes effective. Used for capacity planning and scheduling optimization.

attributes.name: ev_certified_tech_count
attributes.description: Number of technicians holding OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) certification for EV, HEV, and PHEV high-voltage system service and repair.

attributes.name: ev_service_bays
attributes.description: Number of service bays equipped and certified for EV (Electric Vehicle), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), and PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle) service work.

attributes.name: express_service_bays
attributes.description: Number of service bays designated for quick service operations such as oil changes, tire rotations, and PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection).

attributes.name: general_service_bays
attributes.description: Number of service bays designated for general maintenance and repair work on ICE (Internal Combustion Engine) vehicles.

attributes.name: has_mobile_service_capability
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dealer offers mobile service capability for on-site customer vehicle service and OTA updates.

attributes.name: hours_per_shift
attributes.description: Standard duration of each work shift in hours, typically 8.0 or 10.0 hours.

attributes.name: internal_capacity_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total service capacity allocated for internal work including PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection), loaner maintenance, and dealer-owned vehicle service. Typically 10-15% of total capacity.

attributes.name: last_capacity_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent capacity assessment and configuration review. Used for capacity planning governance and audit trails.

attributes.name: loaner_fleet_size
attributes.description: Total number of loaner vehicles available for customer use during service appointments. Used for customer satisfaction and service capacity planning.

attributes.name: loaner_fleet_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Current utilization rate of the loaner fleet expressed as a percentage. Calculated as (loaners in use / total loaner fleet size) × 100.

attributes.name: max_daily_appointments
attributes.description: Maximum number of service appointments that can be scheduled per day based on bay capacity, technician availability, and average repair order duration.

attributes.name: mobile_service_technician_count
attributes.description: Number of technicians dedicated to mobile service operations. Null if mobile service is not offered.

attributes.name: next_capacity_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next capacity assessment and configuration review. Typically quarterly or semi-annually.

attributes.name: operating_days_per_week
attributes.description: Number of days per week the service department operates. Typically 5 or 6 days for most dealers.

attributes.name: parts_inventory_capacity_sqft
attributes.description: Total square footage of parts storage capacity at the dealer service location. Used for parts inventory planning and JIT (Just-in-Time) delivery optimization.

attributes.name: shifts_per_day
attributes.description: Number of work shifts operated per day (1 for single shift, 2 for double shift operations).

attributes.name: specialty_certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of specialty certifications held by the service department, such as EV, ADAS, body shop, OBD (On-Board Diagnostics), TPMS (Tire Pressure Monitoring System), OTA (Over-the-Air Update) programming. Used for service capability assessment and customer routing.

attributes.name: target_capacity_utilization_pct
attributes.description: Target utilization rate for optimal service department performance, typically 80-85%. Used for capacity planning and performance scorecards.

attributes.name: total_service_bays
attributes.description: Total number of physical service bays available at the dealer service department for vehicle maintenance and repair work.

attributes.name: total_technician_headcount
attributes.description: Total number of certified technicians employed at the dealer service department across all skill levels.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service capacity configuration record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: warranty_work_capacity_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of total service capacity allocated for warranty and recall work. Typically 20-30% of total capacity.

products.name: floor_plan
products.description: Dealer vehicle floor plan financing records tracking the financing of new vehicle inventory. Captures financing institution, credit line amount, outstanding balance, per-unit floor plan cost, curtailment schedule, aged inventory flags, and floor plan audit dates. Critical for dealer financial health monitoring and OEM floor plan assistance program administration.

attributes.name: floor_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the floor plan financing record.

attributes.name: floor_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer holding this floor plan financing arrangement.

attributes.name: floor_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer holding this floor plan financing arrangement.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.sku. Business justification: Floor‑plan financing is calculated per SKU to reflect cost, interest, and regulatory limits.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Floor plan financing is per‑vehicle; linking to VIN registry enables accurate interest calculation and balance tracking.

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: Unique account number assigned by the financing institution to the dealer's floor plan credit facility.

attributes.name: aged_inventory_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator flagging vehicles that have exceeded the aging threshold defined in the floor plan agreement (typically 90, 120, or 180 days). True indicates aged inventory requiring attention.

attributes.name: aging_threshold_days

attributes.name: assessment_type

attributes.name: assessor_name

attributes.name: compliance_score
attributes.description: Quantitative compliance rating expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00). Calculated based on weighted assessment criteria and deficiency severity. Used for franchise renewal decisions and dealer performance scorecards.

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Current compliance state for this facility standard. attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this facility standard compliance record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: critical_deficiency_count
attributes.description: Number of critical deficiencies identified. Critical deficiencies are those that pose safety risks, violate regulatory requirements, or severely impact brand image.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: dealer_response_notes

attributes.name: deficiency_count
attributes.description: Total number of deficiency items identified during the assessment. Includes all severity levels (critical, major, minor).

attributes.name: deficiency_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of all deficiency items identified during the assessment. Includes specific observations, locations, and non-compliance details.

attributes.name: dms_integration_status

attributes.name: estimated_investment_amount

attributes.name: franchise_renewal_impact_flag

attributes.name: incentive_eligibility_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether non-compliance with this facility standard affects the dealer's eligibility for OEM incentive programs. True = may disqualify from incentives, False = no incentive impact.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this facility standard compliance record was most recently updated. Audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: major_deficiency_count
attributes.description: Number of major deficiencies identified. Major deficiencies significantly impact customer experience or operational efficiency but are not safety-critical.

attributes.name: minor_deficiency_count
attributes.description: Number of minor deficiencies identified. Minor deficiencies are cosmetic or procedural issues with minimal business impact.

attributes.name: next_assessment_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next facility standards assessment. Frequency determined by standard type, compliance history, and franchise agreement terms.

attributes.name: oem_reviewer_notes
attributes.description: Internal OEM notes regarding the assessment, remediation progress, or special considerations. Used for franchise management and dealer relationship tracking.

attributes.name: passing_threshold_score
attributes.description: Minimum compliance score required to achieve compliant status for this standard type. Threshold may vary by standard category and dealer tier.

attributes.name: photographic_evidence_url
attributes.description: Link to photographic documentation of facility conditions at time of assessment. Used for compliance verification and historical tracking.

attributes.name: remediation_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when all required corrective actions were completed by the dealer. Verified through post-remediation assessment or photographic evidence.

attributes.name: remediation_deadline
