attributes.name: remediation_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether corrective action is required to address identified deficiencies. True = remediation mandatory, False = no action required or waived.

attributes.name: remediation_status
attributes.description: Current state of corrective action for identified deficiencies. Tracks progress from identification through verification of completion.

attributes.name: remediation_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when OEM verified that remediation actions were completed satisfactorily. May involve on-site re-inspection or remote verification.

attributes.name: standard_category

attributes.name: standard_type

[ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CI|signage|showroom|service_drive|ev_charging|parts_department|body_shop|customer_lounge|digital_experience — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: waiver_expiry_date

attributes.name: waiver_granted_flag

attributes.name: waiver_reason

products.name: used_vehicle_appraisal
products.description: Trade-in and used vehicle appraisal records conducted at the dealership. attributes.name: used_dealership_id

attributes.name: used_party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the customer who owns the vehicle being appraised for trade-in or sale.

attributes.name: appraisal_date

attributes.name: appraisal_number
attributes.description: Unique business identifier for the appraisal transaction, typically generated by the DMS (Dealer Management System) or appraisal tool.

attributes.name: appraisal_source_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the appraisal was initiated: walk_in (customer walked into dealership), appointment (scheduled appraisal), online_submission (customer submitted online), phone_inquiry (customer called), service_drive (initiated during service visit).

attributes.name: appraisal_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the appraisal: pending (in progress), completed (appraisal finished), accepted (customer accepted trade-in offer), declined (customer declined offer), expired (offer validity period lapsed).

attributes.description: Precise date and time when the appraisal was completed, including time zone information.

attributes.name: appraisal_tool_used
attributes.description: Third-party valuation tool or system used to determine vehicle value: Manheim MMR (Manheim Market Report), Black Book, KBB (Kelley Blue Book), NADA (National Automobile Dealers Association), Galves, or internal proprietary tool.

attributes.name: appraised_value_amount
attributes.description: Final appraised value determined by the dealer after considering market value, vehicle condition, and local market factors.

attributes.name: appraiser_name
attributes.description: Full name of the dealership employee who performed the appraisal.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this appraisal record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: customer_requested_amount

attributes.name: disposition_decision

attributes.name: interior_condition_notes

attributes.name: linked_deal_number
attributes.description: Deal or sales transaction number in the DMS (Dealer Management System) if this appraisal was linked to a new or used vehicle purchase.

attributes.name: market_value_amount
attributes.description: Estimated market value of the vehicle based on the appraisal tool, representing the fair market price for retail or wholesale.

attributes.name: mechanical_condition_notes
attributes.description: Detailed notes on the mechanical condition of the vehicle, including engine, transmission, brakes, suspension, and other systems.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Model year of the vehicle being appraised, representing the year designation assigned by the manufacturer.

attributes.name: odometer_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the odometer reading: miles or kilometers.

attributes.name: offer_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the trade-in offer expires and is no longer valid, typically 3-7 days from appraisal date.

attributes.name: payoff_amount

attributes.name: reconditioning_cost_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated cost to recondition the vehicle for resale, including repairs, detailing, and PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection) work.

attributes.name: retail_estimate_amount
attributes.description: Estimated retail asking price if the vehicle were to be added to dealer used vehicle inventory.

attributes.name: service_records_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer provided documented service and maintenance records for the vehicle.

attributes.name: tire_condition
attributes.description: Assessment of tire condition and remaining tread life: excellent (like new), good (adequate tread), fair (moderate wear), poor (low tread), replacement_needed (below safe threshold).

attributes.name: title_status
attributes.description: Legal title status of the vehicle: clean (no issues), salvage (total loss), rebuilt (repaired salvage), lemon (manufacturer buyback), flood (flood damage), hail (hail damage).

attributes.name: trade_in_allowance_amount
attributes.description: Trade-in allowance amount offered to the customer, which may differ from appraised value due to negotiation or deal structuring in F&I (Finance and Insurance) process.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this appraisal record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: vin
attributes.description: 17-character Vehicle Identification Number uniquely identifying the vehicle being appraised. VIN is considered PII as it can be traced to an individual owner.

attributes.name: wholesale_estimate_amount
attributes.description: Estimated wholesale auction value if the vehicle were to be sent to wholesale rather than retailed.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.jurisdiction. Business justification: Regional performance and compliance metrics are governed by jurisdiction; the link supports region‑level regulatory analytics.

attributes.name: allocation_quota_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total OEM production allocated to this region. Sum of all region percentages equals 100%. Used for production planning and dealer inventory distribution.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the current region configuration or most recent change was formally approved by management.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee ID of the executive who approved the current region configuration or most recent change.

attributes.name: city_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of major cities included in this dealer region for reference and marketing purposes.

attributes.name: competitive_intensity_rating
attributes.description: Assessment of competitive pressure from other OEMs in this region. Influences incentive programs and marketing investment.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the primary country for this region (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX).

attributes.name: county_region_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of county or regional administrative divisions included in this dealer region for granular territory definition.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this dealer region record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: dealer_count
attributes.description: Total number of active dealerships assigned to this region. Used for capacity planning and regional performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: district_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the district within the region. Districts are sub-regional organizational units that group dealerships for field management.

attributes.name: district_name
attributes.description: Full name of the district within the region.

attributes.name: dms_integration_status
attributes.description: Status of integration between this region and the CDK Global DMS. Active indicates successful data synchronization; error indicates integration issues requiring attention.

attributes.name: dms_last_sync_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Dealer Management System (DMS) Last Sync Timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful data synchronization between this region and the CDK Global DMS. Used for monitoring integration health.

tag_set.value: Dealer Management System (DMS) Last Sync Timestamp

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this region configuration ceased to be effective. Null for currently active regions. Used for historical analysis and territory reorganization tracking.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this region configuration became effective. Used for historical tracking and territory change management.

attributes.name: geographic_boundary_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the geographic boundaries defining this region (e.g., bordered by Interstate 5 to the west, state line to the east). Used when precise coordinates are not available.

attributes.name: household_count_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated number of households within the region. Used for market penetration and vehicle ownership forecasting.
attributes.references: US Census Bureau / National Statistical Agencies

attributes.name: incentive_program_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether dealers in this region are eligible for special OEM incentive programs. True if eligible, false otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this dealer region record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent formal review of this regions boundaries, performance targets, and organizational alignment.

attributes.name: market_segment_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the regions primary market segment based on population density and economic characteristics. Influences product mix and marketing strategy.

attributes.name: modification_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for the most recent change to this regions configuration (e.g., market consolidation, dealer network expansion, territory realignment).

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this regions configuration and performance. Used for governance and planning cycles.

attributes.name: performance_benchmark_group
attributes.description: Code identifying the peer group used for performance benchmarking. Regions in the same group are compared for scorecard evaluation.

attributes.name: population_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated total population within the geographic boundaries of this region. Used for market sizing and sales potential analysis.
attributes.references: US Census Bureau / National Statistical Agencies

attributes.name: postal_code_range
attributes.description: Description of postal code ranges covered by this region (e.g., 90000-93999 for Southern California). Used for territory assignment and customer routing.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the region within the OEM organizational hierarchy. Used for reporting and system integration.

attributes.name: region_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the dealer region (e.g., Northeast Region, California Coastal, Mid-Atlantic).

attributes.name: region_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the dealer region. Active regions are operational; inactive regions are temporarily suspended; pending regions are being established; consolidating regions are merging with others; dissolved regions have been permanently closed.

attributes.name: region_type
attributes.description: Classification of the region based on organizational structure: geographic (physical territory), market (customer segment focus), strategic (special initiative), or operational (functional alignment).

attributes.name: regional_manager_email
attributes.description: Primary email address of the regional manager for business communication and escalation.

attributes.name: regional_manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the regional manager assigned to oversee dealer performance, allocation, and field operations in this region.

attributes.name: regional_manager_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number of the regional manager for dealer support and escalation.

attributes.name: sales_potential_index
attributes.description: Indexed score (0-100) representing the relative sales potential of this region compared to national average. Used for allocation planning and performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: salesforce_region_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this region in the the source system system. Used for cross-system reconciliation and dealer portal integration.

attributes.name: sap_sales_org_code
attributes.description: the source system organization code mapped to this dealer region. Used for order processing, billing, and financial reporting integration.

attributes.name: special_program_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes describing any special programs, initiatives, or considerations applicable to this region (e.g., EV infrastructure pilot, fleet sales focus).

attributes.name: state_province_list
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of state or province codes covered by this region (e.g., CA,NV,AZ for a Western US region).

attributes.name: vehicle_allocation_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking (1=highest) for vehicle allocation to this region during supply constraints. Based on market size, strategic importance, and historical performance.

attributes.name: zone_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the parent zone to which this region belongs. Zones are higher-level organizational units that aggregate multiple regions.

attributes.name: zone_name
attributes.description: Full name of the parent zone (e.g., Eastern Zone, Western Zone, Central Zone).

domains.name: aftersales
domains.description: Post-sale customer support including warranty management, service campaigns, recall execution, and parts distribution. Manages service appointments, repair orders, TSB (Technical Service Bulletin) distribution, DTC (Diagnostic Trouble Code) analysis, and labor time standards. Tracks warranty claims, parts consumption, service revenue, and customer retention. Includes field service operations and authorized service center network management. Integrates with CDK Global DMS and OBD (On-Board Diagnostics) systems.
domains.references: Warranty Standards, Service Standards, OBD-II, NHTSA

products.name: feature_content
products.description: Defines the commercial feature content associated with a trim level or option package — the consumer-facing feature descriptions used in marketing, window stickers, and configurators. Captures feature code, feature name, feature category (safety/technology/comfort/performance/exterior/interior), feature description, standard vs. optional flag, ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) classification flag, EV/HEV-specific flag, regulatory-mandated flag, and content source system reference. Bridges the commercial product catalog to consumer-facing communications.

attributes.name: feature_content_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the feature content record. Primary key.

attributes.name: aftersales_trim_level_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.trim_level. Business justification: Feature content is defined per trim level; linking provides a proper hierarchy and removes any need for duplicate trim identifiers in feature_content.

attributes.name: design_specification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to engineering.design_specification. Business justification: Feature‑to‑Design traceability matrix requires linking each product feature to its engineering design specification for validation and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this feature content record was approved for publication. Used for audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the product manager or marketing manager who approved this feature content for publication. Used for accountability and content governance.

attributes.name: availability_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the feature is included as standard equipment, available as a standalone option, only available within a package, or not available for a given trim or market.

attributes.name: content_source_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this feature content record in the source system, used for traceability and data lineage.

attributes.name: content_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this feature content record originates, such as PLM (Product Lifecycle Management), PIM (Product Information Management), or marketing content management system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this feature content record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: customer_demand_score
attributes.description: Quantitative score (0-100) representing customer demand or take-rate for this feature based on market research, configurator analytics, and sales data. Used for product planning and inventory optimization.

attributes.name: dealer_cost_impact_amount
attributes.description: The incremental dealer invoice cost when this feature is included. Used for dealer margin calculations and incentive program design.

attributes.name: ecu_dependency_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this feature requires specific ECU (Electronic Control Unit) hardware or software configuration. Used for manufacturing planning and service diagnostics.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this feature content record is no longer effective. Null if the record is currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this feature content record becomes effective and available for use in configurators, ordering systems, and marketing materials.

attributes.name: feature_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the feature grouping for marketing segmentation and consumer navigation. Categories align with consumer decision-making patterns.

attributes.name: feature_code
attributes.description: Standardized alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the feature within the product catalog system. Used for cross-system integration and configurator mapping.

attributes.name: feature_description_long
attributes.description: Comprehensive consumer-facing description of the feature including benefits, technical highlights, and usage scenarios. Used in brochures, website detail pages, and dealer training materials.

attributes.name: feature_description_short
attributes.description: Brief consumer-facing description of the feature, typically 50-100 characters, used in configurator tooltips and mobile applications.

attributes.name: feature_name
attributes.description: Consumer-facing marketing name of the feature as displayed in brochures, window stickers, and online configurators.

attributes.name: feature_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the feature content record. Active features are available for configuration; discontinued features are retained for historical reference; pending features are awaiting approval; under_review features are being evaluated for changes.

attributes.name: feature_subcategory
attributes.description: Detailed sub-classification within the feature category for granular filtering and reporting (e.g., within safety: active safety, passive safety, driver assistance).

attributes.name: fuel_economy_impact_percent
attributes.description: The estimated percentage impact on fuel economy (positive or negative) when this feature is included. Used for EPA fuel economy label calculations and CAFE compliance.

attributes.name: installation_time_minutes
attributes.description: Standard time in minutes required to install this feature on the production line. Used for manufacturing capacity planning and line balancing in MES (Manufacturing Execution System).

attributes.name: is_adas_feature
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Feature Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this feature is classified as an ADAS (Advanced Driver Assistance Systems) technology, such as adaptive cruise control, lane keeping assist, or automated emergency braking.
attributes.references: SAE International J3016 Levels of Driving Automation

tag_set.value: Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) Feature Flag

attributes.name: is_ev_specific
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this feature is specific to electric vehicle (EV) or plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) powertrains, such as regenerative braking display, charging port, or battery thermal management.

attributes.name: is_hev_specific
attributes.business_glossary_term: Hybrid Electric Vehicle (HEV) Specific Feature Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this feature is specific to hybrid electric vehicle (HEV) powertrains, such as hybrid system display, EV mode selector, or hybrid battery cooling.

tag_set.value: Hybrid Electric Vehicle (HEV) Specific Feature Flag

attributes.name: is_regulatory_mandated
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this feature is mandated by regulatory requirements such as NHTSA Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS), EPA emissions standards, or regional safety regulations (e.g., backup camera, tire pressure monitoring system).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this feature content record was last modified. Used for change tracking and synchronization with downstream systems.

attributes.name: market_availability_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or market where this feature is available, using standardized region codes (e.g., NAM for North America, EUR for Europe, CHN for China). Multiple regions may be pipe-separated.

attributes.name: marketing_priority_rank
attributes.description: Numerical ranking indicating the marketing priority of this feature for promotional campaigns and sales emphasis. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: model_year_discontinued
attributes.description: The model year (MY) when this feature was discontinued or phased out. Null if the feature is still active in the current lineup.

attributes.name: model_year_introduced
attributes.description: The model year (MY) when this feature was first introduced into the product lineup. Used for product evolution tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: msrp_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the MSRP impact amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: msrp_impact_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) Impact Amount
attributes.description: The incremental MSRP (Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price) value added when this feature is included as an option. Zero for standard features. Used for pricing calculations and configurator display.

tag_set.value: Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) Impact Amount

attributes.name: ota_updateable_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this feature can be enabled, updated, or modified via OTA (Over-the-Air) software updates post-production.

attributes.name: regulatory_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific regulatory standard or requirement that mandates this feature, such as FMVSS number, EPA regulation code, or Euro NCAP protocol. Populated only when is_regulatory_mandated is true.
attributes.references: NHTSA, EPA, UNECE, Euro NCAP Standards

attributes.name: safety_rating_impact
attributes.description: Indicates the level of impact this feature has on vehicle safety ratings such as NCAP (New Car Assessment Programme) star ratings or IIHS Top Safety Pick awards.
attributes.references: Euro NCAP, IIHS Safety Rating Protocols

attributes.name: supplier_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary supplier or OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) partner providing the component or system that delivers this feature. Used for supply chain traceability and warranty management.

attributes.name: technology_level
attributes.description: Classification of the feature's technology sophistication level, used for market positioning and trim-level differentiation strategies.

attributes.name: warranty_extension_months
attributes.description: Number of additional warranty months provided specifically for this feature beyond the base vehicle warranty. Zero if no extension applies.

attributes.name: weight_impact_kg
attributes.description: The incremental vehicle weight in kilograms added by this feature. Used for CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) calculations, performance modeling, and engineering analysis.

products.name: program_milestone
products.description: Tracks key program milestones and gate reviews for each MY program (e.g., Program Approval, Design Freeze, PPAP completion, SOP, Job 1, EOP). Captures milestone type, planned date, actual date, milestone status (pending/achieved/delayed/waived), responsible function, gate review outcome, and variance days. Enables program management tracking, cross-functional alignment, and executive reporting on program health.
products.reference: Program Gate / APQP Milestone (APQP Phase Gate)

attributes.name: program_milestone_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the program milestone record. Primary key for the program milestone entity.

attributes.name: aftersales_model_year_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent MY (Model Year) program to which this milestone belongs. Links to the program master entity.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: nameplate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle nameplate (brand/model) associated with this program milestone. Links to nameplate master data in the product domain.
attributes.references: SAE J1979 - E/E Diagnostic Test Modes

attributes.name: plant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manufacturing plant where this milestone applies. Relevant for production-related milestones (SOP, Job 1, EOP). Null for program-level milestones. Links to plant master data.

attributes.name: predecessor_milestone_program_milestone_id
attributes.description: Reference to the immediately preceding milestone that must be achieved before this milestone can begin. Null for the first milestone in the program sequence. Enables critical path analysis.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: program_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or program manager accountable for delivering this milestone. Links to workforce/employee master data.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: program_responsible_person_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or program manager accountable for delivering this milestone. Links to workforce/employee master data.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: actual_date
attributes.description: Actual date the milestone was achieved. Populated when milestone_status transitions to achieved. Used for variance analysis and lessons learned.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: Approved baseline date after program approval or re-baseline. Used as the official target for performance measurement and variance calculation.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: budget_impact_amount
attributes.description: Estimated financial impact (in base currency) if this milestone is delayed. Used for prioritization and executive escalation. Null if no quantified impact.

attributes.name: completion_percentage
attributes.description: Estimated percentage of work completed toward achieving this milestone (0.00 to 100.00). Updated during program reviews. 100.00 when milestone_status is achieved.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this milestone record was first created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: critical_path_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone is on the program critical path. True if any delay to this milestone will delay the overall program SOP date. Used for prioritization and risk management.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for budget_impact_amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY). Null if budget_impact_amount is null.

attributes.name: deliverable_completed_count
attributes.description: Number of deliverables that have been completed and approved. Used to calculate completion_percentage and assess readiness for gate review.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: deliverable_count
attributes.description: Number of formal deliverables (documents, approvals, test results) required to achieve this milestone. Used to track completion progress.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: external_dependency_description
attributes.description: Description of external dependencies, including supplier names, partner organizations, or regulatory agencies. Null if external_dependency_flag is false.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: external_dependency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone depends on external parties (suppliers, partners, regulatory agencies) for completion. True if external coordination required, false if fully internal.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: forecast_date
attributes.description: Current forecast date for milestone achievement based on latest program status. Updated regularly during program reviews. Null if milestone already achieved.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: gate_review_comments
attributes.description: Executive comments, conditions, or action items resulting from the gate review meeting. Captures key decisions and follow-up requirements.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: gate_review_date
attributes.description: Date the formal gate review meeting was held. Null if gate_review_required is false or review not yet conducted.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: gate_review_outcome
attributes.description: Result of the formal gate review meeting: approved (proceed to next phase), approved_with_conditions (proceed with action items), deferred (reschedule review), rejected (do not proceed). Null if gate_review_required is false or review not yet held.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: gate_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal gate review (executive approval meeting) is required before this milestone can be marked as achieved. True for major program gates (e.g., Program Approval, SOP), false for intermediate checkpoints.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: milestone_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the milestone type (e.g., PROG_APPR, DESIGN_FREEZE, PPAP_COMP, SOP, JOB1, EOP). Used for system integration and reporting.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: milestone_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the milestone (e.g., Program Approval, Design Freeze, PPAP Completion, Start of Production, Job 1, End of Production).
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: milestone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the milestone: pending (not started), in_progress (activities underway), achieved (completed on time), delayed (missed target), waived (skipped by exception), cancelled (no longer required).
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: milestone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the milestone by functional category: program_gate (strategic approval), design_gate (engineering freeze), quality_gate (PPAP/APQP), production_gate (SOP/EOP), regulatory_gate (homologation), commercial_gate (launch readiness).
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: mitigation_plan
attributes.description: Action plan to address identified risks and recover schedule. Includes specific actions, owners, and target dates. Null if risk_level is low.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Model Year for which this program milestone applies (e.g., 2024, 2025). Aligns with automotive industry MY planning cycles.
attributes.references: SAE J1979 - E/E Diagnostic Test Modes

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last modified this milestone record. Audit trail for data governance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this milestone record was last updated. Audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, context, or historical information about this milestone. Free-text field for program team collaboration.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: planned_date
attributes.description: Originally planned target date for achieving this milestone, as defined in the program master schedule. Baseline for variance tracking.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: program_phase
attributes.description: High-level program phase in which this milestone occurs: concept (initial planning), design (engineering), development (prototyping), validation (testing/PPAP), launch (SOP/Job 1), production (volume ramp), end_of_life (EOP). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: concept|design|development|validation|launch|production|end_of_life — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: regulatory_body
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory authority or governing body requiring this milestone (e.g., NHTSA, EPA, Euro NCAP, CARB, UNECE). Null if regulatory_requirement_flag is false.
attributes.references: NHTSA Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS)

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone is driven by regulatory or homologation requirements (e.g., NHTSA, EPA, Euro NCAP, WLTP certification). True for regulatory gates, false for internal program milestones.
attributes.references: NHTSA Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS)

attributes.name: responsible_function
attributes.description: Primary functional organization accountable for achieving this milestone: engineering (design/CAE), manufacturing (plant readiness), quality (PPAP/APQP), supply_chain (supplier readiness), regulatory (homologation), commercial (launch), program_management (gate reviews). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: engineering|manufacturing|quality|supply_chain|regulatory|commercial|program_management — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of risks, issues, or blockers that may prevent timely achievement of this milestone. Updated during program status reviews.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: risk_level
attributes.description: Current risk assessment for achieving this milestone on time: low (on track, no issues), medium (minor concerns), high (significant risk of delay), critical (delay highly likely or already occurred).
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: variance_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days between baseline_date and actual_date. Positive values indicate delay, negative values indicate early completion. Null if milestone not yet achieved.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: waiver_approved_by
attributes.description: Reference to the executive who approved the milestone waiver. Links to workforce/employee master data. Null if milestone not waived.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: waiver_approved_date
attributes.description: Date the milestone waiver was formally approved. Null if milestone not waived.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Business justification for waiving this milestone. Populated when milestone_status is set to waived. Requires executive approval.
attributes.references: APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) Reference Manual

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system account that created this milestone record. Audit trail for data governance.

products.name: product_engineering_change
products.description: Commercial product domain record of engineering changes (ECNs/ECOs) that impact the commercial product catalog — affecting BOM structures, SKU configurations, option availability, or MSRP pricing. Captures change request number, change type (cost reduction/quality improvement/regulatory/customer-driven), affected SKUs and BOM lines, effective MY and date, commercial impact assessment (price change/feature change/availability change), approval status, and Teamcenter PLM reference. Distinct from the engineering domain's full ECN lifecycle — this is the commercial impact view.
products.reference: ECN / ECO (Siemens Teamcenter Engineering Change / SAP PLM)

attributes.name: product_engineering_change_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product_engineering_change data product (auto-inserted pre-linking).

attributes.name: aftersales_model_year_program_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to product.model_year_program. Business justification: Engineering changes are scoped to a model year program; linking provides traceability and prevents orphan change records.

attributes.name: engineer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Engineering change requests need the responsible engineer employee for traceability in change management system.

products.name: option_constraint
products.description: Defines the business rules governing option and package compatibility — which options require, exclude, or are included with other options on a given trim level and MY. Captures constraint type (requires/excludes/includes/upgrades), source option/package, target option/package, applicable trim levels, applicable markets, effective date range, and constraint priority. Enforces valid vehicle configurations in dealer ordering systems and consumer configurators, preventing invalid build combinations.
products.reference: Option Constraint / Configuration Rule (SAP SD / Configurator Rules)

attributes.name: option_constraint_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the option constraint rule. Primary key.

attributes.name: aftersales_trim_level_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific trim level to which this constraint applies. Nullable if constraint applies across all trims for the nameplate/MY.

attributes.name: nameplate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle nameplate (brand/model family) to which this constraint applies.

attributes.name: primary_aftersales_option_package_id
attributes.description: Reference to the option or package that triggers this constraint rule. The 'if' side of the constraint logic.

attributes.name: target_option_aftersales_option_package_id
attributes.description: Reference to the option or package that is affected by this constraint rule. The 'then' side of the constraint logic.

attributes.name: target_option_option_package_aftersales_option_package_id
attributes.description: Reference to the option or package that is affected by this constraint rule. The 'then' side of the constraint logic.

attributes.name: applies_to_fleet
attributes.description: Indicates whether this constraint applies to fleet orders. Some constraints are relaxed or different for high-volume fleet customers.

attributes.name: applies_to_retail
attributes.description: Indicates whether this constraint applies to retail customer orders through dealer networks.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval status for this constraint rule. Only approved constraints are activated in production ordering systems.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this constraint rule was approved for production use.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User identifier or name of the product manager or engineering lead who approved this constraint for production use.

attributes.name: bom_impact
attributes.description: Indicates the severity of Bill of Materials changes triggered by this constraint. Critical impacts may require PPAP or APQP review.

attributes.name: change_request_number
attributes.description: Reference to the Engineering Change Request or Product Change Notice that authorized the creation or modification of this constraint.

attributes.name: configurator_display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence controlling the order in which constraint messages are displayed in consumer and dealer configurators.
attributes.references: Salesforce Automotive Cloud, CDK Global DMS

attributes.name: constraint_code
attributes.description: Business-readable code identifying this constraint rule, often used in dealer ordering systems and configurators.

attributes.name: constraint_description
attributes.description: Detailed business explanation of why this constraint exists, including engineering, regulatory, or commercial rationale.

attributes.name: constraint_priority

products.name: product_lifecycle_event
products.description: Captures significant lifecycle state transitions for nameplates, model year programs, and SKUs (e.g., program approval, design freeze, SOP, Job 1, mid-cycle refresh announcement, EOP, nameplate discontinuation). Captures event type, affected entity type and ID, event date, prior state, new state, triggering authority, announcement type (internal/public), and associated press release or regulatory filing reference. Provides a complete audit trail of commercial product lifecycle decisions.

attributes.name: product_lifecycle_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the product lifecycle event record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id

attributes.name: cost_center_id

attributes.name: profit_center_id

attributes.name: actual_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the lifecycle event occurred, used for variance analysis against planned date.

attributes.name: affected_entity_code
attributes.description: Business code or identifier of the affected entity (e.g., nameplate code, program code, SKU code) for human-readable reference and reporting.

attributes.name: affected_entity_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific product entity affected by this event. References the primary key of the entity type specified in affected_entity_type.

attributes.name: affected_entity_type
attributes.description: Type of product entity affected by this lifecycle event (e.g., nameplate, model year program, SKU, trim level, platform, powertrain).

attributes.name: announcement_date
attributes.description: Date when the lifecycle event was publicly or internally announced, which may differ from the actual event date.

attributes.name: announcement_type

attributes.name: approval_date

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lifecycle event record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: customer_communication_required_flag

attributes.references: Customer Communication Policy, NHTSA Notification Requirements

attributes.name: dealer_notification_date
attributes.description: Date when dealers were notified of this lifecycle event.

attributes.name: dealer_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether dealer network notification is required for this lifecycle event.

attributes.name: engineering_change_number
attributes.description: Engineering Change Notice or Engineering Change Order number associated with this lifecycle event, if applicable.
attributes.references: Engineering Change Management Standard, PLM ECO Process

attributes.name: event_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the lifecycle event: milestone (key program achievement), phase gate (APQP gate), regulatory (compliance-driven), commercial (market-facing), or operational (internal process).

attributes.name: event_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the type of lifecycle event (e.g., PROG_APPR, DSGN_FRZ, SOP, JOB1, MCR_ANN, EOP, DISC).

attributes.name: event_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the lifecycle event occurred or is scheduled to occur. This is the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current status of the lifecycle event: planned (scheduled but not confirmed), confirmed (approved and scheduled), completed (occurred), cancelled, or postponed.

attributes.name: event_timestamp

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Business classification of the lifecycle event. Captures major milestones such as program approval, design freeze, Start of Production (SOP), Job 1 (first production unit), mid-cycle refresh announcement, End of Production (EOP), or nameplate discontinuation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: program_approval|design_freeze|sop|job_1|mid_cycle_refresh|eop|nameplate_discontinuation|phase_gate|homologation_approval|ppap_approval — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: financial_impact_amount

attributes.name: financial_impact_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the financial impact amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: impact_level

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this lifecycle event record was last updated in the data platform.

attributes.name: market_region
attributes.description: Geographic market or region affected by this lifecycle event (e.g., North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, Global).

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: The model year associated with the affected product entity at the time of this lifecycle event.

attributes.name: new_state

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes, comments, or context about this lifecycle event for audit trail and business reference.

attributes.name: planned_date

attributes.name: plant_code

attributes.name: platform_code

attributes.name: press_release_reference
attributes.description: Reference number, URL, or document identifier for the associated press release or public announcement, if applicable.

attributes.name: prior_state
attributes.description: The lifecycle state or phase of the affected entity immediately before this event occurred (e.g., concept, development, pre-production, production, phase-out).
attributes.references: PLM State Model, APQP Phase Framework

attributes.name: production_volume_impact
attributes.description: Estimated change in production volume (units) resulting from this lifecycle event. Positive for ramp-up events, negative for phase-out or discontinuation.

attributes.name: program_code
attributes.description: Internal program code or project identifier for the vehicle program associated with this lifecycle event.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason or driver for this lifecycle event (e.g., market demand, regulatory requirement, cost reduction, quality improvement, end of platform life).

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the business rationale, circumstances, or drivers behind this lifecycle event.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: Reference to any regulatory filing or submission associated with this event (e.g., NHTSA recall notice, EPA certification, homologation approval number).

attributes.description: Unique identifier or key of this event record in the source system, used for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person, role, or organizational unit that authorized or triggered this lifecycle event (e.g., Chief Product Officer, Program Manager, Executive Committee).

attributes.description: System identifier for the person or role that authorized this event, linking to employee or role master data.

attributes.name: variance_days
attributes.description: Number of days between planned and actual event dates. Positive values indicate delay; negative values indicate early completion.

products.name: aftersales_dtc_event
products.description: Diagnostic Trouble Code (DTC) event record captured from OBD-II (On-Board Diagnostics) systems during a vehicle service visit or via connected vehicle telematics. Tracks VIN, DTC code (SAE J2012 standardized or OEM-proprietary), ECU module source, fault type (confirmed, pending, permanent), fault description, freeze frame data snapshot, first occurrence timestamp, last occurrence timestamp, occurrence count, MIL (Malfunction Indicator Lamp) status, cleared flag, repair order linkage, and technician diagnostic action taken. products.name: rebate_coverage
products.description: Represents the contractual coverage of a rebate agreement for a specific vehicle nameplate. Each record links one nameplate to one rebate agreement and stores the terms that apply to that pairing.. Existence Justification: A vehicle nameplate can be covered by multiple rebate agreements over its lifecycle, and a single rebate agreement can apply to many nameplates (e.g., a dealer incentive that spans a model family). The agreement terms (rates, dates, status, target volume) are managed as a contract and are not intrinsic to either the nameplate or the agreement alone, requiring a link that captures this many‑to‑many participation.

products.description: This association product represents the contractual relationship between a parts order and a shipment. domains.name: billing
domains.description: SSOT for all revenue transactions and receivables. Owns dealer invoices, retail customer billing, fleet account statements, parts and service charges, payment records, credit notes, and dispute management. Handles invoicing, payment receipt, credit memos, and financial settlement for vehicle sales and services. Integrates with the source system supports MSRP-based and negotiated pricing models.
domains.references: IFRS, SAP SD, Revenue Recognition Standards

products.name: invoice
products.description: Core billing document representing a formal demand for payment issued to dealers, retail customers, fleet accounts, or corporate buyers for vehicle sales, parts, or services. Captures invoice number, invoice date, due date, invoice type (dealer/retail/fleet/parts/service), billing entity, billing address, currency, total amount, tax amount, discount amount, net amount, payment terms, invoice status (draft/issued/partially_paid/paid/cancelled/disputed), the source system document reference, MSRP-based or negotiated pricing flag, and model year context. SSOT for all outbound billing documents in the enterprise.

products.description: Individual line item on a billing invoice representing a specific charge for a vehicle unit, parts SKU, labor operation, accessory, or service fee. attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Required for General Ledger posting of each invoice line revenue to the appropriate GL account for financial reporting.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent invoice header. Links this line item to the billing invoice document.

attributes.name: part_master_id

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Supports profit‑center profitability analysis by linking each sales line to its profit center.

attributes.name: rep_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the salesperson who completed this transaction. Used for sales commission calculation and performance tracking.

attributes.name: repair_order_line_id

attributes.name: service_subscription_id

attributes.name: cancellation_reason

attributes.name: cost_center

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Marketing promotion or incentive program code applied to this line. Tracks the specific promotional campaign that influenced the pricing or discount.

attributes.name: quantity

attributes.name: revenue_category
attributes.description: Revenue classification for financial reporting and analytics. Categorizes the line item into major revenue streams for P&L (Profit and Loss) reporting and business intelligence. products.name: payment
products.description: Record of a payment received against an invoice or account balance from a dealer, retail customer, fleet operator, or corporate account. Captures payment date, payment method (wire/ACH/check/credit_card/floorplan/dealer_draft), payment amount, currency, applied invoice references, bank reference number, clearing date, payment status (pending/cleared/returned/reversed), the source system document reference, and payer entity type. SSOT for all inbound payment receipts in the billing domain.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment record. Primary key for the payment entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Payments are charged to a cost center for cash‑flow and expense tracking.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Cash receipt posting requires a GL account to record the payment in the ledger.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice against which this payment is applied. Links payment to the billing document.

attributes.name: payment_party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the entity making the payment (dealer, retail customer, fleet operator, or corporate account).

attributes.name: payment_payer_entity_party_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the entity making the payment (dealer, retail customer, fleet operator, or corporate account).

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Profit‑center reporting of cash receipts requires linking payments to the responsible profit center.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary value of the payment received before any adjustments or fees.

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment amount that has been successfully applied to outstanding invoices or account balances.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization code provided by the payment processor or bank confirming approval of the payment transaction.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Bank account number from which the payment originated. Masked or tokenized for security. Used for reconciliation and fraud prevention.

attributes.name: bank_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique reference number assigned by the bank or financial institution for the payment transaction. Used for reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: batch_reference
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch or group of payments processed together. Used for bulk payment processing and reconciliation.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Interface or channel through which the payment was submitted. Distinguishes between online portal, mobile app, bank transfer, mail, and in-person payments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: online_portal|mobile_app|bank_transfer|mail|in_person|automated_system|dealer_system — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was cleared and funds were confirmed as received in the company bank account.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user or system that created the payment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment amount (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Discount amount granted for early payment according to payment terms (e.g., 2% discount for payment within 10 days).

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payment is currently under dispute or has been disputed by the payer or payee.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason for payment dispute. Populated only when dispute_flag is true.

attributes.name: lockbox_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the bank lockbox service used to receive and process the payment. Applicable for check and mail payments.

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: Instrument or mechanism used to make the payment. Includes wire transfer, ACH (Automated Clearing House), check, credit card, floorplan financing, and dealer draft. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wire_transfer|ach|check|credit_card|debit_card|floorplan_financing|dealer_draft|electronic_funds_transfer|cash|promissory_note — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to the payment. May include remittance advice, special instructions, or reconciliation notes.

attributes.name: payer_entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the entity making the payment. Distinguishes between dealer payments, retail customer payments, fleet operator payments, and corporate account payments.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was initiated or received by the payer. Represents the business event date of the payment transaction.

attributes.name: payment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique reference number for the payment transaction. Used for customer communication and reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment. Tracks whether the payment is pending, cleared, returned, reversed, or cancelled. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|cleared|returned|reversed|cancelled|on_hold|partially_applied — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: processor
attributes.description: Name of the third-party payment processor or gateway used to process the payment (e.g., the source system, PayPal, bank name).

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was reconciled with bank statements and confirmed in the accounting system.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the payment has been successfully reconciled with bank statements and accounting records.

attributes.name: remittance_advice
attributes.description: Detailed remittance information provided by the payer indicating which invoices or charges this payment is intended to cover.

attributes.name: return_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was returned or reversed by the bank or payment processor. Populated only when payment status is returned or reversed.

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for payment return or reversal (e.g., insufficient funds, account closed, stop payment). Populated only when payment status is returned or reversed.

attributes.name: routing_number
attributes.description: Bank routing number or SWIFT code for the payer financial institution. Used for wire transfers and ACH (Automated Clearing House) transactions.

attributes.name: sap_clearing_document_number

attributes.description: Reference to the the source system document that records the application of this payment to open invoices. Links payment to financial accounting records.

attributes.name: sap_payment_document_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Financial Accounting (FI) Payment Document Number
attributes.description: Reference to the the source system document that records the receipt of this payment. Primary link to ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) financial records.

tag_set.value: SAP Financial Accounting (FI) Payment Document Number

attributes.name: terms_code
attributes.description: Code representing the payment terms under which this payment was made (e.g., net 30, net 60, immediate). Links to master payment terms reference.

attributes.name: transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the payment processor or gateway. Used for tracking and reconciliation with external systems.

attributes.name: unapplied_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment amount that remains unapplied and is held as credit on the payer account.

attributes.name: updated_by_user
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user or system that last modified the payment record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payment record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: payment_allocation
products.description: Association record linking a payment to one or more invoice lines, capturing how a single payment is distributed across multiple invoices or partial invoice settlements. Tracks allocated amount per invoice, allocation date, allocation type (full/partial/advance/overpayment), remaining balance after allocation, and clearing status. Enables accurate accounts receivable aging and open item management aligned with the source system item clearing.

attributes.name: payment_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment allocation record. Primary key for the payment allocation entity.

attributes.name: billing_invoice_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific invoice line item being settled. Enables line-level payment allocation for partial settlements and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice receiving the payment allocation. Links to the invoice document being settled or partially settled by this allocation.

attributes.name: payment_approved_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the supervisor or manager who approved the allocation. Required for allocations requiring management approval due to amount thresholds or exception handling.

attributes.name: payment_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created or approved the allocation. Used for audit trail and accountability in manual allocation scenarios.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payment transaction being allocated. Links to the payment record that is being distributed across one or more invoices.

attributes.name: primary_payment_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created or approved the allocation. Used for audit trail and accountability in manual allocation scenarios.

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount from the payment that is allocated to this specific invoice or invoice line. Represents the portion of the total payment applied to settle this receivable.

attributes.name: allocated_amount_base_currency
attributes.description: The allocated amount converted to the company base currency using the exchange rate. Enables consolidated financial reporting and accounts receivable aging in a single currency.

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The date when the payment was allocated to the invoice. Represents the business event date for accounts receivable clearing and aging calculations.

attributes.name: allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to create the allocation. Automatic indicates system-matched allocation, manual indicates user-created allocation, system_proposed indicates system suggestion requiring approval, batch_clearing indicates mass clearing process.

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique identifier for the payment allocation. Used for tracking and reference in accounts receivable operations and customer communications.

attributes.name: allocation_priority
attributes.description: Priority sequence for applying payment when multiple invoices are eligible. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used in automatic allocation rules and aging calculations.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment allocation. Pending indicates awaiting confirmation, cleared indicates successfully applied, reversed indicates allocation has been undone, disputed indicates under investigation, reconciled indicates confirmed and balanced, voided indicates cancelled allocation.

attributes.name: allocation_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the payment allocation was recorded in the system. Used for audit trail and transaction sequencing.

attributes.name: allocation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the allocation method. Full indicates complete invoice settlement, partial indicates partial payment, advance indicates prepayment before invoice, overpayment indicates excess payment requiring refund or credit, credit_memo indicates credit note application, adjustment indicates manual correction.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the allocation was approved. Null for automatic allocations not requiring approval. Used for workflow tracking and compliance audit.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: the source system for segment reporting. Enables revenue and receivables analysis by business unit, product line, or geographic region.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: the source system document number that records the open item clearing transaction. Links the payment allocation to the financial accounting clearing entry.

attributes.name: clearing_status
attributes.description: Status of the open item clearing in the source system indicates invoice not yet settled, cleared indicates fully settled, partially_cleared indicates partial payment applied, reset indicates clearing was reversed.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: the source system representing the legal entity receiving the payment. Enables multi-entity financial consolidation and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the payment allocation record was first created in the database. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the allocated amount. Supports multi-currency billing and payment scenarios common in global automotive sales and dealer networks.

attributes.name: customer_account_number
attributes.description: Customer account number in the accounts receivable system. Used for customer-level payment tracking and credit management.

attributes.name: dealer_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the dealer or customer account associated with this payment allocation. Enables dealer-level accounts receivable reporting and performance tracking.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Early payment discount amount applied during this allocation. Common in automotive dealer invoicing where prompt payment terms offer percentage discounts.

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage rate of the cash discount applied. Typically defined in payment terms and calculated based on payment timing relative to invoice date.

attributes.name: dispute_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this allocation is under dispute. True indicates customer has contested the invoice or payment application.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the dispute reason. Captures customer explanation for contesting the allocation or invoice amount.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied when payment currency differs from invoice currency. Used for cross-currency allocation calculations and financial reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the allocation occurred. Supports monthly financial close and period-based reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the payment allocation occurred. Used for period-based financial reporting and accounts receivable aging analysis.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the payment allocation record was last modified. Updated whenever any field in the record changes. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the payment allocation. Used for documenting special circumstances, manual adjustments, or customer communications.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date when the allocation was posted to the general ledger. May differ from allocation date due to period-end processing or backdated corrections.

attributes.name: profit_center
attributes.description: Profit center responsible for this revenue transaction. Used for internal management accounting and profitability analysis.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the allocation in the accounts receivable reconciliation process. Pending indicates awaiting reconciliation, reconciled indicates confirmed and balanced, exception indicates discrepancy requiring investigation, under_review indicates active reconciliation in progress.

attributes.name: remaining_invoice_balance
attributes.description: The outstanding balance remaining on the invoice after this allocation is applied. Zero indicates full settlement. Used for open item management and accounts receivable aging.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date when the allocation was reversed. Null if allocation has not been reversed. Used for audit trail and accounts receivable reconciliation.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this allocation has been reversed. True indicates the allocation was subsequently undone, typically due to payment failure or correction.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for allocation reversal. Examples include payment failure, incorrect allocation, duplicate payment, or customer dispute.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The effective date for cash flow and liquidity management. Represents when funds are actually available in the bank account.

products.name: credit_memo
products.description: Formal credit note issued to a dealer, retail customer, or fleet account to reverse or reduce a previously issued invoice charge. Captures credit memo number, originating invoice reference, credit reason code (return/pricing_error/warranty_adjustment/recall_allowance/volume_rebate/goodwill), credit amount, tax credit amount, issue date, approval status, approver, and the source system memo document reference. Supports dealer volume rebates, vehicle return credits, and service charge reversals.

attributes.name: credit_memo_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the credit memo record. Primary key.

attributes.name: aftersales_warranty_claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the warranty claim that this credit memo is compensating, if applicable.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager who approved the credit memo. Supports audit trail and authorization compliance.

attributes.name: credit_customer_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer (dealer, retail customer, or fleet account) receiving the credit memo.

attributes.name: credit_dealer_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer receiving the credit memo, if applicable. Used for dealer-specific credits such as volume rebates or vehicle return credits.

attributes.name: credit_dealership_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer receiving the credit memo, if applicable. Used for dealer-specific credits such as volume rebates or vehicle return credits.

attributes.name: credit_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager who approved the credit memo. Supports audit trail and authorization compliance.

attributes.name: credit_party_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer (dealer, retail customer, or fleet account) receiving the credit memo.

attributes.name: dealer_incentive_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dealer incentive program (e.g., volume rebate, promotional allowance) that this credit memo fulfills, if applicable.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Credit memos need a GL account for reversal entries in the ledger.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original invoice that this credit memo is reversing or adjusting.

attributes.name: recall_campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the recall campaign for which this credit memo provides dealer or customer compensation, if applicable.

attributes.name: vin_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vehicle.vin_registry. Business justification: Credit memos may be issued for a specific vehicle (e.g., warranty reimbursement); FK links credit adjustments to the vehicle record.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the credit memo was approved by the authorized approver. Distinct lifecycle event from issue and posting.

attributes.name: approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the person who approved the credit memo. Provides human-readable audit information.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description explaining why the credit memo was cancelled, if status is cancelled.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the credit memo record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: credit_memo_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the credit memo, typically following format CM followed by 10 digits. Used for customer communication and the source system reference.

attributes.name: credit_memo_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the credit memo in the approval and posting workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|issued|posted|cancelled|rejected — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: credit_reason_code

attributes.name: credit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the credit memo by its financial treatment and business purpose.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the credit memo transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, JPY).

attributes.name: dispute_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing dispute record that triggered this credit memo, if applicable. Links credit to dispute resolution workflow.

attributes.name: distribution_channel
attributes.description: the source system channel through which the original sale and credit were processed (e.g., dealer network, fleet sales, direct retail).

attributes.name: division

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the credit memo was posted. Supports monthly financial close and reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the credit memo was issued or posted. Used for period-based financial reporting and analysis.

attributes.name: gross_credit_amount

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: Date when the credit memo was officially issued to the customer or dealer. Principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: model_year
attributes.description: Model year of the vehicle associated with this credit memo, if applicable. Supports product-line analysis of credits.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Username or employee identifier of the person who last modified the credit memo record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the credit memo record was last modified. Audit trail for record lifecycle.

attributes.name: net_credit_amount
